jobs.title: Senior Process Engieer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of
lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming
the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a
cleaner and more innovative future.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the
design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes.
This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering,
and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into
robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our
future plants are built on solid fundamentals.
Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite
and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external
engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with:
a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production
environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is
telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Must Have's:
1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up
● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants.
● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process
descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions.

● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design
criteria and scale-up assumptions.
● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future
plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than
theoretical assumptions alone.
2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization
● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps.
● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of
graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing.
● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and
translate these insights into concrete process improvements.
● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on
process performance and technology development rather than daily
troubleshooting.
3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling
● Turn plant data into engineering decisions.
● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances
and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process
performance.
● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions.
● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure
that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality.
● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and
future plant designs.
4. Commissioning & Process Validation
● Make sure what we designed actually works.
● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance
validation for new equipment and plant expansions.
● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original
design intent.
● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed
systems achieve their calculated performance targets.
● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership
transfers once the process meets its design criteria.
5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs
● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently.
● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation.
● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews,
ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather
than after installation.
● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process
parameters of newly commissioned systems.

Nice-to-have's:
Vendor & EPC Coordination
● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners
and equipment suppliers.
● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering
documentation.
● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and
ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process.
● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process
performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and
equipment vendors throughout project execution.


Your profile

You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving
technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and
real plant data.
● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical
Engineering or a related technical field.
● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical,
hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process
industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and
post-processing is highly preferred.
● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs,
mass/energy balances and equipment sizing.
● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data
into engineering models and decisions.
● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation,
hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable.
● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical
assumptions.
● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of
industrial equipment or plants.
● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA.
● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering
documentation and the actual plant.
● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering,
Operations, suppliers and EPC partners.
● Fluent English; German is a plus.


Why us?

Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward
increasingly larger and more standardized plants.
The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning
what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants
while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts.
You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the
technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is
safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
What you can expect from us

Eraneos supports AI initiatives from strategy all the way through to production. In most AI projects, there's a gap between the strategy and what actually ends up running in production and creating real value. That's exactly the gap we close. 

For us, the work doesn't stop at the concept stage, and it doesn't start only once the spec is finished: an initiative stays in one pair of hands from the first idea to the running system. We work in a results-driven way rather than following the classic consulting model. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies. 

You help decide what gets built, not just how. We always work with the latest models and tools to succeed with the client. There's no prescribed stack — instead, we pick the right tool for each task. You design technical solutions from the first idea through to production deployment, working closely with decision-makers on both the client and management side. 

What to expect:

  • You own the architecture and technical implementation of the AI solution end to end — from strategy through to production
  • You build agentic systems, RAG pipelines, and LLM integrations in real enterprise environments
  • Agentic coding tools are your everyday toolkit: you use them to develop solutions, speed up reviews, and build deployment pipelines
  • You're involved from the very first idea, not just once the spec is finished — growing deeper into the strategic and business side along the way
  • You stay accountable until the end: you don't hand things off, you see the solution through until it's running and delivering impact
  • You represent your technical decisions directly at executive level and lead these conversations yourself, without going through an intermediary layer


Who you are

  • You stand behind the whole outcome, not just one part of it. You stick with it until the solution is running in production and delivering impact, and you share in the responsibility for that — a founder and product mindset rather than simply executing tasks
  • You build hands-on, at the highest level — and you think beyond the code. From an engineering perspective, that means you've already taken LLM-based systems into production and understand the business rationale behind them, not just the architecture
  • You're convincing at executive level. You've already owned and defended technical decisions directly in front of top management. You bring this with you — we won't be developing you into it
  • Proven experience bringing LLM-based systems into production — ideally as a Forward-Deployed or Founding Engineer
  • Excellent, production-grade Python skills (e.g. FastAPI, containers, Git, CI/CD) and a deep understanding of agentic architectures, retrieval methods, and function calling
  • You use agentic coding tools as a core part of your toolkit, not as a gimmick — including building deployment pipelines
  • An appetite for picking up where classic engineering roles leave off, and for growing deeper into the strategic side
  • Ideally, experience in one of our core industries — Financial Services, Transportation & Logistics, Energy & Utilities, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Public Sector, Automotive, or Defence. More important than the specific industry is that you quickly get up to speed in a new, often regulated environment
  • German (at least C1) and business-fluent English

  • Sehr gute Python-Skills

  • Erfahrung in Pre-Sales oder technischer Führung
  • Erfahrung im Consulting oder in kundennahen Projekten
  • Erfahrung mit AWS Connect
  • Solide Erfahrung mit IaC (Terraform oder vergleichbar)

jobs.title: Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
THE JOB

Reading this to the end is worth it.

The Company: Why mute-labs?


mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back.


We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you.


Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires.


The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel


This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing.


  • Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it.

  • Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script.

  • Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on.

  • Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once.

  • A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one.

  • A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers.


Is This You?


  • The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you.

  • Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here.

  • Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role.

  • Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language.


Our Hiring Process


We keep this fast and honest, on both sides.


  1. The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit.

  2. The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team.

  3. The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal.

  4. The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here.


ABOUT US

mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart:


  • We are "no tech": we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need.

  • We have no investors, and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one.

  • We are on a steep growth curve, measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake.

  • We are not building toward an exit. We are building a company meant to last for generations.



Skip the Queue

Told you it was worth reading to the end.


We are looking for someone with a go-getter attitude who does not wait around for permission. So here is your first test: don't apply through the form. Cold call your future manager, Patrick, directly.


+49 15888 279908


If you get through and make your case, you've already shown us more than any CV could.

Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme Elisa Oyj:lle Tampereen Ratinan myymälään myyjää, työskentelyalue kattaa Tampereen talousalueen. Tehtävä edellyttää joustavuutta ja valmiutta työskennellä myös muissa Tampereen alueen Elisa myymälöissä.

Päivittäisessä työssäsi keskityt Elisan tuotteiden ja palveluiden aktiivisesta myynnistä henkilöasiakkaille myymälässä. Tehtävään kuuluu myös jalkautuminen erilaisiin toimintaympäristöihin asiakkaiden tarpeiden mukaan. Lisäksi osallistut myymälän arjen sujuvuuden varmistamiseen. Millainen henkilö menestyy tehtävässä?

- Aikaisempi kokemus asiakaspalvelusta tai tavoitteellisesta myyntityöstä on toivottavaa

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- Työtunnit 20 h/vko, toivomme joustavuutta käytettävyyteen -mahdollisuus lisätunteihin!
- Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Työnantajana Barona Sales Oy

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
jobs.description:
Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit.

The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible.

The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability.

A core scientific challenge is to represent cross-layer trade-offs without hiding their origin: rather than isolated energy or latency numbers, the framework should expose bottlenecks, sensitivities, feasibility limits, break-even points and opportunities and identify the regimes in which a technology becomes advantageous. Target workloads span edge inference through to transformer-inspired models, with use cases in vision, audio and sensor processing, sparse and vector/matrix operations, and on-device learning.

Expected outcomes: a maintainable evaluation environment combining fast exploration with selected higherfidelity validation paths; cross-layer models and interface contracts, reusable data schemes, benchmarking flows, system-level Pareto analyses and design guidelines for emerging AI accelerators – a decision-support instrument for future research projects.


Candidate profile: PhD in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, with a strong background in several of: computer architecture and AI accelerators; performance, energy and area modelling; design space exploration and multi-objective optimization; hardwaresoftware co-design and workload mapping; emerging memories, compute-in-memory or photonic computing. Strong Python skills and sound software-engineering practice are essential; experience with SystemC, C/C++, RISCV simulation, QEMU, PyTorch/ONNX workload flows, architecture simulators (NeuroSim, CiMLoop/AccelForge, Timeloop or similar) will be appreciated. Familiarity with circuit-level modelling or EDA is an asset, but the focus is architectural and system-level research.

Environment: the position is hosted by the Electronics group at INL (UMR CNRS 5270), Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Écully, France – an interdisciplinary environment spanning devices, circuits, architectures, design automation, photonics and integrated systems, with national and European collaborations.

Starting date: Fall 2026

jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Location: You can choose to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, Portugal, or Spain.
 
Mission
 
Join us as an iOS Engineer and help us build the most intuitive mobile banking experience for European businesses. You'll be crafting features that directly impact the daily financial operations of over 600,000 SMEs across Europe, making their business finance simpler and more efficient.
 
As an iOS Engineer at Qonto, you will:
 
• Craft cutting-edge financial features: Work on critical architectural and UI features that will directly impact our end users.
• Foster meaningful collaboration: Work closely with back-end teams, designers, and product managers to create a unified vision.
• Solve real-time challenges: Tackle real-time synchronization issues and spearhead new initiatives.
• Champion quality: Maintain an exceptional level of quality by implementing continuous refactoring and unit testing to consistently enhance the codebase.
 
What you can expect
 
• You'll be building for Europe's fastest-growing business banking market, with 600K+ clients across multiple countries and ambitious expansion plans
• Work in an environment that prioritizes quality, comprehensive code reviews, component approach and continuous refactoring as standard practice
• Contribute to a fully Swift-based app using MVP and Coordinators architecture, with modern CI/CD through GitHub, Firebase, and Bitrise
• Access to expert mentorship, Tech Weeklies & Monthlies, and conference opportunities to stay at the forefront of iOS development
 
Our methodology, the Qonto Way
We value upfront technical design, team reviews, and smart slicing, quality drives the velocity our customers need;
Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates;
Our lean toolbox, Kaizen, PDCA, lets you monitor and drive continuous improvement collaboratively with your peers and manager;
Each engineer gets access to Cursor or Copilot, and we want people who use AI to raise the bar, not just to go faster.
 
Your future team

As an iOS Engineer, you will join one of Qonto's squad teams, each organized around a clear project mission, with one team lead and full ownership of a product scope. You'll be part of a 140 mobile engineering community within a 500 Product Engineering department, working in focused teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Frontend and Backend.
 
Our stack & practices

Our app is 100% Swift, built on MVP & Clean Architecture with 35+ independent modules. We use the Coordinator pattern for scalability, and all new screens are built in SwiftUI (MVVM) with async/await — 80+ screens already migrated. Project generation and build optimization run on Tuist. CI/CD covers GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Firebase Test Lab, Sonar, and Fastlane.

We take technical excellence seriously: 30,000+ unit tests, 450+ snapshot tests, SwiftyMocky for mock generation, and LLMs integrated into our dev workflow. Our modular architecture (32 reusable modules + centralized design system) ensures fast builds, clear ownership, and safe iterations.

Want to know more about our mobile performance indicators? Read this.

 

About You
 
• iOS Expertise: Proven experience as a Mobile engineer with strong Swift skills and deep understanding of the iOS ecosystem, SDK, and development lifecycle
• Quality-driven development: Strong commitment to best practices, including unit testing (XCTests, FBSnapshots), Clean code / SOLID principles, and organized workflows
• Problem-solving approach: Pragmatic and solution-oriented approach to engineering challenges, with ability to deliver tangible value in a fast-paced environment
• Collaborative spirit: Excellent communication skills, fluent english and experience working effectively in cross-functional teams with both technical and non-technical colleagues
• Growth mindset: Curious and proactive developer who thrives on learning new technologies and contributing to a product serving hundreds of thousands of users
At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.

jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are looking for an engaged and passionate Staff Engineer to join our growing engineering department and be a technical leader across our engineering teams.
 
As a Staff Engineer, you will be responsible for driving influence across teams and domains, leading solution delivery on cross-functional and strategic initiatives, and serving as a technical leader within the engineering organization. You will ensure the set quality standards and drive the adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps.
 
Quality, excellence, and agility drive our delivery processes and you will help us level these up. Using NodeJS and Typescript back-end stacks, appropriate for each requirement, but always hosted on AWS, we build added value and resilient services on top of voice and fully integrate with our customers’ business critical tools (CRM, Helpdesk, E-Commerce, …).
 

Your mission @ Aircall:
  • Lead transversal, complex projects, fully autonomously from ideation to completion, starting from a high-level problem statement.
  • Proactively communicate the technical vision across multiple teams, ensuring alignment and sharing knowledge across domains.
  • Act as a go-to expert, providing mentorship and guidance across teams.
  • Deeply understand multiple product domains; proactively identify improvements and advocate for customer needs across the company.
  • Lead and define technical strategies for complex, impactful problems.
  • Set and uphold higher quality standards and drive adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps.
  • Writes production-ready code, finding appropriate solutions for medium complexity challenges; participates in software design discussions; demonstrates a good understanding of system infrastructure and DevOps principles; contributes to performance and quality within their scope; applies a security-first mindset.
    •  

    A little about you:
  • A little about you:You have extensive experience (e.g., 10+ years) in back-end development, using TypeScript & NodeJS/Python/Ruby/Rails or other languages, with a focus on delivering for security, scalability, availability, and performance across multiple domains.
  • You lead and define technical strategies, demonstrating a strong understanding of system design to solve complex, impactful problems.
  • You are comfortable leading the development of complex projects affecting multiple teams and domains, driving initiatives from ideation to completion.
  • You are an expert at identifying opportunities for new impactful initiatives.
  • You have a deep understanding of multiple product domains and can anticipate long-term needs.
  • You possess effective and proactive communication skills, and can collaborate with different profiles and roles to ensure cross-domain alignment.

    • Our Tech Stack:
  • You do not need to be familiar with all of our technical stack or any specific functional area, but you have a strong willingness to learn and adapt quickly.
  • Typescript/Node.js, Python, REST API/GraphQL APIs, Ruby/Rails, React AWS/Serverless or EKS, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Redis

  • Run the EMEA forecast process end to end — preparing, facilitating, and following up on weekly forecast calls across the four Areas (FIME, UKI, DACH, Iberia)

  • Own the quarterly business review (QBR) cadence: structure, narrative, data, and readouts for regional and executive audiences

  • Deliver analytics and insights across the full EMEA GTM funnel (BDR, AE, PAM, AM, SE, CE, FDE), translating data into clear, actionable recommendations

  • Lead process improvement initiatives that increase seller productivity, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy

  • Partner with the Global RevOps Center of Excellence, providing regional inputs and adopting standardized best practices, tooling, and methodologies

  • Drive annual planning for EMEA, including territory design, segmentation, and capacity/headcount modeling

  • Support quota setting, coverage models, and GTM design in partnership with Sales, Finance, and the broader RevOps team

  • Maintain data quality and operational discipline across the region's systems and reporting


    • What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Strategy & Operations, or a comparable analytical/commercial role, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment

  • Strong experience supporting a multi-segment, multi-country GTM organization across direct, partner, and post-sales motions

  • Demonstrated ownership of forecasting, pipeline management, and QBR processes at a regional or business-unit level

  • Excellent analytical skills — fluency with Salesforce and BI/reporting tools (Looker, Hex); comfort building capacity, territory, and segmentation models

  • Experience with annual planning, including territory and quota design

  • Exceptional stakeholder management — credible with senior commercial leaders and able to influence without authority

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills; able to turn complex data into a clear executive narrative

  • A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-moving environment

Jobomschrijving

2026 promises to be a year of exciting growth, and we want YOU to be part of our success story! We are looking for dedicated process operators to join our team at a leading biotechnology company. What can you expect in this exciting role?

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Your journey begins with extensive training, where we immerse you in the world of aseptic (germ-free) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) operations, including the crucial procedures you need to master.

Afterward, you will join our dynamic and driven Operations team, which works together every day to fulfill our mission. Alongside your fellow operators and team leaders, you will perform aseptic and manual production processes according to strict, proven procedures.

  • Daily aseptic and manual production processes
  • Executing production steps in controlled environments (grade A/B/C/D) Spiking
  • Media refreshing
  • Cell culture
  • Freezing therapeutic products
  • Managing equipment: inspections and maintenance
  • Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials
  • Supporting transitions between production zones
  • Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

What does our client expect from you?

  • A strong sense of responsibility and a passion for making a difference in the lives of patients.
  • Clear communication with your colleagues and supervisor.
  • You love structure and order, are very accurate, and are willing to work in an aseptic environment with appropriate sterile clothing.
  • Experience in pharma or biotech is not required as we provide complete training.
  • You have a high school diploma (A2) or equivalent through experience. The mindset for quality and accuracy takes precedence over diploma and background.
  • You have good PC skills:
    Be able to add attachment to an email

jobs.title: Reach truck operator
jobs.description:
TPCE (Toyota Parts Centre Europe) is Toyota's European distribution center. It supplies Toyota and Lexus parts to distributors throughout Europe. In addition, TPCE delivers directly to garages and dealerships in Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, and Northern France. At the Diest facility, imported Toyota and Lexus automotive parts are stored, orders for dealers and distributors are picked and assembled, and shipments are prepared and dispatched. TPCE is a modern, highly automated distribution center specializing in automotive parts logistics.


Jobomschrijving

Toyota Diest is looking for reach truck operators who are passionate about their profession and seeking a long-term career opportunity.

Are you the person we're looking for? Then Toyota is the right place for you!

As a Reach Truck Operator, your responsibilities include:

  • Order picking
  • Moving automotive parts and placing/removing them from warehouse racks
  • Stacking various pallets
  • ...

You will start working in a specific department, where you will learn all aspects of the operation. Over time, you will also become familiar with other departments. At Toyota, there is always room for growth and development! You will have the opportunity to develop into a fully-fledged Toyota team member. Who knows, you might even become Toyota's next supervisor or team leader.

Did you know that?

  • Toyota offers highly stable employment.
  • After approximately six months of employment, you may be offered a long-term contract.
  • Toyota grants permanent contracts to temporary agency workers twice a year.
  • More than 1,000 employees work at Toyota, making it one of the largest employers in the region.
  • Toyota encourages continuous development and promotes a culture based on teamwork and respect.
  • It is the ideal workplace for people who value innovation, people-oriented values, and a stable career.

Experience? Not necessary at all! We invest in our employees and provide comprehensive training. With the right attitude, you'll go a long way!

You are looking for a job where you can build a future. After positive performance evaluations, you may qualify for a permanent contract.

In addition:

  • You have experience operating a reach truck.
  • You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:50 AM - 2:00 PM and 1:50 PM - 10:00 PM).
  • Do you enjoy rolling up your sleeves and staying physically active? Great! Then Toyota is the right place for you.
  • Safety is your top priority.
  • You can travel independently to work. While we encourage carpooling, you must also be able to commute on your own when your carpool partner is unavailable. Public transport is not an option, considering your work hours.

jobs.title: Experienced Junior Graphic Designer - Scale-up company
jobs.description:
Monday Merch produces physical branded merchandise and custom apparel for international enterprise clients. Due to the high technical complexity of physical manufacturing, this role requires at least 1 year of hands-on experience specifically in merchandise, apparel, or packaging design.

A standard graphic design background is insufficient. The candidate must possess proven experience with pre-press production processes, including vectorizing artwork, Pantone (PMS) color matching, print separations for embroidery and Screen Printing/DTG, and mapping 2D artwork onto complex 3D product surfaces. Furthermore, the candidate must have experience executing designs within strict corporate B2B brand guidelines and working directly with technical specifications from global manufacturers.

About Monday Merch
Monday Merch is a fast-growing B2B merch platform based in Rotterdam. We design, produce, and deliver high-quality, sustainable custom merchandise and corporate gifts for leading global brands and scale-ups.

The Role: Graphic & Visual Designer
We are looking for a talented Graphic & Visual Designer to join our creative team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between creative visual design and physical product execution. You will be responsible for creating compelling visual assets, developing brand identities, and translating complex design concepts into production-ready physical merchandise.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop full visual identity packages, brand guidelines, and high-impact design assets.
Create production-ready vector files and technical specs (tech packs, CMYK/Pantone prepress) for apparel, accessories, and custom packaging.
Lead design projects from initial concept and artwork creation through final supplier handoff.
Collaborate with account managers, production teams, and external suppliers to maintain visual quality across physical products.

What We Offer:
A dynamic, international work environment in Rotterdam.
Full-time position (40h/week) with market-competitive remuneration.
Catered team lunches, travel reimbursement, and high-end merch benefits.

jobs.title: Verpleegkundige
jobs.description:

Dirksland - Ziekenhuis

32
Ben jij als verpleegkundige toe aan de volgende stap in je carrière? Wil jij je verder specialiseren in de zorg voor zwangeren, vrouwen tijdens de bevalling én pasgeboren baby's? Dan is de opleiding tot obstetrieverpleegkundige misschien wel precies wat je zoekt! Wij zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste leerling obstetrieverpleegkundige die wil bijdragen aan de best mogelijke zorg voor moeder, kind en gezin. Wil je meer weten over deze functie en opleiding? Lees dan verder!
Wat ga je doen?
Als obstetrieverpleegkundige is geen dag hetzelfde. Je verleent zorg aan zwangeren, vrouwen tijdens de bevalling, kraamvrouwen en pasgeboren baby's. Daarbij staat gezinsgerichte zorg centraal: je hebt niet alleen oog voor de moeder en het kind, maar voor het hele gezin.
Je begeleidt de zwangere of kraamvrouw, haar partner en eventuele kinderen tijdens één van de meest bijzondere momenten in hun leven. Vaak is dat een periode vol vreugde en nieuw geluk, maar soms ook een ingrijpende tijd waarin verdriet en verlies een rol spelen, bijvoorbeeld bij het overlijden van een (ongeboren) kind. Juist in die momenten maak jij met jouw deskundigheid, betrokkenheid en persoonlijke aandacht een waardevol verschil.
De opleiding
Je start met een voorwerktraject waarin we samen ontdekken of de opleiding en het vak van obstetrieverpleegkundige goed bij jou passen. Is er van beide kanten een goede match? Dan begin je aan de opleiding. Er zijn meerdere instroommomenten per jaar.
De opleiding duurt gemiddeld 13 maanden en wordt gevolgd aan de Erasmus MC Academie in Rotterdam. Tijdens de opleiding combineer je leren en werken, waardoor je de opgedane kennis direct kunt toepassen in de praktijk en jezelf stap voor stap ontwikkelt tot een deskundige obstetrieverpleegkundige.
Hoe ziet je team eruit?
Je komt te werken op een gecombineerde afdeling waar we naast obstetrische zorg...

Ben jij een Verzorgende IG die houdt van afwisseling, nieuwe uitdagingen en vrijheid in je werk? Dan hebben wij de baan voor jou!

jobs.title: PHD Candidate Towards a Tiered Risk Assessment Strategy
jobs.description:
PhD Candidate Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
30 augustus 2026 Maastricht University
WO
limburg, Maastricht
Geplaatst 9 uur geleden
Welcome to Maastricht University!
Would you like to help detect health risks in herbal food supplements earlier, using data-driven approaches? Herbal supplements are often considered safe because they are natural. But how well do we actually understand their potential health effects? In this PhD project, you will develop a testing strategy to identify possible hazards earlier and contribute to safer use of herbal supplements.
PhD Candidate: Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
Herbal food supplements are widely used and often perceived as inherently safe because they are 'natural'. Yet these products can contain complex mixtures of bioactive compounds, and their composition may vary depending on the plant material, extraction method and production process. Contamination, adulteration and differences between batches add further uncertainty. Because these products are generally not tested before entering the market, potential adverse effects may only become apparent once they are already widely used.
That is why a robust and structured strategy is needed to better evaluate the safety of herbal supplements and reduce potential risks to human health. In this collaborative project, you will investigate the hepatotoxicity, nephrotoxicity, genotoxicity and endocrine-disrupting potential of diverse herbal extracts using human-relevant in vitro models and complementary bioassays. Flamingo Parket B.V. is committed to purchasing products and services that ensure materials come from legal sources and well-managed forests that are certified to compelling certification standards and/or come from post-consumer recycled materials.

By applicable legislation we refer to the following types of legislation applicable to the harvest and trade of deforestation-free products. jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the role

We're looking for an Account Executive to join our new SME team, selling into the eCommerce, SaaS and Professional Services industries. These are fast-growing businesses operating internationally, and we're the only fintech with the payment infrastructure, software and AI layer to streamline how they get paid, manage treasury and pay suppliers from one system. Your job is to understand their priorities, surface where their finance systems are holding them back, and build the case for change.

What you will be doing

Pipeline and new business generation

  • Territory planning: prioritising accounts and the people worth reaching out to, as well as identifying routes in through partners or leadership connections.

  • Owning your outbound strategy: building a hypothesis on what a business is prioritising and where things are likely breaking, then getting to the right people. Our product evolves quickly, so we need reps who develop new angles as they open up.

  • Running a proven sales process, and iterating on it: understanding a business's priorities, the challenges preventing them from executing, and building the ROI case with the customer.

  • Forecasting: using MEDDPICC to know where you are in a deal, where the gaps are, and to forecast accordingly.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Implementation and account management: coordinating implementation and handover, including the mutual action plans that keep everyone aligned on timelines and get the customer adopting quickly.

  • Product: relaying customer insight to the product team and influencing roadmap priorities.

  • Marketing: working together on ABM campaigns, competitive positioning and customer case studies.

What you bring

Experience

  • Ideally 3+ years of B2B software or fintech sales experience, with at least 1 year in an outbound closing role.

  • If you have 2+ years in an outbound lead generation role and have been deliberate about upskilling for a move into closing, apply and tell us how.

Skills and mindset

  • Curious: about the industries we sell into, the people we sell to, and our own product. You want to understand how things actually work, not just what to say about them. You think on your feet and you're clear and concise with your communication.

  • Perceptive: you read a room, and you have genuine empathy for the people you're selling to and working alongside.

  • Driven: the motivation comes from you. You want to get better, and you keep working through the stretches where results lag effort.

  • Honest: you bring problems forward early rather than letting them surface late, and you're upfront when you don't know something.

  • Coachable: you take feedback and act on it quickly, while being critical enough about what you hear to apply it selectively.

jobs.title: Wegenwerker

Onze klant met deze vacature als wegenwerker regio Buken is gespecialiseerd in wegenbouw en maakt deel uit van een grote bouwgroep, wat zorgt voor stabiliteit en brede expertise. Het bedrijf is actief in alle aspecten van wegeniswerken en voert naast de uitvoering ook ondersteunende diensten in eigen beheer uit, zoals laboratoria, ontwerpdiensten, onderhoudsdiensten, landmeters en signalisatie. Daarnaast is het een belangrijke producent van asfalt en wegenisbeton, met vijf asfaltcentrales en twee mobiele betoncentrales. Via eigen recyclageterreinen dragen ze bij aan de recyclage van beton, asfalt en bouwafval.


Jobomschrijving

In deze job als wegenwerker regio Buken zet je iedere dag mee je schouders onder straffe projecten.

  • Je voert algemene grondwerken uit op wegenis- en rioleringswerven, zoals sleuven en bouwputten voorbereiden en funderingen aanbrengen.
  • Je plaatst rioleringen en huisaansluitingen: rioolbuizen inbedden, leidingen plaatsen en verbinden, en kolken in het wegdek installeren.
  • Je zet borduren en werkt verhardingen af, inclusief het uitschieten van beton waar nodig.
  • Je controleert kabels en nutsvoorzieningen tijdens de werken en stemt je aanpak af om schade en hinder te vermijden.
  • Je leest plannen en werktekeningen, werkt met een bouwlaser en volgt veiligheids- en milieuvoorschriften strikt op.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Voor deze vacature als wegenwerker in Buken zoeken we iemand die het werk graag goed doet.

  • Je hebt al ervaring in de wegenwerken, grondwerken of rioleringswerken.
  • Je hebt een rijbewijs B.
  • Je communiceert goed om alles veilig en vlot te laten verlopen op de werf.
  • Je wil fysiek werken en volgt alle veiligheidsvoorschriften.
  • Je kan plannen en werktekeningen lezen en bent flexibel om op verschillende werven te werken.
De ideale collega is...
  • Je werkt graag samen in een klein, hecht team en stemt vlot af met collega’s op de werf.
  • Je neemt veiligheid serieus en volgt afspraken en werfinstructies consequent op.
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en geconcentreerd, ook bij herhalende of fysiek zwaardere werkzaamheden.
  • Je communiceert duidelijk zodat overleg en veiligheidsafspraken op de werf helder blijven.
  • Je bent flexibel: je schakelt tussen verschillende werven en past je aan wanneer planning of locatie verandert.

jobs.title: Rioolarbeider

Deze aannemer met de vacature van rioolarbeider te Aalst is actief in de wegenbouw, rioleringsaanleg, milieusanering en de aanleg van publieke ruimtes. Hun projecten zijn voor zowel publieke als private opdrachtgevers in Vlaanderen en Brussel. Het bedrijf behoort tot de top 3 spelers op de Belgische infrastructuurmarkt. Vanuit verschillende vestigingen beschikken ze over eigen betonsites, recyclagesites en asfaltproductie-installaties. De bedrijfscultuur is open en samenwerkend: collega’s ondersteunen elkaar om veilig en kwalitatief werk te leveren. Kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid staan centraal, met aandacht voor planning, correcte uitvoering en ruimte om te leren en te groeien.


Jobomschrijving

Als rioolarbeider in de regio Aalst werk je samen met je ploeg op verschillende werven en voer je het onderstaande takenpakket uit:

  • Je vertrekt met je team vanaf een afgesproken opstapplaats in de regio Aalst naar de werf en stemt ter plaatse de dagplanning af met de ploegbaas en werfleiding.
  • Je voert rioleringswerken uit, zoals het maken van huisaansluitingen, het plaatsen van rioleringsbuizen en putten, en het ophogen of vrijmaken van putdeksels.
  • Je plaatst en werkt weginfrastructuur af, waaronder funderingen, kolken, boordstenen, goten en straat- of klinkerwerken.
  • Je gebruikt klein bouwmaterieel en gereedschap voor grond- en wegenwerken, zoals trilplaten, slijpschijven en (kleine) graafmachines.
  • Je houdt de werf ordelijk en veilig, controleert hoogtes en uitzettingen waar nodig, en helpt mee om de uitvoering volgens planning te laten verlopen.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Hieronder vind je wat je nodig hebt om op te starten als rioolarbeider voor deze job in de regio Aalst:

  • Je raakt iedere ochtend vlot tot een ophaalpunt in de regio Aalst.
  • Je hebt al (een eerste) ervaring als grondwerker, arbeider in rioleringswerken of wegenwerker.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd om te starten als rioolarbeider en je wil fysiek werken in weer en wind.
  • Je hebt een geldig rijbewijs B of bent er concreet mee aan de slag (praktijklessen en/of praktijkexamen ingepland).
  • Je hecht belang aan veilig en vlot communiceren op de werf.
  • Je kan vroeg starten en je bent flexibel naar werkuren, overuren en werven op verschillende locaties.
De ideale collega is...
  • Iemand die graag werkt in teamverband, vlot afstemt met ploegbaas en collega’s en meehelpt waar nodig om samen vooruitgang te maken.
  • Iemand die veiligheid en orde op de werf serieus neemt: je volgt afspraken, gebruikt materiaal correct en spreekt risico’s tijdig aan.
  • Iemand die flexibel is in werkritme en planning, met bereidheid om vroeg te starten en in overleg extra uren te doen wanneer de werfplanning dat vraagt.
  • Iemand die houdt van buitenwerk en fysiek werk, ook bij wisselende weersomstandigheden: je blijft doorzetten tot het werk klaar is.

  • Iemand die nieuwe werkwijzen en technieken snel toepast in de praktijk.

jobs.title: Ylilääkäri Psykiatria
jobs.description:
Haemme vakituiseen virkasuhteeseen ylilääkäriä HUS Psykiatrian Itä- ja Keski-Uudenmaan linjan sairaalatoimintoihin 1.10.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Tehtävä sijoittuu Hyvinkään sairaalan psykiatrisille osastoille 1 ja 2, jotka toimivat Itä- ja Keski-Uudenmaan psykiatrian linjan akuutti- ja hoito-osastoina. Vastaamme alueen psykiatrisesta akuutista osastohoidosta sekä tarjoamme laadukasta ja vaikuttavaa erikoissairaanhoitoa potilaillemme.

Ylilääkärinä johdat osastojen lääketieteellistä toimintaa ja osallistut aktiivisesti toiminnan kehittämiseen. Tehtävään kuuluu hallinnollisten vastuiden lisäksi kliinistä potilastyötä osastoilla 1 ja 2. Vastaat erikoistuvien lääkäreiden ohjauksesta sekä psykiatrisen lääkäripäivystyksen ja neuromodulaatioyksikön toiminnan lääketieteellisestä koordinoinnista.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan sekä hoidon sisältöihin että palveluiden kehittämiseen yhdessä osaavan ja motivoituneen moniammatillisen henkilöstön kanssa. Kehitämme toimintaamme jatkuvasti tarjotaksemme potilaille vaikuttavaa hoitoa ja henkilöstölle hyvän työympäristön. Tuemme ammatillista kehittymistä koulutusten, työnohjauksen ja laajojen verkostojen avulla. Virkaan sisältyy mahdollisuus osallistua päivystystoimintaan.

Työ alkaa 1.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Hae meille hakuajan loppuun mennessä. HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.

Kelpoisuusvaatimukset

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on psykiatrian erikoislääkärin pätevyys sekä laillistetun lääkärin oikeudet ja lupa toimia lääkärin ammatissa Suomessa. Sijaisuuksissa voidaan huomioida myös erikoistumisen loppuvaiheessa olevat.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

Arvostamme kokemusta psykiatrian akuuttihoidosta sekä hallinnollisista tai johtamistehtävistä. Menestyäksesi tehtävässä sinulla on joustava työote, hyvät yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot sekä kyky johtaa toimintaa tavoitteellisesti muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä.

Virkaan valitun tulee esittää työterveyshuollon arvio edellytyksistään hoitaa virkaan kuuluvia tehtäviä. Tehtävässä noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We're at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, the context-engineering layer for AI-driven software delivery used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration and efficiency, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, Bazel, npm, and Python, with support for additional build tools coming soon.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. We're investing deeply in making Develocity's unique data and decades of domain expertise accessible to both humans and AI agents, with trust, evidence, and explainability at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as DuckDuckGo, Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding; we strive to understand diverse viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals. 

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration. 

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With a deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative, bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative, and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We are looking for a hardworking, driven Account Executive to join our high-performing team. In this role, you will be the face of Develocity for enterprise prospects and customers in the New York and East Coast US region, focusing on driving revenue growth and new business acquisition.

You'll act as a primary point of contact for our enterprise accounts in your territory. Your goal will be to guide these organizations on their journey with Develocity to unlock comprehensive data throughout the build process, empowering you to detect the unknown unknowns so you can ship faster, reduce risk, and lower costs, all while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance. You will be responsible for formulating and executing a sales strategy to grow your territory and acquire new customers.

Responsibilities

As an Account Executive, you will manage the entire sales cycle, from lead to close, to expand Develocity adoption. Your main focus will be to consistently achieve or exceed quotas and drive pipeline growth.

You will do this by:

  • Developing and executing strategic account plans to target new logos not already covered by other teams.
  • Building a robust pipeline and preparing accurate forecasts for large-scale, multi-year deals.
  • Cultivating strong customer relationships and consistently engaging with key engineering and C-level executives.
  • Leading the full sales cycle, from initial outreach to close.
  • Clearly articulating the value of Develocity and providing customer feedback to enhance our product.
  • Mastering sales techniques like MEDPICC and Command of the Message to execute deals effectively.
  • Attending industry events and Develocity-hosted sessions to strengthen relationships and generate new business.
  • Analyzing wins and losses and sharing insights with internal teams to improve our approach.
  • Documenting best practices in our sales playbook to contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Being willing to travel to meet customers in person.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of direct sales experience selling enterprise software to executives in large, complex organizations.
  • A proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quotas.
  • Experience in the DevOps, Observability, or CI/CD space.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present to C-level executives.
  • Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and/or consultative sales techniques. Knowledge of MEDDPICC is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the following sales tools: Salesforce, SalesLoft, ZoomInfo, and Gong.
  • AI-first mindset to help with automating everyday tasks. 

What We Offer

  • Ability to work in a remote-first environment with flexible working hours.
  • Work on a fast-growing product with a clear vision for the future.
  • Close collaboration with an ambitious and experienced team and the opportunity to learn from them regardless of your experience level.
  • Opportunities for growth in your career and in leadership responsibilities.
  • In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite team meetings, and onboardings.
  • Contribute to leading solutions in the new industry of Developer Productivity Engineering and work with cutting-edge DPE tools and practices.
  • Competitive salaries and equity grants.

Location

Remote from Europe.

While our team works remotely and is spread across the globe, we deeply value daily interactions and collaboration.

jobs.title: SAP Account Executive (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du weißt, dass du zu den Besten gehörst.  Dein Umfeld weiß es auch.  Aber deine aktuelle Rolle gibt dir nicht mehr den Raum, den du verdienst.   Du hast in den letzten Jahren Deals geschlossen, die andere für unmöglich hielten. Du kennst das SAP-Ökosystem nicht aus Präsentationen – sondern aus echten Co-Sell-Gesprächen, aus Partnerverhandlungen, aus Abschlüssen, die du persönlich über die Linie gebracht hast.  Jetzt fragst du dich: Gibt es eine Rolle, die meinem Anspruch wirklich gerecht wird?   Die gibt es. Und du liest sie gerade. 

Die Rolle

 Dies ist eine reine New-Business-Position mit klarer strategischer Bedeutung für Implicos Wachstum in SAP-zentrierten Prozessindustrien. Du verantwortest die Gewinnung neuer Kundenlogos in den Segmenten Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie sowie Zement und Baustoffe – in enger Co-Sell-Partnerschaft mit SAP Account Teams und Industry Business Units.  Du bewegst dich in einem Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen, Substanz und Marktkenntnisse entscheiden – nicht Lautstärke. 
 
Deine Verantwortung

  • Vollständige Quota-Verantwortung für neues ARR aus Prozessindustrie-Kunden
  • Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Opportunities aus der SAP-ADRM-Pipeline sowie dem eigenen Netzwerk
  • Aufbau und Pflege belastbarer Co-Sell-Beziehungen mit SAP SCM Sales Reps und IBU-Kontakten
  • Steuerung komplexer Sales-Zyklen von 3–9 Monaten mit mehreren Entscheidungsträgern auf IT-, Operations- und C-Level-Ebene
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Architects für technische Deep Dives und Proof-of-Value-Definitionen
  • Akkurate Pipeline-Führung im CRM sowie strukturiertes Forecasting
  • Kontinuierliche Rückmeldung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsinformationen an Product- und GTM-Teams


Dein Profil

Was wir voraussetzen:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre B2B-Softwarevertrieb, davon mindestens 3 Jahre im SAP-Umfeld oder im strukturierten Co-Sell mit SAP
  • Nachweisliche Hunter-Bilanz: nachhaltig neue Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut und abgeschlossen – nicht primär im Bestandsgeschäft
  • Tiefes Verständnis der SAP Channel- und Co-Sell-Mechanismen: Partnerdeals, RISE/GROW-Pipeline, SAP-Partnerökosystem
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen auf Entscheiderebene
  • Souveränes Auftreten auf C-Level – verbindlich, präzise, auf Augenhöhe
  • Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit in einem frühen, sich entwickelnden Go-to-Market-Setup
  • Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch
Was dich zusätzlich auszeichnet:
  • Branchenwissen in Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie oder Zement/Baustoffe
  • Bestehendes Netzwerk in der SAP SCM- oder Logistik-IBU-Community
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von SAP-Add-ons oder SolEx-Produkten
  • Vertrautheit mit Supply-Chain-Execution-, TM- oder Bulk-Logistik-Prozessen
 
Was du bei uns findest
  • Eine strategisch bedeutsame Rolle mit direktem Einfluss auf das Unternehmenswachstum
  • Klare Ziele, volle Autonomie in der Ausführung – kein Mikromanagement
  • Ungedeckeltes Vergütungsmodell – dein Upside spiegelt deinen Beitrag
  • Direkter Zugang zum SAP-Ökosystem und enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Solution Architects
  • Ein Umfeld, das Seniorität respektiert und Eigenverantwortung erwartet
Du gestaltest – nicht nur mit. Du gestaltest, wie es wird.

 Implico ist kein fertig gebautes Konstrukt, das auf einen weiteren Vertriebsmitarbeiter wartet. Diese Rolle ist eine der ersten ihrer Art – du definierst mit, wie wir in den Prozessindustrien wahrgenommen werden, wie wir co-sellen, wie wir skalieren. Was du heute aufbaust, bleibt. Dein Fingerabdruck ist sichtbar – in der Kundenbasis, in der Marktpositionierung, in der Art, wie das Team in zwei Jahren arbeitet. Das ist kein Job. Das ist ein Gestaltungsauftrag.
 
Das Team – kein Versprechen, sondern eine Einladung.

 "Tolles Team" steht in jeder Stellenanzeige. Das überspringst du längst. Deshalb sagen wir es anders: Schau dir an, mit wem du zusammenarbeiten würdest.  Mark, Maurice, Anna, Thales, Selina und mehr. Menschen, die nicht wegen des Titels hier sind. Die morgens mit echtem Interesse an ihre Arbeit gehen. Die füreinander einspringen, ohne dass jemand fragen muss. Die über ihre Themen sprechen, als wären es ihre eigenen Projekte – weil sie es sind. Keine perfekte Hochglanz-Kultur. Aber eine, in der Leidenschaft und Haltung mehr zählen als Hierarchie.  Ob das zu dir passt? Das findest du nur heraus, wenn du das Gespräch suchst.
 
Der nächste Schritt

 Wenn du in den letzten Jahren bewiesen hast, dass du im SAP-Umfeld neue Märkte erschließt und Abschlüsse bringst dann freuen wir uns auf ein erstes, offenes Gespräch.  Kein langes Anschreiben. Zeig uns deinen Track Record – der Rest ergibt sich.

Maybe you've already mentored or technically guided colleagues, and you're looking to grow steadily into a Team Lead role as you take on more ownership and, over time, people responsibility.

The Technical ChallengeYou'll work on problems like extracting structured data reliably from many different documents, building uncertainty estimation so the system knows when to flag a document for human review instead of silently guessing, and automatically reconciling purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices against each other – all within legal and compliance requirements that leave no room for "close enough." This is a domain where clean benchmark metrics mean far less than robustness against real documents you've never seen before, and where every accuracy gain has a direct, visible impact on our customers' daily operations.


Your Mission

  • Lead MLOps processes and maintain infrastructure to keep our AI systems reliable, scalable, and secure
  • Design and implement advanced AI features, working closely with engineering and product teams to deploy machine learning models and data pipelines
  • Improve the accuracy, efficiency, and uncertainty estimation of existing AI features through rigorous testing
  • Contribute to the scalability, maintainability, and core functionality of our AI solutions – and help build new ones from scratch
  • Align your technical work with customer needs and support product and sales discussions
  • Help establish engineering standards, tooling, and quality practices
  • Mentor and technically guide colleagues as you build the track record to grow into a leadership role
  • Use modern AI tools such as Claude or Cursor as part of your daily workflow


Your Profile

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; alternatively, an equivalent education
  • 5+ years of experience in AI engineering, including end-to-end lifecycle management and MLOps
  • Hands-on expertise in natural language processing and image processing
  • Strong Python skills and experience with Azure; Terraform experience is a plus
  • A passion for generative AI, OCR, and building customer-focused solutions
  • A habit of writing clean, well-tested code with an eye on what happens after deployment
  • Solid understanding of AI agents, tools, and their limitations
  • Ideally, some experience mentoring or technically guiding others – and the ambition to grow into a Team Lead role
  • Fluent English and German (C1 or above)
  • Willingness to work from our Munich office at least two days a week


Your Benefits

  • Real ownership instead of micromanagement. You shape, you decide, and you see the impact of your work directly in the market.
  • Direct line to founders and leadership. Flat hierarchies are our everyday reality – short paths, fast decisions.
  • AI-First workflow. Copilot, Claude, Cursor & co. are standard tools for us. We expect and support their use.
  • Hybrid work with an office in the heart of Munich, just around the corner from Theresienwiese. Flexible setup with regular office presence – because we believe the best ideas happen in person.
  • EGYM Wellpass or BahnCard, corporate benefits, team events, annual offsites.
  • Fair, competitive compensation.

jobs.title: (Senior) Marketing Manager – Events & Partnerships (d/w/m*)
jobs.description:
Warum wir?

Bei pixx.io bist du Teil eines ambitionierten und unterstützenden Teams, das ein gemeinsames Ziel verfolgt: Unseren über 1.600 Kunden eine erstklassige SaaS-Lösung für Digital Asset Management (DAM) zu bieten und gleichzeitig neue Unternehmen von unserer Software zu begeistern. Gemeinsam machen wir digitales Arbeiten smarter und erfolgreicher – und du kannst einen wichtigen Beitrag dazu leisten.

Freue dich auf:

  • ein Marketing-Team, das Themen eigenverantwortlich vorantreibt und dich als zentrale Schnittstelle für Events und Partnerschaften willkommen heißt,
  • direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing-, Sales- und Partner-Verantwortlichen sowie sichtbaren Impact auf unsere GTM-Strategie,
  • moderne und nachhaltige Büros in Mühldorf (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mVc3LBJ8C9Q) und in München (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9hoq8-16O48), wobei du frei auswählen kannst, ob du an einem unserer Standorte (gerne auch hybrid) arbeitest – was wir bevorzugen würden – oder remote innerhalb Deutschlands,
  • echte gelebte Hybrid Kultur: 2 On-Sites pro Jahr in unserem Headquarter für Workshops & Teambuildings in Persona,
  • unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit (40 Std.) ab 01.01.2027,
  • 30 Urlaubstage + jeweils einen freien Tag am 24.12. und 31.12.,
  • marktgerechtes Gehalt je nach Skill- und Erfahrungslevel,
  • offene Fehler- und Feedbackkultur,
  • tolle Weiterbildungs- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten,
  • modernste Ausstattung, ergonomische Arbeitsplätze im Büro, Mitarbeitende werben Mitarbeitende-Programm, Zusammenhalt fördernde Events und spaßige Firmenfeiern, faire Regelungen zu Workations innerhalb der EU, vergünstigte Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, Corporate Benefits & Co.


Deine Aufgaben

Du behältst bei mehreren Projekten gleichzeitig den Überblick, denkst in Prozessen und liebst es, Events und Partnerschaften von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung zu bringen? Dann bist du hier genau richtig! Du als (Senior) Marketing Manager – Events & Partnerships (d/w/m*) verantwortest unsere Marketing Kanäle Events und Partnerships vollumfänglich – von der Strategie bis zur operativen Umsetzung.

Was dich erwartet:

  • Messe- & Event-Management: Du planst und steuerst unsere Auftritte auf Messen wie der DMEXCO und der K5 von Stand- und Eventkonzept über Budget, Bewerbung und Durchführung bis hin zur Nachbereitung inklusive Lead-Übergabe an den Vertrieb.
  • Online Events: Du planst und steuerst unsere Webinare, egal ob selbst gehostet oder durch Partner/Plattformen. Bei dir laufen alle Fäden zusammen von der Konzeption über Projektmanagement bis zur Erfolgskontrolle.
  • Partner-Marketing & Enablement: Du konzipierst und organisierst Formate wie Meet-ups oder einen virtuellen Partner-Day und baust unser Partner-Enablement kontinuierlich aus.
  • Schnittstellenfunktion: Du arbeitest als Teil des Marketings eng mit Sales, CSM und externen Partnern zusammen und stellst sicher, dass alle Projekte termingerecht, budgetkonform und mit klarem Erfolgsmaß umgesetzt werden.


Dein Profil

Bei uns zählt jede einzelne Person – dein Impact macht den Unterschied. Wir suchen eine Person, die unsere Kanäle 'Events' & 'Partnerships' nicht nur organisiert, sondern strategisch weiterentwickelt – mit Hands-on-Mentalität und einem Gespür für Priorisierung.

Idealerweise bringst du zudem folgende Qualifikationen mit:

  • Erfahrung im Marketing (Events, Partnerships): Du hast mindestens 4-5 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Marketing, am Besten mit Kampagnen- oder Eventmanagement Schwerpunkt, bevorzugt in der SaaS oder Tech-Branche.
  • Budget- & Ressourcenkontrolle: Du hast Erfahrung in der effizienten Steuerung von Event- und Marketing-Budgets und behältst Kosten sowie Ressourceneinsatz jederzeit im Blick.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick: Du verhandelst sicher mit Partnern, Dienstleistern und Sponsoring-Partnern und erzielst dabei für beide Seiten Deals mit Mehrwert.
  • Analytisches Mindset: Du misst und analysierst den Erfolg deiner Maßnahmen anhand klarer KPIs und triffst Entscheidungen datenbasiert statt aus dem Bauch heraus. Du hast immer einen Blick darauf, wo wir noch effizienter werden können und wo Potenziale für Skalierung liegen.
  • Organisationstalent mit Umsetzungsstärke: Du behältst bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick, setzt Prioritäten und lieferst zuverlässig termingerecht.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst Ownership für deine Projekte und triffst Entscheidungen eigenständig, ohne dabei den Blick fürs große Ganze zu verlieren.
  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist bereit, für Messen und Partner-Events gelegentlich zu reisen.
  • Deutsch (C1/C2) & Englisch (mind. B2): Du bewegst dich sicher in nationalen sowie internationalen Partnerbeziehungen.
