jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Data Engineer. Siinä on energiaa - Tule meille näyttämään kykysi ja rakentamaan puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää! Me Helenissä tarjoamme helpompaa ja mutkattomampaa arkea kaikkialla Suomessa. Lämmön, jäähdytyksen ja sähkön lisäksi tarjoamme ratkaisuja alueelliseen ja uusiutuvaan energiaan sekä sähköiseen liikenteeseen. Kehitämme fiksumpaa ja puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää, jonka avulla pidämme huolta, että asiakkaamme voivat tuottaa, käyttää ja säästää energiaa ympäristöä kunnioittaen. Vähennämme suunnitelmallisesti päästöjämme ja tavoitteemme on irtautua polttamiseen perustuvasta energiantuotannosta vuoteen 2040 mennessä. Etsimme nyt Data Engineeriä kehittämään joustavan kaukolämmön dataratkaisuja ja data-arkkitehtuuria osana Helenin Lämmön kysyntäjoustoratkaisut -tiimiä. Tehtävä on määräaikainen vanhempainvapaan sijaisuus, ja työsuhteen kesto on noin 8 kuukautta. Työsuhteen toivottu aloitusajankohta on viimeistään loka-marraskuussa 2026. Lämmön kysyntäjoustoratkaisut -tiimimme vastaa Optimilämpö-tuotteen jatkuvasta digitaalisesta kehityksestä ja varmistaa kaukolämpöverkon joustokyvyn osana Helenin kokonaisoptimointia. Tiimi ylläpitää tuotteen digiratkaisuja sekä kehittää uusia digitaalisia kyvykkyyksiä, lämmönjakokeskusten etähallintaan tarvittavia yhteysratkaisuja ja omaa jouston ohjausalgoritmia. Roolissasi Vastaat joustavan kaukolämmön data-arkkitehtuurin ja -infrastruktuurin kehittämisestä.Rakennat Databricks data-alustalle datatuotteita ja vastaat datan jalostamisesta dokumentoiduiksi tietoaineistoiksi.Vastaat dataintegraatioiden rakentamisesta, ylläpidosta ja kehittämisestä Helenin yhteisten data-alustakäytäntöjen mukaisesti.Kehität datan laadun ja dataputkien luotettavuuden monitorointia sekä siihen tarvittavia työkaluja.Odotamme sinulta Relevanttia työkokemusta moderneista data-alustoista, ensisijaisesti Databricksistä.Vahvaa SQL-osaamista sekä kokemusta Pythonin ja Sparkin käytöstä.Kokemusta datan mallinnuksesta, transformoinnista ja suurten datamäärien käsittelystä.Hyvää ymmärrystä ohjelmistokehityksen käytännöistä, kuten versionhallinnasta (Git), CI/CD:stä, testiautomaatiosta ja Infrastructure as Code (IaC) -periaatteista.Ymmärrystä skaalautuvien data- ja IoT-ratkaisujen rakentamisesta.Hyviä yhteistyö- sekä vuorovaikutustaitoja, avoimuutta ja rohkeutta. Tärkeää on halu oppia uutta, kaikkea ei tarvi osata ennalta.Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Arvostamme kykyä hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia, tehdä perusteltuja teknisiä ratkaisuja ja kehittää dataratkaisuja yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Tukea työssäsi saat niin ratkaisutiimiltäsi kuin koko Helenin datayhteisöltä. Tarjoamme sinulle Tässä tehtävässä pääset rakentamaan datakyvykkyyksiä, joilla on suora yhteys Helenin lämpöverkon joustavuuden kehittämiseen ja puhtaamman energiajärjestelmän rakentamiseen. Saat ympärillesi osaavan tiimin ja mahdollisuuden syventää osaamistasi niin teknologioiden kuin energiaratkaisujen parissa. Pääset nauttimaan myös erilaisista henkilöstöeduistamme, kuten henkilöstösähköstä, hyväntekeväisyystyöpäivästä, etätyömahdollisuudesta ulkomailla ja hyvinvointiedusta. Toimistomme sijaitsee Ruoholahden We Landissa, ja työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla. Tehtävän palkka määritellään tehtävän vaativuuden sekä osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Voit kysyä meillä työskentelystä tai tehtävästä tarkemmin tulevalta esihenkilöltäsi (Jouni Rantalankila / etunimi.sukunimi@helen.fi) sähköpostitse. Kiinnostuitko? Mahtavaa! Voit hakea rekryjärjestelmämme kautta viimeistään 30.9.2026. Huomioithan, että käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

jobs.title: Liiketoiminta-analyytikko
jobs.description: Me Helen Sähköverkossa varmistamme sujuvan arjen helsinkiläisille. Ylläpidämme ja kehitämme Helsingin sähköverkkoa tehokkaasti ja huolehdimme siitä, että kasvavan ja sähköistyvän kaupungin tarpeisiin voidaan vastata myös tulevaisuudessa Päästäksemme kunnianhimoisiin tavoitteisiimme ja varmistaaksemme laadukkaan sähköverkon kehittämisen, etsimme nyt joukkoomme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen analyyttista ja kehityshaluista liiketoiminta-analyytikkoa, jonka työn keskiössä ovat sähköverkon rakennetietojen raportointi, verkko-omaisuuden luokittelu sekä verkkotiedon laadun ja raportointiprosessien kehittäminen. Liiketoiminta-analyytikkona vastaat sähköverkon rakennetietojen käsittelystä, analysoinnista ja raportoinnista. Kehität verkko-omaisuuden luokittelua ja varmistat osaltasi, että verkkotietojärjestelmän tiedot muodostavat luotettavan perustan liiketoiminnan johtamiselle, investointien arvioinnille ja regulaatioraportoinnille. Keskeisiin tehtäviisi kuuluu sähköverkon rakennetietojen tuottaminen, analysointi ja raportointi sekä verkko-omaisuuden luokittelun kehittäminen ja ylläpito. Vastaat verkko-omaisuuden investointi- ja purkutietojen laadunvarmistuksesta sekä verkkotietojen oikeellisuuden, kattavuuden ja yhdenmukaisuuden seurannasta. Kehität raportointilogiikoita, tietomalleja ja automaattisia tarkistuksia sekä tunnistat tiedon laatuun liittyviä poikkeamia, selvität niiden syitä ja edistät korjaavien toimenpiteiden toteutusta. Työssäsi analysoit verkko-omaisuuden arvoa, määriä, ikätietoja ja luokituksia sekä kehität raportointi- ja analytiikkaratkaisuja hyödyntäen SQL:ää, Pythonia ja FME:tä. Lisäksi dokumentoit raportointiperiaatteita, määrittelyjä ja työohjeita sekä osallistut tiedonhallinnan ja raportointiprosessien jatkuvaan kehittämiseen. Roolissa yhdistyvät sähköverkkoliiketoiminnan ymmärtäminen, tiedonhallinta ja käytännön analytiikka. Pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten verkkotietoa tuotetaan, luokitellaan ja hyödynnetään koko verkko-omaisuuden elinkaaren aikana. Odotamme sinulta tehtävään soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa sekä analyyttista ja järjestelmällistä työskentelyotetta. Sinulla on kokemusta datan käsittelystä, raportoinnista tai tiedon laadunhallinnasta ja hallitset SQL:n. Lisäksi olet kiinnostunut kehittämään Python-osaamistasi. Pystyt hahmottamaan laajoja tietokokonaisuuksia ja niiden välisiä riippuvuuksia sekä tunnistamaan tietoaineistojen virheitä ja poikkeamia. Työskentelet oma-aloitteisesti, viet tunnistamiasi kehitystarpeita käytännön ratkaisuiksi ja toimit sujuvasti yhteistyössä erilaisten sidosryhmien kanssa. Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen sähköverkoista, energia-alasta tai teknisen omaisuuden hallinnasta sekä Trimble NIS -verkkotietojärjestelmän tuntemuksen. Arvostamme osaamista Azure Databricks-, Power BI-, Python- tai paikkatietoratkaisuista sekä kokemusta viranomais- tai muusta sääntelyyn perustuvasta raportoinnista. Lisäksi tehtävässä hyödyt ymmärryksestä tietomalleista, datan laadunhallinnasta ja raportoinnin automatisoinnista sekä kokemuksesta prosessien, ohjeistusten tai tiedon omistajuuksien kehittämisestä. Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen tehtävän Helsingin sähköverkon ja yhteiskunnan kriittisen infrastruktuurin kehittämisen parissa. Pääset työskentelemään laajojen ja liiketoiminnan kannalta keskeisten tietoaineistojen kanssa sekä rakentamaan toimintatapoja, joilla parannetaan sähköverkko-omaisuuden hyödynnettävyyttä pitkäjänteisesti. Työskentelet osana strategisen omaisuudenhallinnan ja regulaation kokonaisuutta tiiviissä yhteistyössä verkon kehityksen, omaisuudenhallinnan, talouden ja analytiikan asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Saat tueksesi kokeneen asiantuntijaverkoston ja mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi sähköverkkoliiketoiminnan, regulaation ja modernin data-analytiikan rajapinnassa. Uskomme yhteistyöhön, jatkuvaan kehittymiseen ja rohkeuteen uudistaa toimintatapoja, ja tarjoamme ympäristön, jossa voit aidosti vaikuttaa ja jättää oman kädenjälkesi tulevaisuuden sähköverkkoon. Meillä pääset tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitys: rakennamme yhdessä sujuvampaa arkea ja parempaa kaupunkia tuleville sukupolville. Jäikö jokin vielä mietityttämään? Voit kysyä tehtävästä ja meillä työskentelystä tarkemmin tulevalta esihenkilöltäsi Teemu Nurmi, verkon kehityspäällikkö (puh. 050 573 7443). Kohtasivatko energiamme? Mahtavaa! Voit helposti laittaa hakemuksen rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta su 20.9.2026 mennessä. Huomioithan, että käsittelemme hakemuksia ja etenemme rekrytoinnissa sopivan henkilön kohdalla jo hakuaikana, joten toimithan siis nopeasti. Yhdistetään voimat!

jobs.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

 

Annual gross salary range (package): €55,000 – €65,000
This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 3+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week. 

Annual gross salary range (package): €55,000 – €65,000
This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

 

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

 

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 3+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

 

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We're at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, the context-engineering layer for AI-driven software delivery used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration and efficiency, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, Bazel, npm, and Python, with support for additional build tools coming soon.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. We're investing deeply in making Develocity's unique data and decades of domain expertise accessible to both humans and AI agents, with trust, evidence, and explainability at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as DuckDuckGo, Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding; we strive to understand diverse viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals. 

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration. 

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With a deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative, bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative, and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We are looking for a hardworking, driven Account Executive to join our high-performing team. In this role, you will be the face of Develocity for enterprise prospects and customers in the New York and East Coast US region, focusing on driving revenue growth and new business acquisition.

You'll act as a primary point of contact for our enterprise accounts in your territory. Your goal will be to guide these organizations on their journey with Develocity to unlock comprehensive data throughout the build process, empowering you to detect the unknown unknowns so you can ship faster, reduce risk, and lower costs, all while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance. You will be responsible for formulating and executing a sales strategy to grow your territory and acquire new customers.

Responsibilities

As an Account Executive, you will manage the entire sales cycle, from lead to close, to expand Develocity adoption. Your main focus will be to consistently achieve or exceed quotas and drive pipeline growth.

You will do this by:

  • Developing and executing strategic account plans to target new logos not already covered by other teams.
  • Building a robust pipeline and preparing accurate forecasts for large-scale, multi-year deals.
  • Cultivating strong customer relationships and consistently engaging with key engineering and C-level executives.
  • Leading the full sales cycle, from initial outreach to close.
  • Clearly articulating the value of Develocity and providing customer feedback to enhance our product.
  • Mastering sales techniques like MEDPICC and Command of the Message to execute deals effectively.
  • Attending industry events and Develocity-hosted sessions to strengthen relationships and generate new business.
  • Analyzing wins and losses and sharing insights with internal teams to improve our approach.
  • Documenting best practices in our sales playbook to contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Being willing to travel to meet customers in person.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of direct sales experience selling enterprise software to executives in large, complex organizations.
  • A proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quotas.
  • Experience in the DevOps, Observability, or CI/CD space.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present to C-level executives.
  • Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and/or consultative sales techniques. Knowledge of MEDDPICC is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the following sales tools: Salesforce, SalesLoft, ZoomInfo, and Gong.
  • AI-first mindset to help with automating everyday tasks. 

What We Offer

  • Ability to work in a remote-first environment with flexible working hours.
  • Work on a fast-growing product with a clear vision for the future.
  • Close collaboration with an ambitious and experienced team and the opportunity to learn from them regardless of your experience level.
  • Opportunities for growth in your career and in leadership responsibilities.
  • In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite team meetings, and onboardings.
  • Contribute to leading solutions in the new industry of Developer Productivity Engineering and work with cutting-edge DPE tools and practices.
  • Competitive salaries and equity grants.

Location

Remote from Europe.

While our team works remotely and is spread across the globe, we deeply value daily interactions and collaboration.

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer (AI Lab)
jobs.description:
About Agicap


Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !


Agicap est en train de devenir une AI-first company. Nous formons l'ensemble de nos employés à travailler avec l'IA et à automatiser eux-mêmes une partie de leurs tâches. Certains projets sont trop longs, trop transverses ou trop techniques pour être portés par une équipe métier seule.

C'est le rôle de l'AI Lab.

C'est l'équipe pivot qui construit les outils internes qui changent la façon dont Agicap travaille au quotidien. Notre boussole : impact opérationnel rapide, itérations courtes, travail à 360° avec toutes les équipes (Sales, CS, Finance, Produit, Marketing, Data, C-level).

C'est une création de poste : l'accélération de l'IA change nos process et notre manière de bosser. On a besoin d'un renfort senior pour accompagner cette transition et l'inscrire dans des pratiques qui tiennent sur le long terme.

L'équipe que tu vas rejoindre : 
  • 3 personnes, toi inclus : un ingénieur IA junior, un Tech Lead à mi-temps (qui sera ton manager), un Product Manager.
  • Ton rôle : apporter le recul technique qui manque aujourd'hui dans l'équipe (infra, architecture, maintenabilité, scalabilité) — construire vite, mais sans creuser de dette pour demain.
  • Tu es en interaction directe avec toutes les équipes métier d'Agicap : c'est un poste très transverse, très exposé.

⚡️ Responsabilités :

Tu alternes entre cadrage rapide, build et itération :

  • Comprendre le besoin d'une équipe métier en direct, cadrer ce qui a réellement de l'impact vs. ce qui est du confort, prioriser.
  • Construire les outils internes de bout en bout : cadrage → dev → mise en prod → itération avec les utilisateurs.
  • Faire évoluer la plateforme IA commune : serveurs MCP, intégrations, outillage transverse mis à disposition de toute l'entreprise.
  • Prendre les décisions techniques qui structurent le Lab : infra, choix de stack, architecture. Il n'y a pas d'existant lourd auquel te conformer, tu construis pour scaler.
  • Élever le niveau technique de l'équipe : mentoring de l'IA Engineer junior, transmission des bonnes pratiques, revue de code utile.
  • Identifier proactivement les process où l'IA apporte un vrai gain — et construire la solution.

    • Exemples de chantiers sur tes 6 premiers mois :

    • Feedback loop produit : construire un système qui digère l'ensemble des logs de feedback client (calls, RFP, remontées CS) et produit des recommandations priorisées pour les Product Managers. Aujourd'hui la donnée existe mais on ne la digère pas.
    • Chantier infra MCP : mettre à disposition des collaborateurs Agicap des serveurs MCP connectés à leurs outils du quotidien, à l'échelle.

⚡️Comment on travaille :
  • Autonomie totale : équipe de 3, tu décides, tu assumes tes choix.
  • Ship rate élevé : on livre quotidiennement, on mesure, on itère. Pas de sprints à la papa.
  • Full remote ou hybride Lyon/Paris, comme tu préfères. Venues à Lyon possibles (~1 fois toutes les 6 semaines) mais jamais obligatoires.
  • IA au quotidien dans le delivery : on utilise Claude, OpenAI, Mistral au quotidien pour construire — on n'observe pas la vague IA, on est dedans.
  • Anglais requis : beaucoup de collaborateurs sont anglophones. Ton binôme est francophone.

    • 👀 Le profil recherché:

    On vise un profil senior avec expérience de Tech Lead — quelqu'un qui a déjà pris des décisions impactantes, poussé des sujets techniques exigeants, et exploré activement le terrain IA :

    • ~4-5 ans d'expérience minimum en dev, sur des projets réellement mis en production.
    • Expérience de Tech Lead ou équivalent : tu as déjà driver des décisions d'architecture et d'infra, tu sais arbitrer entre vélocité et dette.
    • Pratique concrète et récente des LLMs : tu as essayé des choses, poussé des expérimentations, testé Claude / OpenAI / Mistral. Tu es moteur sur ces sujets, pas suiveur.
    • Python et TypeScript dans ta boîte à outils. Le langage compte moins que ta capacité à choisir le bon outil pour le bon problème.
    • Bases techniques solides : tu maîtrises et comprends ce que tu livres.
    • Capacité à livrer vite et à prioriser ce qui a réellement de l'impact — mode Doer, pas mode powerpoint.
    • Proactivité et curiosité : tu identifies des opportunités que personne n'a formulées, tu vas chercher.
    • Anglais professionnel courant.
    • Autonomie assumée : dans une équipe de 3, tu ne peux pas te cacher. 

    ⭐ Stack et outillage
  • LLMs : Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI, Mistral — l'équipe n'est pas mono-provider, tu choisis le bon modèle pour le bon usage.
  • Langages : majoritairement Python et TypeScript.
  • Infra : à toi de la construire, avec un vrai droit de décision — pas d'existant lourd.
  • Outillage IA en interne : serveurs MCP, plateforme IA commune, agents connectés aux outils métier.
  • Cycle : Continuous Delivery, mise en prod quotidienne, feedback utilisateur direct.

    • 🎁 Ce qu'on offre
    • Un poste à impact direct et visible dans une AI-first company de 600 personnes.
    • Un cadre ultra-responsabilisant : autonomie, ownership, décisions techniques à ton niveau.
    • Rémunération : 55K€ - 70K€ selon expertise + prime vacances SYNTEC.
    • CDI, forfait en heures, 39h dont 4h supplémentaires payées.
    • 25 jours de congés payés + 10 jours de congés flexibles (utilisables dès l'arrivée).
    • Full remote ou hybride (Lyon/Paris), venues à Lyon non obligatoires.
    • Mutuelle Alan (extension famille possible), titres restaurant Swile (11€/jour dont 6,50€ pris en charge).
    • Avantages CSE : carte KDO annuelle, Gymlib/EGYM wellpass, etc.
    • Démarrage ASAP.

    ⏳ Process de recrutement :
    1. Screening avec l'équipe Talent Acquisition — présentation du poste et validation du fit (30-45 min).
    2. Deux entretiens techniques avec l'équipe AI Lab (formats et sujets communiqués en amont).

    Feedback sous 24-48h à chaque étape. Process rapide, transparent.

    Agicap s'engage à garantir l'égalité des chances pour tous et favorise un environnement de travail inclusif qui valorise la diversité !

Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:

Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐

Staff Engineers are technical leaders who innovate to build solutions that will support the company's growth.
 
This is achieved through individual contributions, applying technical skills to deliver products that will revolutionise the world of freelancing. 
 
Additionally, you provide technical leadership by addressing organization-wide design and architectural challenges and guiding their implementation.
 
Finally, you play an active role in the lead engineering group, contributing to the definition and enhancement of company-wide software and systems engineering standards.

  • Impactful: You demonstrate excellent ownership and problem-solving skills, with a high degree of agency in driving solutions.

  • Interview with your future manager, Jean (VP engineering), to delve into your experience and the specifics of the role. (60 minutes)

jobs.title: Teamleader tankstation
jobs.description:
Als Teamleader ben jij het aanspreekpunt voor jouw team en zorg je voor een vlotte dagelijkse werking. Je stuurt medewerkers aan, bewaakt processen en zorgt ervoor dat alle activiteiten veilig, efficiënt en volgens de kwaliteitsnormen verlopen. Je bent de rechterhand van de stationsmanager en je zorgt samen met het team dat alles vlot verloopt. 

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je ondersteunt de stationsmanager in de dagelijkse werking
  • Je stuurt collega's aan en begeleidt nieuwe medewerkers tijdens hun opleiding
  • Je stelt de personeelsplanning op en voert evaluatiegesprekken
  • Je beheert bestellingen, facturen en administratieve opvolging
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de shop en/of het restaurant steeds vlot en efficiënt draaien
  • Geen enkele dag is dezelfde: je krijgt een gevarieerd takenpakket met veel verantwoordelijkheid én ruimte om initiatief te nemen
  • Je hebt reeds ervaring in de retailsector.
  • Je hebt ervaring in het aansturen van een team.
  • Een flexibel uurrooster, weekendwerk of werken op feestdagen is voor jou geen probleem.
  • Eigen vervoer is belangrijk om tot aan het station te geraken.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd!

jobs.title: Assistent winkelverantwoordelijke | Telecom
jobs.description:
Functie

Voor onze klant een Telecomwinkel te Sint Denijs Westrem zijn we dringend op zoek naar een assistent winkelverantwoordelijke!

Jouw uitdagende takenpakket als assistent winkelverantwoordelijke:

  • Als assistent winkelverantwoordelijke ben je de rechterhand van de shopmanager, bij afwezigheid zorg jij voor de taakverdeling en bijhorende praktische zaken van de winkel.
  • Je zorgt er mee voor dat de winkel er piekfijn uitziet, je brengt mee je collega's op de hoogte van de meest recente promoties en acties van telecom providers en computer merken. Samen met de Shopmanager ben je de drijvende kracht voor de commerciële en financiële resultaten. 
  • Je helpt klanten verder in de winkel en staat hen bij.
  • Je zal een aantal administratieve taken doen, maar verder sta je net als je teamleden verder mee in de verkoop.
  • Je brengt je collega's mee op de hoogte van de recentste promoties en acties van telecom en computer merken.
Profiel

Onze nieuwe assistent winkelverantwoordelijke kan dit afvinken:

  • Je hebt ervaring in de verkoop, en dit bijvoorkeur ook in een leidinggevende functie.
  • Een goede kennis van de hedendaagse computer en telecom diensten.
  • Commercieel met oog voor een langdurige klantrelatie.
  • Je communiceert heel vlot in het Nederlands, zowel gesproken als geschreven
  • Bereid om op zaterdag te werken met een recupdag in de week (geen zon- of feestdagen).
  • IT, telecom, energie,.. dit interesseert je!
  • Je bent handson ingesteld en neemt graag initiatief.
  • Oog voor orde en netheid binnen de winkel.
  • Jouw enthousiasme is aanstekelijk en zorgt voor een lach op het gezicht van jouw collega's en klanten.
Wat je van ons krijgt

Wat kan jij als nieuwe assistent winkelverantwoordelijke van ons verwachten?

  • Regelmatige interne en externe (sales) opleidingen en constante salesondersteuning - opleiding on the job gegarandeerd! ??
  • Een heel leuke teamsfeer die aangemoedigd wordt door leuke teamevents & activiteiten. ??

Als teamleader ben je de rechterhand van de stationmanager en zorg je er samen met het team voor dat alles vlot verloopt. Afhankelijk van de grootte van het station neem je verantwoordelijkheid op binnen de shop, het restaurant, de administratie of een combinatie van deze domeinen.

jobs.title: HVAC-monteur
jobs.description:
Onze klant gelegen in Sint-Truiden is gespecialiseerd in HVAC-montage en technieken. Ze zijn niet een doorsnee chauffagist, maar staan voor duurzaamheid en innovatie. 's Morgens komen de monteurs samen in Sint-Truiden en vertrekken ze naar de verschillende werven, de techniekers vertrekken rechtstreeks van thuis met een camionette.
De werven zijn gelegen in Limburg, Vlaams-Brabant en Antwerpen. Ze werken zowel bij particuliere als op grote projecten. Als de werf of moet bundelen ze de krachten, maar kan het zijn dat je een overuur maakt. Over het algemeen is dit niet veel en werk je 8 uur per dag op de werf. Het bedrijf geeft graag kansen aan mensen zo zijn er dus ook doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen het bedrijf. Je komt hier terecht in een bedrijf met aangename sfeer.


Jobomschrijving

Voor de job als HVAC-monteur voor de regio van Sint-Truiden ben je verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Installeren van verwarming, sanitair en ventilatie
  • Gecombineerd met volgende technieken: zonneboilers, airco's, warmtepompen & zonneboilers (in mindere mate)
  • Focus op Samsung & Vaillant toestellen
  • Werven voor projectbouw (meerdere woningen of appartementen) of winkelbouw (provider winkels, zowel nieuwbouw als renovatie)

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Voor de job als HVAC-monteur voor de regio van Sint-Truiden is het ideale profiel:

  • Je bent bereid te werken op werven over gans België
  • Kan werken zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband
  • Toont verantwoordelijkheidszin naar de eindklant
  • Komt terecht in een groeiende onderneming met een jong doch ervaren team
  • Hebt interesse in de wereld van de HVAC en diens continu evoluerende technieken

jobs.title: Senior Innovation Consultant - EU Projects
jobs.description:
Job summary (Short promotional text)

We are looking for a Senior Consultant to strengthen our European Grants team in France.

You will advise innovative companies and organisations on European funding strategies and lead the development of complex grant applications for major R&D, industrial and innovation projects.

The role combines strategic consulting, project analysis, proposal writing and client management. We are looking for someone who can independently transform complex projects into compelling funding strategies and high quality European proposals.


Your mission (What are you going to do in text) summarised down below

Help ambitious organisations secure European funding for high impact innovation projects by combining strategic advice, technical understanding and excellent proposal development.


Your tasks 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead the development of complex European funding applications under programmes such as Horizon Europe, Innovation Fund, LIFE and CEF.
  • Assess R&D and innovation projects, identify the most appropriate funding opportunities and advise clients on funding strategy.
  • Structure compelling project narratives covering excellence, innovation, impact, implementation and European added value.
  • Interview senior client stakeholders, scientists, engineers and technical experts to extract and challenge the information required for successful proposals.


Your tasks 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Coordinate the complete proposal development process, including work plans, consortium inputs, budgets, deadlines and quality reviews.
  • Manage client relationships independently and act as a trusted advisor throughout the funding process.
  • Review and improve proposals prepared by other consultants and contribute to internal quality standards and methodologies.
  • Support the development of junior consultants and contribute to business development and the growth of PNO Innovation’s European Grants activities in France.


Your profile 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Master’s degree or PhD in a scientific, engineering, technical, economic or innovation related discipline.
  • Several years of relevant experience in European funding, innovation consulting, R&D project development or a closely related environment.
  • Proven experience with European funding programmes, ideally including Horizon Europe and/or other major programmes such as Innovation Fund, LIFE or CEF. Demonstrated experience writing or leading high quality grant proposals.
  • Excellent written and spoken French and English.


Your Profile 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Strong ability to understand complex scientific, technological and business concepts and turn them into persuasive narratives.
  • Strong client management, communication and project management skills.
  • Autonomous, rigorous and comfortable managing complex assignments under demanding deadlines.
  • Ability to mentor less experienced consultants and contribute to the development of the team.


Why us? (What do we offer) 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead major European funding projects with innovative companies and organisations.
  • Work across technologies, sectors and European programmes rather than being limited to a single funding instrument.
  • Join one of Europe’s largest specialist innovation and funding consultancies.
  • Work with an international network of more than 600 colleagues and European funding specialists.


Why us? (What do we offer) 2nd part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Take ownership of client relationships and complex strategic assignments.
  • Contribute to developing junior consultants and strengthening our European Grants practice in France.
  • Benefit from clear opportunities for professional development and increasing responsibility.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package according to experience and seniority.

jobs.title: Ingénieur Logiciel Senior (PHP Symfony)
jobs.description:
Prêt(e) à rejoindre la révolution Legal Tech ?
 
Vision: Editeur de logiciels SaaS de premier plan, DiliTrust est une entreprise globale spécialisée dans les solutions juridiques et de gouvernance. Notre ambition est d’accompagner nos clients dans la digitalisation rapide de leurs départements juridiques. Avec une croissance annuel de plus de 25 % depuis 2020, nous visons à devenir l’un des leaders mondiaux de la Legal Tech, avec une valorisation dépassant 1 milliard de dollars d’ici à 2027.
 
Impact : De la génération de rapports pour les Assemblées Générales à la gestion du cycle de vie des contrats assistée par l'IA, nos équipes réparties dans 8 bureaux à travers le monde (France, les États-Unis, le Mexique, la région MEA, l'Allemagne, l'Espagne, l'Italie et le Canada) sont le moteur de notre succès mondial. Aujourd’hui, nous accompagnons +2 400 clients dans 64 pays, dont 80 % sont des d’entreprises cotées sur les principaux marchés européens, américains et du Moyen-Orient.
 
Reconnaissance: DiliTrust est un pionnier de l’innovation LegalTech, étant la première entreprise du secteur à avoir intégré des fonctionnalités IA dès 2022. Nous sommes également reconnus pour offrir un environnement de travail dynamique et entrepreneurial à nos équipes, certifié chaque année depuis 2019 par les labels "Happy at Work" et "Tech at Work".
 
 

Vos missions :
En tant qu’Ingénieur Logiciel Senior, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la conception, le développement et l’évolution de nos solutions. Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble de la stack pour créer des fonctionnalités robustes et évolutives au service des professionnels du droit dans le monde entier.
 
Responsabilités:
  • Concevoir, développer, tester et maintenir les fonctionnalités de notre plateforme
  • Collaborer avec les chefs de produit, les designers et les autres ingénieurs pour proposer des solutions centrées sur l’utilisateur
  • Participer aux revues de code et accompagner les développeurs juniors
  • Contribuer aux discussions d’architecture et participer aux décisions techniques
  • Garantir une haute qualité de code et des performances optimales grâce aux tests, à la surveillance et à l’optimisation
  • Participer à la définition et au maintien des bonnes pratiques en ingénierie et en DevOps
  • Se tenir informé des tendances et des outils du secteur, et évaluer les nouvelles technologies pour améliorer la plateforme

    • Notre stack technique :
  • Backend : PHP (Symfony)
  • Frontend : Vue.js 3
  • Base de données : PostgreSQL, MariaDB
  • DevOps : Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  • Cloud : GCP

    • Profil recherché :
  • Solide expérience (10+ ans) en développement logiciel sur des architectures web complexes
  • Expérience SaaS / avec une notion de Product Engineering

  • Excellente maîtrise du backend PHP, idéalement avec le framework Symfony
  • Très bonne connaissance des bases de données (PostgreSQL, MariaDB) et capacité à optimiser les performances SQL
  • Expérience avec les environnements Docker, Kubernetes et les pratiques DevOps modernes

  • Rigueur, sens du détail et exigence sur la qualité du code
  • Esprit d’équipe, communication claire et capacité à collaborer avec des profils variés (produit, design, ingénierie…)
  • Curiosité technologique, veille active et envie d’expérimenter de nouvelles approches

    • Ce que nous offrons :
  • Rejoignez une entreprise en forte croissance dans un environnement international et convivial (bureaux en France, Italie, Espagne, Canada, Allemagne, États-Unis, Mexique, Dubaï...) ;
  • Notre politique de télétravail garantit un équilibre optimal entre présence sur site et travail à distance ;
  • Sans oublier tous les avantages du quotidien : CSE, tickets restaurant, prime de participation, séances de sport hebdomadaires organisées par TrainMe, etc.

    • Process de recrutement :
  • Entretien avec un membre de l'équipe TA (30/45 mins)
  • Entretien avec notre Engineering Manager (1h)
  • Entretien technique (1h)
  • Entretien avec notre CTO (45 mins)

jobs.title: Montør av Plasthaller. Installation Worker for Fabric Halls and Steel Construction
jobs.description:
We are a company working with the assembly, disassembly and maintenance of fabric halls (PVC halls) and warehouse halls of all sizes and for various purposes throughout Norway, and occasionally abroad. We are now looking for additional employees to join our installation team.

Hva vi ser etter

We are looking for motivated and hardworking people who are not afraid to take responsibility and get the job done.

You enjoy physical work and working at height, and you are comfortable using lifts and working on construction sites.

You like travelling and working at different locations around Norway.

You can work independently, while also working well as part of a team.

You are reliable, engaged and take pride in your work.

You enjoy challenges and want to learn and develop in a professional working environment.

Experience with steel construction assembly and/or installation of fabric halls (PVC halls) is a strong advantage.

You must be able to understand and communicate safety instructions in English .

Norwegian language skills are a strong advantage.

A valid driving licence (class B) is required.

Lift and forklift certificates are an advantage, but not required -- training can be provided.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Assembly and disassembly of fabric halls (PVC halls) in various sizes and types.

This includes installation of steel structures and PVC fabric as cladding.

A lot of the work is performed at height using lifts, so fear of heights is not suitable for this job.

Steel structures are assembled on the ground, lifted into position using a crane, and completed before the fabric is installed.

The work also includes a significant amount of manual tasks such as measuring and anchoring base plates, assembling small and large steel components, and tensioning the fabric.

Extensive travel is required, as we carry out assignments ranging from one-day repair jobs to large projects lasting several weeks, all across Norway.

Vi tilbyr

We offer full training and exciting challenges in a growing company.

All necessary courses and certifications are provided, so you will be properly trained for the job.

We offer competitive salary and good working conditions.

You will have an independent and varied job with freedom under responsibility and the opportunity to develop your skills.

The position involves extensive travel, allowing you to experience many different locations, work at varied sites, and meet new people all the time.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are a well-established and growing company specialising in all aspects of fabric halls, including assembly, disassembly, relocation and maintenance of fabric halls and warehouse halls of all sizes and applications.

With our office and warehouse in Krøderen, we deliver projects across Norway and occasionally abroad, offering varied workdays and exciting challenges.

We work with both small and large clients within industries such as industry, agriculture, transport and logistics.

Today, our team consists of 18 skilled installation workers and 10 fully equipped service vehicles, providing the right tools and support to deliver high-quality work.

Founded in 2005, we have nearly 20 years of experience and are a stable employer with strong expertise in our field.

Our vision is to build high-quality solutions and create a great workplace for everyone, while striving to be the best in our industry through quality, safety and teamwork.

jobs.description:
Turn Precision Measurements into High-End Stone Countertops

Hva vi ser etter

What we're looking for

  • Experience with CAD or technical drawing (specific software experience is not required -- we provide training on our systems)

  • A background in stone, kitchen, or similar production is an advantage

  • High attention to detail and precision

  • Fluent in English and/or Norwegian

  • Comfortable working closely with both production and installation teams

Arbeidsoppgaver

Technical Drafter / CAD Technician -- Stone Countertop Production (Sandefjord, Norway)

Scan Granitt AS is Norway's leading manufacturer of stone countertops, supplying major kitchen brands such as Sigdal, HTH, Strai Kjøkken, Designa, and Byggmakker. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Technical Drafter to join our production team at our factory in Sandefjord.

In this role, you'll take field measurements from our installation teams and turn them into precise, production-ready drawings -- including complex, high-end custom projects. You'll work closely with our production department (using Breton CNC machinery and software) as well as with the installers who perform the on-site measurements, and with our sales team.

What you'll do

  • Convert control measurements from installers into accurate CAD drawings for production

  • Verify joints, edges, and cutouts against customer specifications before production

  • Prepare drawings and cutting layouts for complex, high-end stone projects

  • Work closely with production, using Breton-supplied CAD/CAM software and CNC equipment

  • Coordinate with installers and sales to resolve discrepancies before manufacturing begins



Vi tilbyr

What we offer

  • Fixed position

  • Office- and factory-based role in Sandefjord

  • Training on our systems and machinery

  • The opportunity to work on complex, high-end projects

  • A stable, growing company with professional and dedicated team

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Scan Granitt AS is Norway's leading manufacturer of stone countertops, with kitchen brands such as Sigdal, HTH, Strai Kjøkken, Designa, Svane Kjøkkenet, and Byggmakker among our customers. We have a factory in Sandefjord and installation departments in several locations across the country.

Since our founding in 1998, we have grown to become the largest player in our segment in Norway. Today we are 48 employees -- 15 in administration and 33 in production/installation -- with an average age of around 40.

Scan Granitt maintains a very strong focus on service and precision, which is reflected throughout the organization and in everything we deliver to our customers. We always aim to deliver our products at the highest level, so that we can rely on returning customers and a strong reputation.

Du blir en del av et kompetent fagmiljø med gode utviklingsmuligheter og varierte arbeidsoppgaver på tvers av avdelinger og med ulike systemer. Våre produkter og systemer skal fungere i alle miljøer og til enhver tid -- og i ytterste konsekvens bidra til å redde liv. På denne måten skaper vi verdier for både kunder og samfunnet.

  • Konfigurere, programmere og teste kundespesifiserte systemer

  • Feilsøking og kvalitetssikring før leveranse

  • Gjennomføre akseptansetest (FAT) før leveranse og sammen med kunde

  • Dokumentasjon av testresultater og leveranser

  • Verifisere tekniske data og dokumentasjon

  • Kundestøtte og fjernservice

For deg som ønsker det, finnes det også muligheter for reisevirksomhet i forbindelse med verifikasjon, oppstart og service på installasjoner hos kunder.

Vi utvikler og holder kurs internt og eksternt for kunder i våre systemer, og hvis du har erfaring som kursholder, eller synes det høres spennende ut, vil du etter hvert også få mulighet til det. Arbeidsoppgavene utvides i takt med økende kompetanse.

Vi har engelsk som arbeidsspråk, og for å lykkes i denne stillingen må du beherske norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er engasjert og lærevillig, og som har evne til å håndtere komplekse oppgaver

  • Evner å sette deg inn i kundens behov og finner gode løsninger

  • Er lett å samarbeide med og har gode kommunikasjonsegenskaper

  • Jobber strukturert og systematisk, har pågangsmot og god gjennomføringsevne

Vi tilbyr:

  • Jobb med spennende teknologi og utfordrende oppgaver i et inkluderende og faglig sterkt team

  • God opplæring og fokus på utvikling og kompetansebygging

  • Gode forsikringsordninger, inkludert psykologisk førstehjelp og digital legehjelp, som gir trygghet og støtte når du trenger det

  • Konkurransedyktig pensjonssparing, med innskudd som ligger over bransjegjennomsnittet og bidrar til økonomisk trygghet i fremtiden

  • Et årlige trim- og helsebudsjett som fremmer god helse og trivsel for våre medarbeidere

  • Firmahytte på Norefjell, en helårsdestinasjon som kombinerer flotte skiopplevelser om vinteren med sykling, vandring og rekreasjon i fjellet om sommeren og høsten

Hos Zenitel blir du en del av et kompetent og engasjert teknisk team, i et arbeidsmiljø kjennetegnet av profesjonalitet, åpenhet og lidenskap. Våre løsninger bidrar til sikker kommunikasjon i kritiske situasjoner og skaper verdi for kunder over hele verden.

Bli med oss på laget!

Zenitel ønsker å gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet, og oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater med ulik utdanning, arbeids- og livserfaring til å søke jobb hos oss uten hensyn til etnisitet, religion, kjønn, alder, seksuell orientering og funksjonsevne.

Vi gjennomfører bakgrunnssjekk av relevante kandidater gjennom Semac AS.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Zenitel is a major global player in the development and marketing of intelligent communication solutions where security, guaranteed availability and sound quality are essential. With nearly 120 years of experience, Zenitel has proven to be a reliable and quality provider of telecommunication solution for the Maritime and Energy segments. This includes PAGA systems, PABX / Intercom systems, CCTV systems, two-way radio intercom solutions and more. These systems are installed on more the 30.000 marine vessels across the world to provide secure operation of the vessel, as well as safety for workers and passengers on board. In addition, we have offshore- and onshore energy installations including offshore wind, which are securely and efficient operated with support by Zenitel audio communication equipment guiding operations in rough environments.

jobs.title: Er du vår nye daglige leder på Laberget Leirsted
jobs.description:
Er du vår nye daglige leder på Laberget leirsted? Om Laberget leirsted Laberget leirsted ligger vakkert til ved Trondheimsfjorden i Levanger kommune. Gjennom mer enn 50 år har leirstedet vært en viktig møteplass for barn, ungdom og voksne. Her arrangeres leirer, kurs, konferanser og samlinger der fellesskap, gjestfrihet og kristen tro står sentralt. Laberget er et leirsted der frivillighet, gjestfrihet og samarbeid står sterkt, og hvor mange har et nært forhold til stedet gjennom generasjoner. Vi ønsker å være en trygg og inkluderende møteplass der mennesker opplever fellesskap, omsorg og gode rammer for tro og liv

Hva vi ser etter

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, eller ønsker å besøke Laberget før du

søker, er du hjertelig velkommen til å ta kontakt med daglig leder

John Arne Jenssen på tlf. 410 45 274 eller styreleder Bent Ove på telefon 92426057

Arbeidsoppgaver

Om stillingen

Laberget står foran en spennende tid, og vi søker en daglig leder som vil være med på å videreutvikle og styrke arbeidet vårt.

Vår nåværende daglige leder går inn i en ny stilling, og vi ser etter en engasjert etterfølger som ønsker å sette sitt preg på videre satsing og vekst.

Vi søker deg som både kan samle mennesker og drive prosesser fremover.

Du er en relasjonsbygger som skaper engasjement, bygger tillit og omsetter idéer til handling.

Som daglig leder får du det overordnede ansvaret for den daglige driften og videreutviklingen av Laberget. Du vil lede en virksomhet med stor betydning for mange mennesker og bidra til å utvikle en viktig møteplass for kommende generasjoner.

Sentrale arbeidsoppgaver

Overordnet ansvar for den daglige driften av leirstedet, inkludert administrasjon, booking og økonomistyring.

Personalansvar for fast ansatte, sesongarbeidere og frivillige medarbeidere.

Lede og utvikle virksomheten i samarbeid med styret.

Bidra til et godt vertskap og skape en varm og inkluderende atmosfære for gjester og brukere.

Bygge og videreutvikle samarbeid med menigheter, organisasjoner, skoler og andre samarbeidspartnere.

Ansvar for HMS, internkontroll og rapportering til styret.

Bidra til å utvikle Laberget som et attraktivt leirsted og en bærekraftig virksomhet.

Kvalifikasjoner og personlige egenskaper

Vi søker en leder som:

· bekjenner den kristne tro og ønsker å bidra aktivt til å virkeliggjøre Labergets kristne formål og verdigrunnlag

· har ledererfaring, gjerne fra administrasjon, økonomi, reiseliv eller organisasjonsarbeid

· har evne til å motivere, inspirere og utvikle medarbeidere og frivillige

· arbeider strukturert og har god økonomisk forståelse

· er utadvendt, relasjonsorientert og trives i vertskapsrollen

· kommuniserer godt på norsk, både skriftlig og muntlig

· har god gjennomføringsevne og evner å kombinere strategisk tenkning med praktisk handling.

Vi tilbyr

Hva kan vi tilby?

· En meningsfull og spennende lederstilling med stor påvirkningskraft.

· Muligheten til å videreutvikle et leirsted med en viktig plass i regionens kristne arbeid.

· Lønn etter avtale og gode pensjonsordninger.

· Mulighet for tjenestebolig på leirstedet.

· Et engasjert styre og et bredt nettverk av frivillige og støttespillere.

· En variert arbeidshverdag i naturskjønne omgivelser.

Om ansettelsen

Laberget leirsted bygger sin virksomhet på et kristent verdigrunnlag.

Daglig leder har en sentral rolle i å ivareta og videreutvikle leirstedets kristne identitet, formål og verdier.

På grunn av stillingens karakter er det en forutsetning at den som ansettes bekjenner den kristne tro og kan identifisere seg med og arbeide lojalt i samsvar med virksomhetens kristne grunnlag. Dette vil bli tillagt vekt ved ansettelsen i samsvar med likestillings- og diskrimineringsloven. Labergets verdidokument er et internt dokument som vil bli presentert og gjennomgått med aktuelle kandidater i intervjuprosessen.

Den som ansettes må fremlegge tilfredsstillende politiattest før tiltredelse.

Praktisk informasjon

· Stilling: Fast, 100 %

· Arbeidssted: Laberget leirsted, Levanger kommune

Laberget leirsted ligger vakkert til ved Trondheimsfjorden i Levanger kommune. Gjennom mer enn 50 år har leirstedet vært en viktig møteplass for barn, ungdom og voksne. Her arrangeres leirer, kurs, konferanser og samlinger der fellesskap, gjestfrihet og kristen tro står sentralt.

jobs.title: Consultant BI (m/f)
jobs.description:
Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités SAP, Business Intelligence et Data, Bmatix recherche un(e) Consultant(e) SAP BI / Data Science & IA.

La particularité de ce profil réside à combiner de solides compétences dans l'écosystème SAP Business Intelligence avec des compétences en Data Science, Machine Learning et Intelligence Artificielle.

Vos missions :

En fonction des projets et des besoins de nos clients, vous pourrez intervenir sur différentes étapes de la chaîne Data :

SAP Business Intelligence

• Participer à la conception et à l'évolution de solutions BI dans l'environnement SAP.
• Intervenir sur SAP BW/4HANA et SAP BusinessObjects.
• Concevoir et maintenir des rapports et tableaux de bord avec SAP BusinessObjects Web Intelligence (WebI).
• Participer à la modélisation et à la structuration des données.
• Utiliser SAP Information Design Tool pour la conception et la gestion des univers.
• Analyser les besoins métiers et les traduire en solutions BI.
• Participer à l'amélioration et à l'optimisation des solutions de reporting existantes.

Data Engineering & ETL

• Participer à l'extraction, la transformation et l'intégration des données.
• Travailler sur des environnements SAP Data Services et SSIS.
• Manipuler différentes bases de données : MySQL et SQL Server.
• Préparer et nettoyer les données nécessaires aux analyses.
• Participer à la mise en place de flux de données fiables et exploitables.

Data Science & Machine Learning

• Explorer et analyser des jeux de données complexes.
• Préparer et transformer les données pour les modèles analytiques.
• Développer des modèles de Machine Learning.
• Participer à des travaux de prédiction, classification, régression et optimisation.
• Utiliser les bibliothèques Python dédiées à la Data Science et au Machine Learning.
• Évaluer les performances des modèles et interpréter les résultats.
• Explorer les possibilités offertes par l'Intelligence Artificielle dans les problématiques métiers de nos clients.

Data Analytics & Visualisation

• Réaliser des analyses statistiques et exploratoires.
• Identifier les tendances, corrélations et informations pertinentes dans les données.
• Construire des visualisations permettant de faciliter la compréhension et l'exploitation des données.
• Participer à la conception de tableaux de bord et d'indicateurs de performance.
• Utiliser Power BI ainsi que les outils de visualisation Python.

Votre profil :

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'un Master en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Business Intelligence, Informatique, Statistiques ou dans un domaine similaire.

Vous disposez d'une première expérience professionnelle significative dans les domaines de la BI, de la Data/ de l'IA.
Nous recherchons avant tout une personne capable de comprendre les problématiques métiers et de faire le lien entre données, outils BI et technologies Data/IA.

Au-delà de la maîtrise des différents outils, votre valeur ajoutée réside dans une double approche SAP BI et Data Science / IA.
Vous devez comprendre les problématiques traditionnelles de Business Intelligence et de reporting, tout en ayant une vision plus large des possibilités offertes par la Data Science, le Machine Learning et l'Intelligence Artificielle.

As new laws and regulations are introduced, companies' management needs to ensure that corporate governance standards are adhered to and that robust compliance management systems are in place, especially as non-compliance with regulatory requirements is under increased scrutiny from regulators.
In a period of heightened regulatory scrutiny and continuing globalization of AML/CTF regulation, organizations are faced with greater challenges to achieving and maintaining their AML/CTF compliance.

Our Forensic & AML services team, part of our Advisory department is advising clients on how to deal with and meet these regulatory challenges, assisting them in their efforts to prevent, detect and respond to money laundering, corruption and fraud issues.

• Strong attention to details, ability to manage teams and multiple priorities

jobs.title: Deutschsprachige Junior Auditoren - Starttermin: Oktober 2026 (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deutschsprachige Junior Auditoren - Starttermin: Oktober 2026 (m/w/d)

Job Description

Finde deine Berufung bei KPMG Luxembourg

Wir sehen eine Welt voller Möglichkeiten. Ob es darum geht, Wege zur Digitalisierung der Wirtschaftsprüfung zu finden, neuen Branchen zum Durchbruch zu verhelfen oder die Nachhaltigkeit und Widerstandsfähigkeit von Ökonomien zu stärken - wir wissen, dass Erkenntnisse neue Möglichkeiten für alle eröffnen.

Wir sind stolz darauf, Teil des weltweiten Netzwerks für hochwertige Prüfungs-, Steuer- und Beratungsdienstleistungen zu sein. Wir sind vielfältige und engagierte Problemlöser:innen, die ein gemeinsames Ziel verbindet.

Wir streben danach, durchgängig qualitativ hochwertige Wirtschaftsprüfungen zu erbringen, die durch die Leistungsfähigkeit der Technologie und die Stärke unserer Mitarbeitenden ermöglicht werden.

Wir bieten hervorragende Karrierechancen, die Autonomie, Flexibilität und Verantwortung in Einklang bringen. Unsere umfassenden Leistungen inspirieren unsere Mitarbeitenden dazu, ihr Bestes zu geben und sich wohlzufühlen.

Derzeit beschäftigen wir mehr als 1800 Mitarbeitende aus über 70 Nationen. Werde Teil unserer wachsenden Gemeinschaft junger und innovativer Mitglieder, um gemeinsam eine Welt voller Möglichkeiten zu erkunden.

Wir suchen unsere zukünftigen Junior-Auditoren (m/w/d) – Start im Oktober 2026

Wir sind im öffentlichen Interesse und für den Kapitalmarkt tätig, und wir haben uns verpflichtet, qualitativ hochwertige Prüfungen zu liefern, die durch die Kraft der Technologie und die Stärke unserer Mitarbeitenden ermöglicht werden. Durch den Einsatz führender Technologien verändern wir das Prüfungserlebnis für unsere Fachleute und unsere Kundschaft, wodurch wir eine noch höhere Prüfungsqualität bieten können, indem wir uns dank der Daten und Einblicke, die wir erhalten, noch besser auf die relevanten Themen konzentrieren können.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten und Herausforderungen

• Erbringen von Prüfdienstleistungen für eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen und die Möglichkeit, deine Fähigkeiten in IFRS und lokalen GAAP zu entwickeln
• Teilnahme an Prüfungs- und Buchhaltungsprojekten für nationale und internationale Kundschaft in verschiedenen Branchen wie Banken, Versicherungen, Asset Management, Real Estate, Private Equity oder Commercial Industrial & Public Sector (CIPS; Handel und öffentlicher Sektor)
• Erwerb von fundierten Kenntnissen in den Bereichen Wirtschaftsprüfung, Finanz- und Rechnungswesen
• Vertrauen zur Kundschaft aufbauen und eine enge Beziehung mit ihnen pflegen
• Arbeiten in einem internationalen Umfeld, in dem die Unternehmenssprache Englisch ist
• Arbeiten in multikulturellen Teams mit Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Kulturen und Ländern

Woran du arbeiten wirst

Als Junior wirst du:

• Die Brücke zwischen deinem theoretischen Wissen und den praktischen Auswirkungen aufkommender globaler Rechnungslegungsstandards und internationaler Mandate überbrücken und eine profunde Beherrschung von Standards wie IFRS und lokalem GAAP entwickeln
• An einem vielfältigen Portfolio internationaler Kundschaft arbeiten und sie treffen (persönlich oder virtuell)
• Lernen, wie eine Vielzahl von Organisationen arbeiten, einschließlich der Überprüfung ihrer Systeme und Prozesse, um die Unternehmen, die du prüfen wirst, beraten zu können
• Vertrauen bei Berichtsadressat:innen schaffen, indem du die Jahresabschlüsse von Unternehmen prüfst
• Unsere Prüfungsmethodik umsetzen, die die Bewertung der Betriebsstruktur der Kundschaft, die Beurteilung von Risikofaktoren und internen Kontrollstrukturen, die Durchführung von Jahresabschlussprüfungen und die Formulierung gezielter Empfehlungen und spezialisierter Berichte beinhaltet
• Teil innovativer Projekte zur Verbesserung unserer Prozesse und digitaler Tools sein

Wonach wir suchen

Effektive Wirtschaftsprüfer:innen verfügen über eine Kombination aus technischen und sozialen Fähigkeiten, darunter:

• Qualifikation: Du hast einen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss oder wirst dein Studium bald in den Bereichen Betriebswirtschaft, Volkswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsprüfung, Finanzen, Ingenieurwesen/IT oder Rechnungswesen abschließen oder du bist Betriebswirtin oder Fachwirtin und bist an einer beruflichen Qualifikation im Bereich Wirtschaftsprüfung interessiert (z. B. IRE, Wirtschaftsprüfer)
• Analytische Fähigkeiten: Die Fähigkeit, finanzielle Daten zu analysieren, Unregelmäßigkeiten zu identifizieren und die finanzielle Lage eines Unternehmens zu beurteilen
• Detailgenauigkeit: Ein geschultes Auge für Genauigkeit und die Verpflichtung zur gründlichen Dokumentation und Überprüfung
• Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Effektive verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um ausgezeichnete Beziehungen zur Kundschaft und zu Teams aufzubauen und zu pflegen sowie die Fähigkeit, eigenständig und im Team zu arbeiten
• Ethische Integrität: Ein starkes Bekenntnis zu ethischem Verhalten und Unabhängigkeit, um die Glaubwürdigkeit des Prüfprozesses aufrechtzuerhalten
• Problemlösung: Die Fähigkeit, komplexe finanzielle Probleme und Unstimmigkeiten zu identifizieren und zu lösen
• Zeitmanagement: Effizientes Management mehrerer Mandate und Einhaltung von Fristen
• Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch, jede weitere Sprache wäre von Vorteil

Was du erhalten wirst

Ergreife eine aufregende Gelegenheit, die Zukunft des globalen Geschäfts in Luxemburg zu gestalten, einem aufstrebenden Finanzzentrum. Bei KPMG sind wir bereit, dich auf einer Reise des beruflichen Wachstums zu begleiten und bieten dir ein breites Spektrum an Möglichkeiten, um deine Karriere zu fördern. KPMG bietet dir umfassende Schulungen und Unterstützung, einschließlich eines vollständigen Schulungsprogramms mit einer Einführungswoche im Ausland bei deiner Ankunft, um die Fähigkeiten zu erwerben, die du für deine beruflichen Ziele und deine berufliche Entwicklung benötigst. Im Rahmen der beruflichen Entwicklung bietet KPMG auch die Möglichkeit, interne oder externe Versetzungen durchzuführen, um in einer anderen Abteilung oder einem anderen Standort zu arbeiten.
Im Bereich der Prüfdienstleistungen wirst du eine spürbare Wirkung erzielen, indem du mit einer vielfältigen Gruppe von führenden Experten:innen zusammenarbeitest und mit einer weltweiten Kundschaft interagierst, während du innovative technologische Lösungen erkundest.

Als Teil der KPMG-Familie wirst du auch eine Reihe von Erlebnissen genießen, darunter die Teilnahme an Veranstaltungen wie KPMG Plage, dem Oktoberfest, der Betriebsfeier und anderen Festlichkeiten, die uns näher zusammenbringen. Schließe dich uns nicht nur für einen Job, sondern für eine bereichernde Reise an, profitiere von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, der Möglichkeit, von zu Hause aus oder von verschiedenen Büros aus zu arbeiten, und einer umfassenden Schulung von Anfang an. Werde Teil eines vielfältigen Teams, in dem wir kontinuierlich die Geschlechtergleichstellung fördern und der LGBTQ+-Community kraftvolle Unterstützung bieten. Deine Erfolgsgeschichte beginnt hier. Schließe dich uns an und werde Teil von #Teamblue.
