Experience the power of a game-changing career  

Want to be part of an innovative and growing team? We’re a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. We help well-known brands — the ones you use every day — improve their businesses with technology and integrated solutions, in over 70 countries.  

If you’re looking to grow and be inspired, as an Account Manager Executive, you will be part of our team of game-changers who are powering the brands of the future in tech.  

Career growth and personal development  

This is a great opportunity to experience the power of what’s next and develop “friends for life” at the same time. We’ll give you all the training, cutting-edge technologies, and the continuing support you’ll need to succeed.  

What you will do in this role  

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.  

As an Account Manager Executive on our team, you will:  

- Focus on developing and closing opportunities with both new and existing customers, driving acquisition, retention, and growth across mid-sized accounts.
- Own the overall account strategy and sales execution.
- Systematically qualify customer potential and address whitespace opportunities across the full product portfolio.
- Collaborate closely with the Channel team (PBM, iPBM, Proximity) to align account strategies.
- Drive PC++ Sales (including Headsets, Displays, and Care Packs) as well as Print Transactional Sales.
- Lead the solution-building process and engage pooled central inside sales specialists and presales experts when needed.
- Identify and engage new contacts within assigned accounts, elevate relationships across the full portfolio, and manage structured communications based on strategic sequencing.
- Own opportunity identification, qualification, and management. Proactively hunt within low or no SOW accounts.
- Coordinate with in-market technical consultants to provide expert support when required.
- Support or lead project management efforts, own pricing discussions, ensure compliance with global pricing guidelines, and manage negotiations and sales closure with a focus on profitability.
- Support renewals and post-sales activities in partner-led opportunities, offering guidance on cross-sell and upsell strategies based on customer needs, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience.

Your qualifications  

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.  

Concentrix is a great match if you:  

- Are proficient or bilingual in German with advanced English level
- Have proven ability to self-prospect via cold outreach using multiple contact tools.
- Are skilled in building strong relationships with decision-makers.
- Are capable of navigating complex organizations to identify expansion opportunities.
- Are experienced in leading meetings with IT and Procurement stakeholders.
- Have strong business acumen with the ability to develop long-term growth strategies.
- Have analytical mindset to identify key business challenges and propose actionable solutions.
- have ability to manage the end-to-end sales process for transactional and, in selected cases, contractual opportunities.
- Have 1–3 years of relevant industry sales experience.
- Enjoy working in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
- Are passionate about technology, customer relationships, and business growth.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator - Dutch & German speaking m/f/d (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description:
**Location:**  Ghent

Client confidential

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

This is us, your new colleagues

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.

This is the job

- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.
- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.
- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.
- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business

Are you the one?

- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.
- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.
- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.
- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.
- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.
- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.
- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.

A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...

- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.
- Well-being services
- Restaurant on site
- Opportunity to grow within the company
- Good work life balance
- International environment
- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

jobs.title: Kok på Center Parcs Nordborg Resort (Koch/Köchin)
jobs.description:
Kok på Center Parcs Nordborg Resort

fastansættelse eller sæsonjob

Fuldtid / Deltid

Siden juni 2025 har vi været en del af Center Parcs Nordborg Resort med mange forskellige gastronomiske koncepter, og vi søger dig som kok! Vi søger et fast medlem til vores team – ikke kun for en sæson.

Leder du efter et job, hvor du kan være med til at forme en positiv virksomhedskultur, spille en afgørende rolle for gæsternes oplevelse og være en del af et spændende eventyr fra starten? Så bliv en del af vores team!

Vi kan tilbyde:

- Attraktiv løn : En løn, der matcher dine kvalifikationer og din erfaring
- Spændende udfordringer : Bliv en del af en ny afdeling og vær med til aktivt at forme udviklingen og succesen af vores gastronomiske tilbud.
- Venlig teamatmosfære : Hyggelige kolleger
- Internationalt arbejdsmiljø : En pålidelig international virksomhed og en fast ansættelse eller også for sæsonen – alt efter hvad der passer dig bedst
- Medarbejderrabatter : Få bl.a. rabat på måltider i vores restauranter
- Muligheder for videreuddannelse : Din karriere, din fremtid – muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling på nationalt og internationalt plan

Dine opgaver:

Som kok er du en del af vores køkkenhold og sørger for, at vores gæster hver dag får et gastronomisk tilbud af høj kvalitet og med stor variation.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

- Tilberedning af retter til f.eks. morgenbuffet
- Kreativ tilberedning med både friske råvarer og convenience-produkter
- Planlægning og organisering af indkøb og opbevaring
- Tilberedning af à la carte-menuer

Din profil:

- En afsluttet uddannelse som kok eller tilsvarende erhvervserfaring inden for gastronomi
- Erhvervserfaring, f.eks. fra restaurant, hotel, kantine eller storkøkken, er en fordel
- Kvalitetsbevidsthed, ansvarsfølelse og glæde ved madlavning
- Et køligt hoved – også i stressede situationer
- Teamånd, pålidelighed og en struktureret arbejdsmåde
- Kreativitet og interesse for forskellige køkkenretninger
- Fleksibilitet og villighed til også at arbejde i weekender og på helligdage
- Gode danskkundskaber; engelsk- eller tyskfærdigheder er en fordel

Mere end 24.000 mennesker i 11 lande er allerede en del af Areas-familien. Vi brænder for det, vi laver, elsker rollen som værter og byder vores gæster velkommen med lækker og indbydende mad

Vi ser frem til at lære dig at kende! Ansøg nu via e-mail til: karriere@areas.com eller via online ansøgningsskemaet!

Vi opfordrer alle interesserede til at søge uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, handicap, eller etnisk tilhørsforhold.

jobs.title: German speaking Google Ads Sales Executive (m/w/d), Barcelona Spain (Sales-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Join a dynamic team as a Google Ads Sales Executive, where you’ll drive growth for our valued clients. We’re seeking a resilient individual to focus on providing exceptional service-oriented Google Ads solutions to emerging businesses and established local enterprises. If you have a proven sales track record, excel at building relationships quickly, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

- Engage with regional clients, understanding their needs and providing tailored service solutions.
- Manage a high volume of accounts, focusing on delivering exceptional service and sales support.
- Drive revenue growth by effectively selling and convincing clients, using strong sales techniques.
- Work with performance targets and KPIs to consistently meet or exceed objectives.
- Quickly adapt to changing customer needs and business priorities.
- Cultivate relationships with clients, ensuring their satisfaction and fostering long-term loyalty.
- Provide excellent customer service, addressing inquiries, concerns, and providing timely resolutions.

Requirements

- C2 level of German and C1 level of English (both written and spoken).
- 2 years of proven sales experience, with the ability to win people over and convince clients rapidly.
- Proficient at creating digital marketing strategies for all customers sizes.
- Education: BA/BS degree required; Master’s degree or advanced professional certification is highly desirable.
- High-Impact Target Attainment: Extensive history of consistently achieving and surpassing challenging sales quotas. Must possess deep expertise in persuasive negotiation and a demonstrated capacity for driving significant individual revenue and market share gains in high-velocity sectors of different verticals. Proficient resilience and ability to handle a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
- Advanced Client Advocacy: Significant experience as a senior, customer-facing subject matter expert, specifically designing and implementing service protocols that resolve systemic client friction and substantially enhance customer retention and lifetime value.
- Operational Versatility: Exceptional ability to thrive through periods of ambiguity and rapid change, swiftly implementing process improvements and recalibrating priorities to ensure continuous business momentum.

Specialized Skills for the German Market:

- Deep German market and cultural understanding.
- Strategic thinking to target high-growth companies.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and relationship-building skills.
- Ability to unlock substantial expansion opportunities.
- German cultural awareness for building client trust.
- Stakeholder management, including skeptical clients and multiple agencies.
- Deep understanding of the German digital marketing ecosystem to position Google Ads effectively.
- Proficiency in managing sophisticated ROI and integration queries.
- Knowledge of local regulations, especially GDPR, to ensure compliance and tailor data-privacy-focused outreach strategies.

Desirable Skills

- Process Excellence: Systematically improving organizational processes to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and quality
- Collaboration: Working effectively with others, sharing ideas and resources to achieve common goals
- Communication: Exchanging information, ideas, and messages between individuals or groups through various channels and mediums.
- Emotional Intelligence: Understanding and managing one’s own emotions and the emotions of others to foster positive relationships and enhance the impact of actions
- Open Mindedness: Considering and appreciating diverse perspectives and ideas, fostering collaboration
- Critical Thinking: Evaluating information and arguments, leading to informed and effective decisions based on data insights
- Solution Orientation: Approaching problems and challenges with a focus on finding practical and effective solutions
- Entrepreneurship: Having a mindset characterized by innovation, creativity, risk-taking, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and opportunity identification

Benefits

- Full-time (39 hours/week) hybrid position in Barcelona with a salary of 24.310,00 € gross/year + up to 4.290,00 € gross/year in bonus.
- Relocation Support
- Private Health Insurance.
- Continuous skill development and certifications.
- Clear career growth opportunities
- Engaging workplace with bi-weekly, monthly, or quarterly contests and dynamic business casual culture.
- Prime office location at the World Trade Center, Barcelona, surrounded by the sea.

jobs.title: (Senior) Risk Manager (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.employer: Commerz Real AG Commerz Real Düsseldorf
jobs.description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

jobs.title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

jobs.title: Shiftmanager Fastfood/Horeca
jobs.description:
Ben jij klaar voor de volgende stap als leidinggevende? Zoek je een job met veel doorgroeimogelijkheden, een hecht team en de zekerheid van een stabiele werkgever? Dan hebben wij dé kans voor jou!

In deze functie stuur je het team aan tijdens jouw shift. Je zorgt dat alles soepel loopt: van een vlotte service tot tevreden klanten. Samen met je collega’s bouw je mee aan een positieve werksfeer én aan jouw toekomst. Je krijgt volop kansen om door te groeien richting hogere managementrollen.

Waarom is dit dé job voor jou?

  • Je zet je leidinggevende skills in én bouwt ze verder uit.
  • Je werkt in een team waar samenwerking centraal staat.
  • Je krijgt begeleiding en kansen om door te groeien.
  • Als shiftmanager start je in de functie van 'gewone' medewerker voor ongeveer een maand, om de flow te leren kennen, daarna start je aan jouw opleidingstraject als shiftmanager. Ongeveer een half jaar een examen in NL later ben je klaar om jouw rol op te nemen.

Als shiftmanager stuur jij samen met een collega shiftmanager een team van 25 mensen aan. Jullie krijgen de planning een maand op voorhand door.

Doorheen de dag lossen jullie problemen op in het team of met klanten. Belangrijk dus om communicatief sterk in jouw schoenen te staan.

Je werkt in vaste uurblokken die zich situeren tussen 8u 's morgens en 01.00u 's avonds.

  • Je bent communicatief zeer sterk en weet hoe je een team moet aansturen. People management ligt jou.
  • Je bent flexibel in werktijden, zowel in avondwerk als weekendwerk.
  • Je bent klaar om te groeien, zowel als persoon als in functie.

jobs.title: Handyman / general facilities technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician with solid electrical knowledge and a passion for maintenance, repairs, and problem-solving? Do you enjoy having variety in your work and being the go-to person for all technical issues? And are you already living in Belgium?

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician or handyman to help maintain the buildings, warehouse facilities, technical installations and outdoor areas. A very varied job that combines electrical maintenance, facility maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting and general handyman tasks. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you're responsible for a wide range of maintenance and repair activities across the different sites of the company. You and the rest of the technical team use your technical skills to ensure the operations run safely and efficiently.

Your key duties:

  • Perform electrical maintenance and repairs
  • Carry out minor repairs to plumbing, storage racks, equipment...
  • Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
  • Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
  • Supervise external contractors and service providers

Your profile:

  • Good knowledge of electrical systems and installations
  • Basic knowledge of plumbing, mechanics, building maintenance, or general technical repairs
  • Experience as a maintenance technician, handyman, facilities technician, general maintenance worker...
  • Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
  • Very good knowledge of English

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

  • You must already be living in Belgium
  • You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)

Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.title: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

  • Transport of frozen goods
  • National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
  • Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
  • Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

  • Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
  • Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
  • Has a good level of English
  • Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
  • Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby truck cannot be taken home)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

  • You must already be living in Belgium
  • You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)

Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.title: SiS LVM-Hem Hessleby söker dig behandlingspedagog
jobs.description:
Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring.

SiS LVM-hem Hessleby som ligger i vacker skogsmiljö strax utanför Mariannelund tar emot män med alkohol-, narkotika- eller blandmissbruk. Vi har särskild kompetens för att ta emot klienter med psykisk ohälsa eller ett utåtagerande beteende. Vi har i uppdrag att bedriva vård för klienter med särskilda vårdbehov.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Vill du vara med och skapa den livsviktiga förändringen för utsatta människor? Då är jobbet som behandlingspedagog hos SiS en meningsfull utmaning. Som behandlingspedagog arbetar du i team tillsammans med behandlingsassistenter och behandlingssamordnare och tillsammans ansvarar ni för att de ungdomar och klienter som bor hos oss får den trygghet, vård och behandling som de behöver. Vi möter ofta människor i kris, vilket innebär att du jobbar med kvalificerat omvårdnads-och motivationsarbete och med att vara ett stöd i vardagen. Med stöd av dina kunskaper inom vård- och behandlingsarbete bidrar du aktivt till att behandlingsplaner fullföljs. Dokumentation är en viktig del av ditt arbete, och bidrar bland annat till rättssäkerhet, planering och uppföljning av vår verksamhet. Du bidrar till att säkerheten upprätthålls enligt våra rutiner och du medverkar till att vardagen flyter på med skolgång, städning, matlagning med mera. Kontaktmannaskap är också en av dina arbetsuppgifter. I arbetet kan det även ingå att vara handledare åt nya medarbetare och praktikanter. Det här är ett arbete för dig som ser en positiv utmaning i att få arbeta med utsatta människor i en svår livssituation. Jobbet är många gånger krävande men också stimulerande, glädjefyllt och omväxlande.

Vår vision är att vara en plats för förändring och det genomsyrar vårt bemötande, vårt engagemang och vårt förhållningssätt.

Arbetstiden är enligt schema dag, kväll och helg.

Kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i ditt arbete har du en grundmurad positiv människosyn. Du är motiverad att hjälpa människor i en utsatt livssituation och du delar SiS värdegrund, att vara en plats för förändring. Vidare har du en god förmåga att skapa engagemang och delaktighet hos våra ungdomar. Som person är du trygg i dig själv och har lätt för att skapa relation med ungdomar likväl som med övriga i personalgruppen. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga och kan behålla ditt lugn även i pressade situationer. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra och du kan hantera konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.

Du ska också ha:

    Examen från 2-årig eftergymnasial utbildning vid folkhögskola eller yrkeshögskola (KY/YH) med inriktning mot socialt/pedagogiskt behandlingsarbete eller utbildning från högskola som vi bedömer likvärdig
    B- körkort
    God svenska i tal och skrift

På SiS månar vi om ett gott medarbetarskap. Det innebär att du som medarbetare tar ansvar för ditt arbete, bidrar till utveckling och medverkar till ett gott samarbete. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/.

Anställning:

Tjänsten är ett vikariat på heltid till och med 2027-05-16 med möjlighet till förlängning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Ansökan:

Välkommen att registrera din ansökan i vårt rekryteringsverktyg senast den 2026-10-10

SiS arbetar aktivt mot all form av diskriminering och välkomnar alla sökande.

För arbete på våra institutioner gör SiS registerkontroll innan anställning.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Statens institutionsstyrelse tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

OBS! Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte söka via rekryteringssystemet. Kontakta i stället den som står som kontaktperson i annonsen.

jobs.title: Sylteskolan söker erfaren lärare i ma/no till åk 4 -6
jobs.description:
Vi är stolta över Trollhättans stads över 5 000 medarbetare, som varje dag gör en positiv skillnad i våra invånares liv och är med och utvecklar stadens hållbarhet och livskraft. Vi drivs och motiveras av ledorden Mod, Delaktighet, Nytänkande och Handlingskraft. Här finns en spännande utveckling där du kan vara med och göra vår stad ännu bättre.

Om verksamheten

Sylteskolan är en F-9 skola med flera verksamhetsdelar; grundskola åk F-6 samt åk 7-9, anpassad grundskola åk 1-6 samt åk 7-9 och två särskilda undervisningsgrupper åk 1-6 samt åk 7-9. Vi arbetar utifrån en gemensam helhetssyn, värdegrund och förhållningssätt för ett starkt ledarskap i klassrummen. Tydliga rutiner och anpassning av undervisningen är ledstjärnor i vår verksamhet. Vi ser mångfald som en tillgång och inkludering som en självklarhet. I vår verksamhet finns många olika nationaliteter representerade och i våra undervisningsgrupper undervisar vi elever utifrån olika kursplaner. Vår ambition är att ständigt utveckla oss och vår verksamhet med målet att öka elevernas måluppfyllelse, kunskapsmässigt och socialt. Alla elever ska få utvecklas så långt som möjligt!

På Sylteskolan har vi ett stort fokus på matematikutveckling. Vi avsätter mycket tid tillsammans och arbetar aktivt med att utveckla matematikundervisningen. Vi använder bland annat Sigmamodellen och ÄDK i detta arbete. Som lärare får du vara en del av detta och bidra till skolans fortsatta utveckling inom matematik.

Kvalifikationer och arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker en legitimerad lärare med behörighet att undervisa inom årskurserna 4 - 6 som har kompetens och erfarenhet att undervisa i ämnena matematik och no. Vi värdesätter ett laborativt arbetssätt där man ser på eleven som någon som är undersökande och upptäckande i sitt lärande. Vi lägger stor vikt vid din förmåga att skapa strukturer och anpassa undervisningen på både individ- och gruppnivå så att vi stärker likvärdigheten i undervisningen för alla våra elever och ger alla elever utmaningar och möjligheter att nå så lång som möjligt.

Du ska vara väl förtrogen med ditt läraruppdrag utifrån aktuella styrdokument och ha goda kunskaper i att planera, genomföra, dokumentera, följa upp och utveckla den pedagogiska verksamheten tillsammans med arbetslaget.  Du har lätt för att samarbeta, mycket god förmåga att skapa relation till elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor och du förstår vikten av att ständigt utveckla din och verksamhetens undervisning.

Jag som rektor...

har höga förväntningar på dig och dina kollegor. Tillsammans vet jag att vi kan göra skillnad för varje enskild elev genom samarbete, att stödja och stärka varandras undervisningskvalitet genom att dela erfarenheter och kunskaper kring undervisning och lärande. Vi ska hela tiden ha elevens lärande och resultat i fokus och jag vet att det är hela skolans gemensamma ansvar att se till att eleverna klarar sina studiemål. Därför tar jag ansvar för att vi lägger stor vikt vid att stärka vår undervisning, att finna undervisningsformer som är gemensamma och som gör att eleverna känner igen sig och möts av samma höga förväntningar. Aktuell forskning visar att stabila strukturer och relationer, insatser som bygger på analys och ett långsiktigt utvecklingsarbete är framgångsrikt, därför ägnar vi oss åt det. Vill du vara med?

Anställningsinformation

Utdrag ur Belastningsregistret är obligatoriskt vid arbete med barn.

Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons!

Trollhättan är en stark och attraktiv kommun som ska bli större. I dag är vi ca 59 000 invånare och vi har siktet inställt på att växa till 70 000 trollhättebor. Inom Trollhättans stad arbetar vi med att skapa förutsättningar för detta. Vi är över 5 000 medarbetare och våra 350 olika yrken bidrar på olika sätt med att ge service och underlätta en bra vardag för våra invånare - nu och i framtiden. Vi ser mångfald som en styrka som berikar vår verksamhet och välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund.

Trollhättans stad tillämpar rökfri arbetstid.

jobs.title: Vill du göra skillnad som socialsekreterare – redan i första kontakten?
jobs.description:
Vad vi gör och vill

Mottagningsenheten för vuxna och ekonomiskt bistånd består av 16 medarbetare och är en del av arbetsmarknads- och socialförvaltningen. Du kommer att ingå i mottagningsgruppen, som består av fem socialsekreterare.

Vi arbetar nära varandra och värdesätter ett gott samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och ett respektfullt bemötande – både gentemot dem vi möter och varandra.

Hos oss får du ett omväxlande arbete, nära kollegialt stöd och möjlighet att utvecklas i din yrkesroll. Vi har veckovisa ärendedragningar och handledning en gång i månaden. Vi värdesätter också en god balans mellan arbete och fritid.

Om tjänsten

Vi söker en socialsekreterare till mottagningsgruppen för vuxna och ekonomiskt bistånd. Tjänsten är ett föräldravikariat från december 2026 till och med maj 2028.

Som socialsekreterare i mottagningen är du ofta den första kontakten för personer som söker stöd från socialtjänsten.

Du arbetar bland annat med:

- förhandsbedömningar gällande våld i nära relation, skadligt bruk och beroende, ekonomiskt bistånd samt socialpsykiatri

- första ansökan om ekonomiskt bistånd, inklusive grundutredning och första beslut

- tillhörighetsbedömningar

- samverkan med andra enheter, verksamheter och aktörer.

Arbetet är varierat och du behöver kunna växla mellan olika typer av ärenden och möta människor i många olika livssituationer.

Vem är du?

Är du socionom och vill ha ett varierat arbete där du får möta människor, göra professionella bedömningar och tillsammans med kollegor hitta vägar framåt? Då kan du vara vår nya kollega!

Vi söker dig som:

- har socionomexamen

jobs.title: Enterprisearkitekt
jobs.description:
Uppdrag: Enterprisearkitekt

Om uppdraget

Vår klient, en myndighet inom offentlig sektor, har ett stort behov av att skapa en samlad lägesbild över hur arkitekturen ser ut inom hela organisationen – hur avdelningarnas förmågor och leveranser hänger ihop, vilken mognadsgrad organisationen har inom olika förmågor, och när behov uppstår av nya förmågor, till exempel ny eller förändrad teknisk förmåga eller organisatoriska gap.

För att skapa denna helhetsbild behöver varje avdelning ta fram en nulägesarkitektur som beskriver arkitekturen inom respektive avdelning. Nulägesarkitekturen omfattar både ett nuläge och ett målläge. Utifrån skillnaden mellan dessa identifieras de gap – ofta kallade förflyttningar eller transformationer – som avdelningen och organisationen som helhet behöver arbeta vidare med.

Ansvarsområden

    Ta emot krav från koncernarkitekter via chefsarkitekt
    Ta fram ett koncept för nulägesarkitektur med tillhörande aggregerad lägesbild för hela organisationen (t.ex. mallar, bilder, modeller)
    Stötta organisationens olika avdelningar i arbetet med att beskriva sin nulägesarkitektur och hur den ska underhållas över tid
    Aggregera ihop avdelningarnas arkitektur till en lägesbild på övergripande nivå

Förväntat resultat

    Avdelningarna har tagit fram och livscykelhanterar sin nulägesarkitektur, som används som stöd för planering och beslut
    Organisationen kan använda en övergripande nulägesarkitektur som stöd för planering och beslut

Leveranser

    En nulägesarkitektur för varje avdelning
    En aggregerad bild över arkitekturen för hela organisationen
    Ett koncept för hur ovanstående tas fram samt hur arkitekturen underhålls över tid

Övrigt om uppdraget

Uppdraget kan innebära resor till klientens andra kontor under uppdragsperioden, och konsulten förväntas delta vid dessa tillfällen. Sådana resor bokas och bekostas av klienten. Övriga resor är inte planerade i nuläget och sker i så fall enligt anvisning från närmaste chef hos klienten.

Urvalsprocess

Klienten kommer att genomföra intervjuer med offererade konsulter. Bedömningen sker samlat utifrån:

    Förmåga att redogöra för uppdragets genomförande och identifiera eventuella utmaningar
    Förmåga att analysera och förstå verksamhetens behov samt föreslå ändamålsenliga lösningar
    Pedagogisk och kommunikativ förmåga
    Samarbetsförmåga i relation till team, beställare och slutanvändare
    Erfarenhet i förhållande till angivna krav och eventuella mervärdeskriterier

Skall-krav

    Minst 5 års erfarenhet av att ha arbetat i en roll som Enterprisearkitekt
    Relevant universitets- eller högskoleutbildning, eller motsvarande kunskaper förvärvade på annat sätt
    Kompetensnivå 3 enligt gällande nivåskala: hög generalistkompetens eller mycket hög utbildning och kompetens inom området; erfarenhet av att ha deltagit i stora uppdrag och genomfört uppdrag med mycket hög kvalitet (nivån uppnås normalt tidigast efter 9–12 år inom området); huvudansvar för ledning av större grupp; mycket stor grad av självständighet
    Innehav av F-skatt, som ska styrkas med giltigt intyg om F-skatteregistrering i anbudet

Bör-krav

    Erfarenhet av att ha varit drivande i framtagandet av nulägesarkitektur och målarkitektur på enterprisenivå för större organisationer
    Erfarenhet av att beskriva nulägesarkitektur, målarkitektur och övergångsarkitekturer för olika målgrupper
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med Enterprise Architect Sparx

Övriga krav

    Erfarenheten ska styrkas genom ett referensuppdrag genomfört under de senaste 24 månaderna, jämförbart med aktuellt uppdrag, redovisat enligt anvisad bilaga

Handlingar som ska ingå i offert

    CV
    Referensförteckning
    Pris
    Intyg om F-skatt

Omfattning och plats

Uppdraget bedrivs hos en myndighet inom offentlig sektor, med visst resande till andra kontor under uppdragsperioden. Närmare detaljer kring omfattning, arbetsplats och startdatum lämnas separat vid intresse.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Assignment: Senior Backend Engineer

About the assignment

We are seeking a senior Backend Engineer to work on large-scale distributed platforms for our client, a company operating technology platforms at significant scale. You will design, develop and maintain highly available, performance-critical Java services where security, scalability, reliability and high engineering standards are essential. You will take responsibility across the full software lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through to deployment and production operations.

Responsibilities

You will build fault-tolerant systems focused on performance, reliability and observability, while investigating and resolving complex production issues related to latency, concurrency, scalability and system behaviour under load. The role also includes technical design reviews, architectural decision-making, and collaboration with architects, platform teams, security engineers and product stakeholders. You will help advance engineering practices around automation, automated testing and continuous delivery.

The role suits someone who enjoys complex technical problem-solving, collaborating across engineering disciplines, and taking ownership of systems operating at very large scale.

Required qualifications

    Excellent communication and collaboration skills
    Strong practical experience developing RESTful APIs and event-driven architectures
    Expert-level command of Java, including memory management and garbage collection, JVM internals, performance optimisation, asynchronous and reactive programming models, and concurrency/multithreading
    Experience working with customer-facing systems where security, uptime and performance are business-critical
    Strong experience with automated testing, deployment automation and CI/CD pipelines
    Deep understanding of distributed systems, including scalability patterns, partition tolerance, failure recovery, service resiliency, and the trade-offs between availability and consistency
    At least 5 years of experience building and operating production-grade backend systems
    Experience with storage and caching technologies used at high scale, such as Memcached, Cassandra, Redis or comparable distributed data platforms

Nice to have

    Experience with machine learning infrastructure or large-scale data platforms
    Experience with cryptography, certificate management, PKI or security-focused systems
    Experience with Java frameworks for asynchronous networking
    Experience with Kubernetes and containerised infrastructure
    Experience with tools such as Maven, Docker, Spinnaker, GitHub or equivalent alternatives

Scope and location

The assignment involves working on large-scale, production-grade backend systems within a global engineering organization. Further details on scope, location/remote arrangements and start date will be shared separately upon interest.

jobs.title: Contract Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1 Contract Manager (m/f/d) Job ID 520262

Siemens Mobility location in 1110 Vienna.
You will analyse, draft and evaluate customer and supplier contracts, identify relevant opportunities and risks during project management and advise the project teams competently on contract-related issues.

* In addition, you will support the creation, negotiation and enforcement of amendments vis-à-vis customers and suppliers, ensuring the documentation and prosecution of claims as part of claim management.
* You will analyze project deviations in terms of costs, deadlines and scope of services, carry out delay analyses and evaluate the causes and effects of schedule deviations.
* In doing so, you will identify, document and assert downtime, obstructions and productivity losses and support the project teams in preparing evidence to enforce additional costs and compensation claims.
* You will work closely with the areas of project management, commercial management, engineering, procurement and legal counsel and accompany negotiations as well as the out-of-court or judicial enforcement of claims.


Your qualifications - solid and relevant

* You have successfully completed a university degree in law or an economic/technical university degree with basic legal training.
* You have a special interest and in-depth knowledge of contract law and ideally have already gained 3-5 years of professional experience in contract management, claim management or project management in the context of complex infrastructure or rolling stock projects.
* You have a pronounced willingness to familiarize yourself with the technical details of infrastructure projects in order to form an effective interface between law and technology.
* You are very interested in using AI to increase the quality and efficiency of your work.
* Personally, you are characterized by a structured, analytical way of working, initiative, strong communication skills and enjoyment of interdisciplinary cooperation.
* You are willing to travel nationally and internationally.
* Since you work in an international project environment, you are fluent in both written and spoken German and English. Ideally, you also have excellent knowledge of Romanian or another Eastern European language.

What do we offer you?

* Internationality - We offer an attractive working environment in an innovative, globally active group with diverse and responsible tasks in an international environment
* Purpose - We are pioneers of mobility. With us, you are actively contributing to the transport turnaround and climate protection in a market of the future, because our transport solutions reduce CO2 emissions all over the world.
* Reconciling family and career - With flexible working hours and the possibility of working from home, we help you to concentrate fully on your career without losing sight of the demands of your family life.
* Attractive conditions - You will receive an attractive remuneration package within the framework of the Collective Agreement for the Electrical and Electronics Industry of Austria and other extras such as employee share programmes and company pension schemes.
* Further development - We offer you comprehensive training opportunities for your professional and personal development, both online and offline.
* Team - Become part of our highly committed and collaborative team.

What else do I need to know?We offer an attractive compensation package that reflects your qualifications and professional experience. The gross annual salary for this position, as defined by the applicable collective agreement, is at least EUR 65,041.34. Depending on your education and experience, a higher salary may be offered. As a large international corporation, Siemens also provides additional benefits and social perks.
How can I apply?If you are interested in this position, we look forward to receiving your detailed online application.

We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

As our Marketing Engineer, you sit at the intersection of data science and paid media. You'll consolidate scattered customer signals into a single source of truth, build ML models that score leads by their real value, and feed those insights back into our ad platforms - making our marketing smarter than the platforms' out-of-the-box optimization. jobs.description:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

Reporting to the Senior Paid Social Manager, you will play a key role within our Paid Media department, managing and scaling campaigns for one of our two new key clients: a large fashion retailer, and a group operating within the local tourism and hospitality sector.

You will lead the end-to-end activation of multimarket and full-funnel campaigns across France and key European territories. Supported by strong partner relationships and emerging AI-driven tools, you will have the autonomy to test new strategies and manage high-impact budgets across major platforms.

This is a hybrid position, based out of our Paris office. The gross annual salary range for this position is between EUR 38,000-42,000, and the final offer is dependent on experience.

Responsibilities

  • Drive end-to-end activation, Quality Assurance (QA), and continuous optimisation of paid media campaigns, including Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest and Google Ads.

  • Manage and control budgets, monitoring pacing, making strategic decisions to boost or deboost tactics, and ensuring overall spend stays on target.

  • Lead client calls and presentations in both French and English, translating campaign data into performance reports and clear strategic recommendations across international markets.

  • Collaborate closely with Client Management, Creative, Data, and other Media teams to ensure smooth execution.

Qualifications

  • Fluency in French and professional-level English are required to lead conversations with the client teams.

  • Approximately 3 years of experience managing multimarket paid social and SEA campaigns.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major paid social platform (Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, or Pinterest) and Google Ads.

  • Solid understanding of PPC KPIs, full-funnel strategies, and key performance drivers.

  • Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for budget tracking and performance analysis.

  • Skilled at creating structured, clear, and visually polished presentations in PowerPoint or Google Slides.

  • You love getting to know your clients, developing long-lasting relationships and adding value to their business.

  • You're good at adapting strategies and plans to navigate unforeseen circumstances.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

jobs.title: Organic Growth Hacker - Paper.io 2
jobs.description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

Paper.io 2 is one of Voodoo's biggest games: 100M+ downloads and a top-ranked arcade title. It's simple, competitive and oddly satisfying, and it's played mostly by Gen Alpha (middle school / early high school).

Role

We're not looking for a community manager or a social media manager who posts three times a week and hopes for the best.


We're looking for a growth hacker who uses social media as their playground. You don't wait for the algorithm; you find ways to game it. You'd rather launch 100 accounts to see which 3 blow up than polish a single post for a week. You know the tricks, the loopholes and the formats nobody has tried yet, and you test them before everyone else does.


Your one mission: make Paper.io 2 massively viral on TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram, measured in views, engagement and virality.

  • Build an account machine: Launch and run a network of accounts: niche pages, personas, gameplay clips, languages, AI-produced content. Scale the ones that win and kill the rest fast.

  • Use AI as a weapon: Produce, remix and test content at a volume a traditional team can't match, with AI video, voice, editing and automation.

  • Hijack trends in hours, not weeks: Spot sounds, formats and IRL trends rising among Gen Alpha, and turn them into PO2 content before they peak.

  • Hack distribution: Seeding, comments, stitches and duets, fan accounts, cross-posting, and boosts on winning posts. Every post gets a plan to spread.

  • Activate creators and collabs: Find creators big and small, set up collabs, and turn players into content creators through challenges, UGC and in-game hooks.

  • Test everything, all the time: Hooks, formats, first frames, posting times, accounts. Read the data, double down on what works, cut the rest.

  • Report what you learn. Every week: what blew up, why, and what you're scaling next.

Profile

  • You've already grown accounts or brands on TikTok/Shorts, and you can show numbers (your own accounts count, and often count more).

  • You think in volume, speed and iteration, not perfection.

  • You have a bag of tricks: algorithm hacks, growth loops, tools, automation, and you're always looking for more.

  • You're fluent in AI tools for content production and scale.

  • You get Gen Alpha culture: what's cool, what's cringe, what moves fast.

  • You can edit short-form videos yourself, quickly.

  • You're data-driven: you know what hold rate, shares per view and completion rate tell you.

  • You're comfortable on camera (a plus).

Why join

  • One of the biggest mobile games in the world as your sandbox

  • Real freedom to test unconventional ideas

  • Resources to scale what works: tools, AI, creators, paid boosts

  • A direct line to the UA, creative and game teams

Benefits

  • Best-in-class compensation

  • Other benefits according to the country you reside

Atbalsta personas pakalpojums lēmumu pieņemšanā ir personai ar garīga rakstura traucējumiem sniegts atbalsts lēmumu pieņemšanā, lai palīdzētu viņai vienlīdzīgi ar citiem sabiedrības locekļiem īstenot savu tiesībspēju un rīcībspēju. Atbalsts lēmumu pieņemšanā ļauj personai paust savu gribu, izvēli, plānot un pašai pieņemt lēmumus par savu dzīvi, veselības un sociālo aprūpi, finansēm un īpašumiem, kā arī palīdz personai paplašināt savu dabisko atbalsta loku, palīdz pilnveidot spējas pārstāvēt sevi un aizsargāt savas tiesības un intereses. Pakalpojuma ietvaros atbalsts tiek nodrošināts 6 dzīves jomās: tiesību un interešu aizstāvības jomā, finanšu jomā, ikdienas dzīves jomā, veselības aprūpes jomā, sociālā aprūpes jomā un atbalsta loka veidošanā.

Ootame kandideerima ka neid, kelle erialane haridus on omandamisel!

Tööülesanded: Otsime oma meeskonda ostuspetsialisti, kes aitab hoida ostuosakonna igapäevatöö sujuvana ning andmed ja dokumendid korras. See amet sobib Sulle, kui naudid täpsust nõudvat tööd, suhtled hea meelega ning oskad oma tegemisi iseseisvalt korraldada. Sinu panus aitab tagada, et tootmiseks vajalik tooraine oleks õigel ajal tellitud ja oluline info jõuaks õigete inimesteni.
SINU PEAMISED ÜLESANDED ON: • lood ja seadistad kaupade andmeid infosüsteemis ning hoiad materjalide ja tarnijate info ajakohasena; • tellid koostöös vahetu juhiga toorainet, vajadusel tegeled allhangetega ning haldad ostutellimusi; • küsid tarnijatelt hinnapakkumisi, võrdled hindu ja aitad valida sobivaima lahenduse; • suhtled igapäevaselt kangatarnijatega, küsides hindu, saadavust, tarneaegu, minimaalseid tellimiskoguseid ja muid ostutingimusi; • tegeled koos kvaliteediosakonna ning tarnijatega kvaliteediprobleemide ja reklamatsioonide lahendamisega; • jälgid materjalide saadavust ja tarneid ning reageerid õigeaegselt võimalikele tarneriskidele ja puudujääkidele; • analüüsid materjalide hindu ja hinnamuutusi ning toetad ostuhindade ja kulude optimeerimist; • koordineerid kangaste proovide, värvikaartide, laboriproovide ja muude materjalinäidiste tellimist ning liikumist; • teed koostööd tootmise, planeerimise, kvaliteedi, arenduse ja müügimeeskonnaga, et tagada vajalike materjalide õigeaegne ja optimaalne saadavus; • haldad ostudokumentatsiooni ning infot tarnijate ja klientide portaalides; • aitad koostada ja ajakohastada osakonna juhendeid ning teavitad müügi- ja planeerimismeeskonda tarnetõrgetest.

Omalt poolt pakume: • stabiilset tööd rahvusvahelises ja arenevas ettevõttes;
• vaheldusrikast tööd, kus saad panustada ostuprotsessi sujuvusse ja õppida tundma rahvusvahelise tootmisettevõtte igapäevatööd; • põhjalikku väljaõpet ja toetavat sisseelamist; • toetavat ja sõbralikku meeskonda, kellega on hea ühiste eesmärkide nimel töötada; • arengu- ja koolitusvõimalusi ning ettevõtte pakutavaid hüvesid.

Muud nõuded: SOBID HÄSTI MEIE MEESKONDA, KUI:
• oled täpne, korrektne ja vastutustundlik; • oskad oma tööd iseseisvalt korraldada ning väärtustad koostööd; • oled hea suhtleja ja naudid meeskonnas töötamist; • kasutad arvutit väga heal tasemel ning tunned end andmete ja dokumentidega töötades kindlalt; • valdad eesti keelt ning oskad inglise keeles suhelda nii kõnes kui ka kirjas; • oled omandanud vähemalt keskhariduse.

jobs.title: Senior QA Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

Please submit your application in English.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenriscreations.com/en/postings/d315eb37-715d-4657-b29d-484420749257
Application deadline 8th of october 2026

CONFIANCE / AUTHENTICITE / AVENTURE HUMAINE / RECONNAISSANCE / REUSSITE

De 2018 à aujourd'hui, pour 125 apprenants intégrés, c'est 86% de taux de satisfaction, 86% de réussite au TP et 92% de taux d'insertion dans l'emploi.

Disposer de connaissances et savoirs faire en électricité / électrotechnique, à minima un Bac pro MELEC ou acquis par l'expérience

Une bonne aisance relationnelle et le sens des responsabilités
Etre inscrit.e à France Travail

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel to join our growing legal team and serve as a strategic partner to our rapidly expanding enterprise sales organization. In this high-impact role, you'll drive complex commercial negotiations that fuel our growth, working closely with our sales teams to close sophisticated technology agreements with enterprise customers across diverse industries. You'll play a critical role in scaling our commercial legal processes while navigating the evolving landscape of AI-powered development tools and ensuring our customers can confidently deploy Replit's platform in their organizations.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Drive Enterprise Deals: Serve as the lead legal advisor for complex, high-value enterprise sales transactions, working directly with our Account Executives and customer legal teams to negotiate and close sophisticated software agreements

 - Navigate AI & Technology Compliance: Help enterprise customers understand and navigate the legal and regulatory implications of adopting AI-powered development tools, addressing data privacy, security, and compliance requirements across various industries

 - Build Scalable Frameworks: Design and implement contract playbooks, template agreements, and streamlined processes that enable our sales team to move quickly while maintaining legal rigor as we scale

 - Risk Management: Identify, analyze, and proactively manage complex commercial and legal risks while maintaining deal velocity in our fast-paced, high-growth environment

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and Privacy teams to ensure our commercial offerings align with product capabilities and regulatory requirements

 - Strategic Advisory: Provide strategic guidance to leadership on commercial legal matters, emerging AI regulations, and market trends affecting developer tools and enterprise software adoption

 - Customer Relationship Building: Foster strong relationships with enterprise customer legal teams, becoming a trusted advisor who helps facilitate smooth adoption of Replit's platform




YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Legal Foundation: JD from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar

 - Commercial Experience: 5-7 years of relevant legal experience supporting enterprise software sales and complex commercial transactions, preferably at high-growth technology companies

 - Technology Focus: Strong background in SaaS agreements, software licensing, and technology transactions, with bonus points for experience with AI/ML tools, developer platforms, or cloud infrastructure

 - Deal Velocity: Proven track record of successfully closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals in fast-paced environments while balancing legal risk with business objectives

 - Business Acumen: Exceptional business judgment and ability to provide practical, solutions-oriented legal advice that enables (rather than blocks) commercial success

 - Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with experience presenting to and influencing C-level executives and enterprise customer stakeholders

 - Startup DNA: Thrives in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments where you'll need to build processes from the ground up and adapt quickly to changing priorities

 - Collaboration: Collaborative mindset with a track record of building strong cross-functional relationships and supporting high-velocity sales processes




BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

 - In-House Experience: Previous in-house counsel experience at technology companies, particularly those serving enterprise customers or developer audiences

 - AI/Developer Tools: Experience with AI, machine learning, or developer platform companies, including understanding of the unique legal considerations around code generation and AI-assisted development

 - Industry Knowledge: Experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries or understanding of compliance requirements across different sectors

jobs.title: Assistent restaurantmanager
jobs.description:
Onze klant is één van de grootste onafhankelijke retailers ter wereld.

De groep heeft een uitgebreid netwerk van vestigingen op internationale markten in Noord-Amerika, Europa en Australië.

Op vandaag is het bedrijf een toonaangevende speler op het gebied van food-to-go bij tankstations.

Onze klant wordt erkend voor zijn investeringsmodel, handelsprestaties en, nog belangrijker, het bieden van de beste ervaring in Retail, Foodservice en Brandstof.

De groep biedt een aantrekkelijk gamma aan erkende wereldmerken (zoals Starbucks, KFC en Burger King) die hun vestigingen omvormen tot een bestemming voor maaltijden en detailhandel die in meerdere behoeften van de klanten voorziet: van koffie over belegde broodjes tot fast food-maaltijden.

Elke dag leveren toegewijde medewerkers onvermoeibaar producten en diensten aan miljoenen klanten en steunen zij de lokale gemeenschappen waarin ze actief zijn.


Jobomschrijving

3 redenen om voor deze job te kiezen

  • Je werkt in een enthousiast, familiaal team
  • Je krijgt een goede verloning en extra voordelen
  • De job is afwisselend met doorgroeimogelijkheden


Zo ziet je job er uit

Als Assistent Restaurantmanager bij deze fastfoodketen ben jij de onmisbare rechterhand van de manager en draag je bij aan het dagelijks succes van de vestiging.

Jouw job bestaat uit:

  • het leiden van het team en samen met de collega's voor een klantgerichte werking zorgen
  • een enthousiaste en gemotiveerde sfeer op de werkvloer creëren
  • het opvolgen en streven naar het behalen van de verkoopdoelstellingen
  • nauw samenwerken met de manager, waarbij je rapporteert over de resultaten
  • assisteren bij taken zoals het opstellen van werkroosters, het beheren van de voorraad en het uitvoeren van kassawerkzaamheden
  • inspringen in de keuken of de bediening waar nodig om op die manier een voorbeeldfunctie te bekleden en de voeling met het dagelijks reilen en zeilen van het restaurant te behouden
  • het opnemen van de eindverantwoordelijkheid bij afwezigheid van de manager

Je draagt kortom bij aan de groei van het restaurant door je enthousiasme en klantgerichtheid, en je bent steeds bereid om operationele uitdagingen aan te pakken.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

De perfecte Assistant Restaurantmanager herkent zich in onderstaande eigenschappen:

  • je hebt ervaring in horeca
  • je kan terugblikken op een eerste leidinggevende ervaring waarbij je een team moest aansturen
  • je bent enerzijds klantgericht, maar ook een echte teamplayer naar collega's toe
  • je bent energiek, positief en hands-on ingesteld
  • je kan goed plannen, organiseren en motiveren
  • je werkt graag in een afwisselend uurrooster met werkuren tussen 4u 's ochtends en 23u 's avonds
  • je bent bereid om in het weekend te werken, zowel op zaterdag als zondag
De ideale collega is...

De ideale collega is een geboren leider met een passie voor voeding en horeca.

Je hebt zin om te groeien in een leidinggevende functie, waarbij je administratieve taken combineert met operationeel meewerken op de vloer.

Je haalt energie uit een afwisselende job en bent in staat om een team te coachen en aan te sturen. Jij bent een expert in organiseren, delegeren en het nemen van initiatief. Ook onder druk weet je steeds het overzicht te bewaren.

Werken met een variabel uurrooster, inclusief weekends, schrikt jou niet af – integendeel, je geniet van de dynamiek die dit met zich meebrengt.

Je houdt van orde, netheid en zorgt ervoor dat de vestiging er altijd piekfijn uitziet. Je bent nauwkeurig bij het uitvoeren van papier- en kassawerk en weet klanten altijd met een grote glimlach te verwelkomen.

Je volgt samen met de manager de commerciële en financiële resultaten op en bent steeds op zoek naar verbeteringen.

Je steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen en bent flexibel inzetbaar.

Kortom, jij bent een enthousiaste Assistant Restaurantmanager die het verschil maakt.

jobs.title: SAP Application Expert, in SAP Transportation Management System
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As an SAP Application Expert, you will be responsible for configuring, testing, and supporting SAP Transportation Management (TM) solutions across transportation planning, execution, freight costing, and settlement processes. The role requires solid functional expertise in transportation management processes, master data configuration, integration testing, defect analysis, and business support throughout implementation, rollout, and hyper care phases.

Key Skills and Responsibilities that are part of your daily work

    Configure and maintain SAP TM master data, including locations, business partners, carriers, transportation zones, lanes, resources, and freight agreements.
    Configure and support transportation demand management, including Freight Unit Building Rules (FUBR), transportation requirements, and demand consolidation.
    Configure and test transportation planning processes, including freight unit planning, carrier assignment, route determination, consolidation, and Freight Order creation.
    Configure and support Freight Order lifecycle management, transportation execution, status management, and shipment tracking processes.
    Configure freight charge management, including rate tables, calculation sheets, freight agreements, surcharges, and freight cost calculation.
    Configure and support freight settlement processes, including Freight Settlement Documents (FSD), cost allocation, invoice verification, and financial integration.
    Support carrier onboarding, tendering processes, and carrier collaboration activities.
    Perform functional testing, SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect analysis, and validation of end-to-end transportation processes.
    Support integration testing with SAP S/4HANA/ECC, EWM, SAP Business Network for Logistics (BN4L), and SAP GTT where applicable.
    Analyse and resolve production issues, support business users, and participate in cutover, deployment, and hyper care activities.
    Prepare functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, and support documentation.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will work with a team of highly skilled professionals on H&M Group’s advanced SAP platform, which supports operations worldwide. The role offers plenty of room for learning, development, and participation in various initiatives. Together we stive to achieve end to end visibility of our Transport & Trade flows to enable proactive, data-driven decision making.

Qualifications

WHO YOU ARE

Your mindset and skills

We believe you bring solid experience in the SAP Transportation Management area, with solid knowledge of system design, concepts, principles, and configuration. You are confident in explaining SAP Transportation Management (TM)-related topics to both team members and stakeholders across the H&M Group.

You are confident in working independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

You are self-driven, proactive and take accountability with analytic mindset.  

You have excellent communication skills so that you can communicate information clearly and effectively.

Mandatory requirements, both competence and tools:

    Solid hands-on SAP TM configuration experience (7+ years).
    Proficiency in Freight Unit Management, Transportation Planning, Freight Order Management, Freight Charge Management, Freight Settlement and SAP TM Master Data configuration.
    Proficiency in end-to-end transportation processes, including inbound, outbound and Transit.
    Proven experience in supporting carrier onboarding, tendering processes, and carrier collaboration activities.
    Proven experience in writing functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, and support documentation.
    Proven experience in SIT/UAT execution, defect management, and business process validation, including integration testing with SAP S/4HANA/ECC, EWM and SAP BN4L,  
    Strong ability to communicate SAP TM topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across the H&M Group.
    Experience with SAP transport and change management tools, such as STMS, Solution Manager, and ActiveControl.
    Experience in developing WRICEF objects (Workflows, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms) from a functional point of view.

Additional beneficial competences:

    Experience working in global SAP rollout and transformation programs.
    ABAP
    Fiori Development

Language Skills:

    Fluent in English.

Additional Information

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

    Staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online.
    Included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.
    Collective Agreement and ITP pensions competitive to Swedish market.
    30 days vacation, health care allowance and good work-life balance.
    Additional perks and discounts from Benify.

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

This is a fulltime permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to agreement. The role is a hybrid position, based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden.

Apply as soon as possible by sending in your CV in English. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. ​We are eager to meet you!
