jobs.title: Test System Engineer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are seeking a proactive and skilled Test system Engineer to develop, maintain, and improve the automation systems used in our advanced testing facilities for power electronics and HVDC converter valves at the HVDC Test Center.

In this role, you will be responsible for PLC programming, HMI development, control system troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of automated test systems. You will also support preventive maintenance activities and ensure the reliability, availability, and safety of critical test equipment and infrastructure.

You will be part of High Voltage Direct Current in Ludvika. We develop, manufacture, and sell DC transmission systems worldwide. HVDC technology is used to transfer electrical energy over long distances, enable power transmission through subsea cables, and connect power grids operating at different frequencies.

This role is based in Ludvika, Sweden.

How you’ll make an impact

    Develop and maintain PLC-based automation and control systems for advanced HVDC test equipment, including MACH.
    Design and enhance HMI solutions to improve usability, efficiency, and operational safety.
    Diagnose and resolve automation, control, and communication issues across complex test environments.
    Lead root cause investigations and drive corrective actions to improve system reliability and performance.
    Support commissioning, upgrades, and lifecycle management of test and automation systems.
    Ensure high equipment availability through preventive maintenance and continuous improvement initiatives.
    Collaborate with engineering, software, and manufacturing teams to deliver robust automation solutions.
    Utilize CMMS and other digital tools to track maintenance activities, equipment performance, and improvement initiatives.
    Ensure compliance with safety standards, regulations, and industrial control system requirements.
    Maintain technical documentation and provide technical guidance on automation systems and test equipment.

Your background

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related field.
    Hands-on experience with PLC programming, troubleshooting, and industrial automation platforms.
    Experience developing and maintaining HMI/SCADA solutions in industrial environments.
    Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Profinet, Profibus, Modbus, Ethernet/IP, or OPC UA.
    Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, control system documentation, and instrumentation drawings.
    Experience troubleshooting automated systems and performing root cause analysis.
    Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to work across multidisciplinary teams.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​

    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​

jobs.title: Research Assistant – CAMELOT: Long-term Climate Governance
jobs.description:
Research Assistant – CAMELOT: Long-term Climate Governance

A 50% Research Assistant position for six months is available in the ERC-funded research project CAMELOT – Capacities for More Effective Long-term Climate Governance, based at Oslo Business School, Oslo Metropolitan University (OsloMet).The research assistant will be based in the academic unit Public Administration and Governance at Oslo Business School.


About CAMELOT

Many of today's most consequential governance challenges, including climate change and Earth system risks, unfold over decades, centuries, or longer. Yet political institutions and decision-making processes often struggle to engage effectively with such long-term futures.

CAMELOT investigates the capacities that enable individuals, groups, and institutions to think about and govern for the long term. The project develops new theory on long-term governance capacities and studies how such capacities can be strengthened through experimental and participatory research. It brings together insights from political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, futures studies, psychology, and related fields.

CAMELOT is a five-year research project funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant and led by associate professor Manjana Milkoreit at OsloMet.


About the position

The Research Assistant will support research within CAMELOT, particularly theoretical and conceptual work on long-term governance capacities (WP1) and the development of experimental research on long-term climate governance (WP2).

Key tasks will include:

  • identifying, collecting, organizing, and synthesizing relevant academic literature across several fields
  • conducting targeted background research and preparing research summaries and short research memos to support the development of academic publications
  • supporting manuscript preparation, including reference management, citation checking, formatting, and preparation of supplementary materials
  • supporting the development of experimental treatments through literature reviews, background research, and preparation of research and design meetings
  • researching potential partners, research sites, and other resources relevant to the development and implementation of CAMELOT's experimental work

Qualification requirements

Applicants should have:

  • a Master's degree, or be close to completing a master's degree, in political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, environmental social science, or another field relevant to CAMELOT
  • strong skills in finding, evaluating, and synthesizing academic literature
  • strong analytical and academic writing skills
  • excellent written and spoken English
  • the ability to work carefully, independently, and systematically while contributing to a collaborative research environment

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, to have experience or demonstrated interest in one or more areas relevant to CAMELOT, such as climate or environmental governance, anticipatory governance, futures studies, political psychology, or experimental social science. Experience with reference-management software and other tools for organizing and synthesizing research literature is also an advantage.

We are looking for an intellectually curious and reliable colleague who is comfortable engaging with research across disciplinary boundaries and learning new areas of scholarship.


Professional development

The position offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience with the development of an ambitious international research project and to work closely with the Principal Investigator and other members of the CAMELOT research team. The Research Assistant will gain experience in advanced literature research and synthesis, conceptual and theoretical research, academic publishing, and the development of experimental social science research.

The position provides exposure to different stages of the research process, from developing ideas and reviewing evidence to designing studies and preparing publications. It may be particularly valuable for someone considering a PhD or another research-oriented career and seeking to strengthen their academic research skills, substantive expertise, and experience of collaborative research.

It is important to OsloMet to reflect the population of our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavors to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to make adaptations to the workplace where required. You are also welcome to apply for a position with us if you have had periods where you have not been in employment, education or training.


We offer
  • exciting job tasks at Norway’s third largest university
  • participation in research groups and a creative and inspiring academic community 
  • opportunities for academic development 
  • a workplace in the center of Oslo 
  • good welfare schemes and a wide range of sports and cultural offers 

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMets pay policy for Research Assistant in code 1020, corresponding to 527 000 NOK per year in a 100 % position. A higher salary may be considered for particularly well-qualified applicants. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK). 

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process 

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.

Please upload the following documents together by the application deadline: 

  • a one-page letter explaining your interest in the position and how your background and skills would enable you to contribute to CAMELOT
  • CV
  • certificates and transcripts 
  • one academic writing sample in English (maximum 15 pages). This may be an excerpt from a master's thesis, seminar paper, published or unpublished manuscript, or another piece of academic work that demonstrates your analytical and writing skills.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered.

jobs.title: Demand Planner
jobs.description:
We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and we’re just getting started.

At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future — and we want you to be part of it.

For this position we are seeking a motivated and curious individual who is proactive, analytical, and organized. You are good at building relationships, comfortable challenging the status quo and can adapt quickly to a fast-paced work environment. Additionally, you should enjoy working both collaboratively and independently. You will report to Johan Törnqvist, Demand Planning Manager.

About the role:

As a Demand Planner within Global Aftermarket Operations, you will work in a dynamic global environment and cross-functionally with sales, marketing, finance, product/part management, projects, quality and supply. Aftermarket plays a vital role in our future ambitions and is a key area of strategic investment. By developing services, spare parts, and customer-focused solutions, we create value long after the initial sale, helping customers get the most out of their products throughout their entire lifecycle.

Our demand planning is based on system generated statistical data-driven forecasts combined with market and product trends that need to be collected from various stakeholders such as sales, product management, quality, projects, etc. This means that collaboration and analytics skills are key. Our forecasting is also exception based driven meaning planning system generates alerts on a daily, weekly and monthly frequency for significant deviations between actual demand and forecasts.

Further key responsibilities:

    Responsible for generating global forecasts at article level for accessories and parts with 24-month rolling horizon and with high forecast accuracy.
    Configurate the system to provide the best statistical forecasts.
    Gather required market and product trends and information from different stakeholders such as Sales, Product/Part Management, Projects, Quality department, etc. to ensure top level forecast accuracy.
    Creating long-term relationships and co-operation with international colleagues within Husqvarna Group.
    Investigate forecast exceptions and determine appropriate actions.
    Ensuring accurate reporting, monitor and analyze of KPIs and take action to improve performance
    Generate and develop reports to analyze and share demand trends with different stakeholders along with reporting and analysis of data for preparing business decisions
    Lead global cross-functional meetings
    Actively contribute and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance higher forecast accuracy, streamline processes and increase efficiency within the demand planning process and planning systems.

Your skills and background

    Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, logistics, business administration or a related field.
    Experience in supply chain, forecasting processes and statistical modelling
    Advanced skills in Excel and excellent presentation and communication skills
    Fluent in English, both in speaking and writing
    Previous experience with demand planning from a global company and advanced global demand planning systems, e.g. Logility as well as experience from aftermarket is highly advantageous.
    Previous experience, knowledge and general curiosity about AI is advantageous.

Location:

This position will be placed in Huskvarna, Sweden. We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, at least 4 days a week (80%), creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making.

Your application:

Please submit your application in English as soon as possible as we will review applications on an ongoing basis. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR.

For questions about the role, reach out to hiring manager Johan Törnqvist, at johan.tornqvist@husqvarnagroup.com.

For questions about the recruitment process, reach out to Talent Acquisition Partner Nina Hallin at nina.hallin@husqvarnagroup.com.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we will ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.    

Our culture is built on three core themes:  

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!  

Learn more about our culture here.

jobs.title: Kundeservice søges til Malta - Betalt relokation
jobs.description:
Kundeservice søges til Malta – God løn, bonus og relocation-pakke

Kunne du tænke dig at kombinere en international karriere med livet på Malta?

Vi søger lige nu en dansktalende Kundeservice til en langsigtet stilling hos en international bank på Malta.

Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor du arbejder med danske kunder og får mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for kundeservice, salg og den finansielle sektor.

Stillingen er særligt interessant for dig, der allerede har erfaring med kundeservice eller salg – og måske har erfaring som Team Leader eller med KPI'er og dataanalyse.

OM JOBBET

Som Kundeservice bliver du en del af et team, der håndterer kundeservice, onboarding, salg og betalinger.

Du vil blandt andet:

• Besvare kundehenvendelser via telefon, live chat, email og SMS

Malta er en populær destination for danskere, der ønsker at kombinere arbejde med livet i udlandet.

Her får du mulighed for at bo på en middelhavsø med et internationalt miljø, gode strande, restauranter, et aktivt socialt liv og masser af muligheder for at opleve øen.

Virksomheden arrangerer blandt andet ugentlige Friday Drinks og forskellige sociale arrangementer, hvor du kan lære dine kollegaer og Malta bedre at kende.

10% bonus udbetalt kvartalsvist

Gratis frugt, brød og morgenmadsprodukter på arbejdspladsen

Friday Drinks og andre sociale arrangementer

Gode muligheder for intern udvikling – både til andre afdelinger og management

Langsigtet kontrakt

HVEM ER DU?

Vi leder efter dig, der:

• Har gode engelskkundskaber både skriftligt og mundtligt

• Har erfaring fra kundeservice eller salg

• Er vant til at arbejde med KPI'er og data

• Er engageret, professionel og ansvarsbevidst

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra kundeservice, salg eller den finansielle sektor, men det vigtigste er, at du er engageret, professionel og pålidelig.

Malta – Msida

40 timer om ugen

Opfølgende reviews efter 1, 3 og 6 måneder

Der er en ledig stilling.

jobs.title: Operatör inom produktion till Epiroc i Fagersta!
jobs.description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Vill du arbeta i en modern produktionsmiljö där säkerhet, kvalitet och samarbete står i fokus? Vi söker nu en operatör till färdigställningsavdelningen i Fagersta.



Bli en del av vårt team



Hos oss blir du en del av Rock Drilling Tools-divisionen, som utvecklar och tillverkar produkter för bergborrning och bergförstärkning. På färdigställningsavdelningen ansvarar vi för det sista steget i produktionsprocessen, där vi säkerställer kvalitet, förstärker materialets egenskaper och förbereder produkterna för slutleverans.







Ditt uppdrag



Som operatör på färdigställningen ansvarar du för drift, operatörsunderhåll och kvalitetskontroller. Utifrån produktionsplaner hanterar du materialflödet och arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med ditt skiftlag för att säkerställa hög kvalitet, leveransprecision och kontinuerliga förbättringar i verksamheten.



Arbetsuppgifter:




    Kulbombning och vakuumblästring för att förstärka materialet och avlägsna restprodukter.
    Manuell och automatisk riktning för att säkerställa att produkterna uppfyller höga krav på rakhet och måttnoggrannhet.
    Målning och slutbehandling inför leverans.
    Kvalitetskontroller, mätningar och avvikelsehantering.
    Drift, övervakning och operatörsunderhåll av produktionsutrustning.



Genom rotation mellan arbetsstationer får du på sikt en varierad vardag och möjlighet att utvecklas inom flera delar av produktionen.





Profile description:

Din profil



Vi söker dig som trivs med att ta ansvar och bidra med initiativ och förbättringsförslag. Du har ett starkt säkerhetstänk där du ser det som en självklarhet att följa säkerhetsrutiner och agera vid risker. Du arbetar noggrant och kvalitetsmedvetet, med förmåga att upptäcka avvikelser och säkerställa att arbetet håller hög standard. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som tycker om att samarbeta med andra och bidra till teamets gemensamma resultat.



För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:




    Eftergymnasial utbildning, gärna med teknisk eller industriteknisk inriktning.
    Praktiskt handlag och gärna erfarenhet av maskiner, verktyg eller industriproduktion.
    Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift, för att kunna ta del av säkerhetsinstruktioner, dokumentation och skiftöverlämningar. Kunskaper i engelska är meriterande.
    Grundläggande datorvana eftersom produktion och avvikelser rapporteras digitalt.



Meriterande




    Erfarenhet från tillverkande industri.
    Truckkort samt B-körkort









We offer:

Placering, arbetstider och omfattning



Tjänsten är placerad i Fagersta, Sverige. Arbetstiden är skiftlagd och omfattar dag-, kvälls-, natt- och helgarbete.



Detta är en visstidsanställning med omgående start till och med den 31 december, med möjlighet till förlängning.







Livet på Epiroc



När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.



Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:




    Globala karriärmöjligheter.
    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.
    Samhällsengagemang.
    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus.







Ansökan och kontaktinformation



Vi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 2/10 2026. Observera att ansökningar granskas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.



Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.







För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta:



Ansvarig chef, Ronnie Bergner, ronnie.bergner@epiroc.com



Rekryteringsspecialist, Erika Örneus, erika.orneus@epiroc.com







Vänligen observera att vi på grund av rådande regelverk inte kan hantera ansökningar som skickas in via e-post.



Vi har redan tagit ställning till annonseringskanaler och konsultleverantörer och undanber oss därför vänligt från att bli kontaktade i sådana frågor.

jobs.title: Det job du rent faktisk fortæller dine venner/veninder om
jobs.description:
De fleste deltidsjobs er til at glemme igen. Man møder ind. Tager sin vagt. Tager hjem.

Det her er ikke helt sådan.

Hos Mano Security bliver du en del af events, koncerter, festivaler og arrangementer, hvor der sker noget omkring dig hele tiden.

Du møder mennesker. Du lærer at kommunikere under pres. Du bliver bedre til at læse situationer og skabe ro, når andre mister overblikket.

Og ja — du får også løn for det.

Hvem er vi?

Vi er et sikkerhedsbureau med mere end 130 ansatte med base i København. Vi opfordrer i høj grad kvinder til at søge.

Vi leverer personale til nogle af Danmarks største venues og arrangementer:

  • Royal Arena

  • Copenhell

  • Forum Copenhagen

  • Copenhagen Fashion Week

  • Spillesteder, studiebarer, gymnasier, konferencer og erhvervsevents

Men det vigtigste for os er faktisk ikke de enkelte events - det er medarbejderne.

Mange af vores ansatte er studerende eller har deltidsjob. Flere læser på universitetet. Andre tager sabbatår eller er i starten af deres karriere. Fælles for dem er, at de gerne vil have et arbejde, hvor man både udvikler sig socialt, menneskeligt og professionelt i følge en vagtplan der er personligt tilpasset lige din kalender.

Jobbet handler ikke om at være “stor og hård”

Det handler om mennesker! De bedste eventvagter er dem, der:

  • kan tale med alle typer mennesker og ved hvad ordet service betyder.

  • kan skabe ro uden konflikt og uden at tabe overblikket selvom det kan gå stærkt.

  • kan være professionel, men stadig med empati

Vi tror langt mere på kommunikation end konfrontation.

Vi tager højde for eksamensperioder, skemaer, andet arbejde osv. Du vælger i høj grad selv, hvornår du arbejder.

Det skal fungere i virkeligheden — ikke kun på papiret.

Du får blandt andet

  • Attraktiv løn og fleksible vagter

  • Grundig oplæring og uddannelse

  • Mulighed for relevante kurser

  • Erfaring med konflikthåndtering og kommunikation

  • Et stærkt socialt fællesskab

  • Et job hvor ingen vagter er helt ens

Og vigtigst af alt:
Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor folk faktisk kender hinanden.

Interesseret?

Send din ansøgning så hurtigt som muligt + CV og et vellignende billede til os, så vil vi glæde os til at læse den :D

Sendes til: info@manosecurity.dk

jobs.title: Nørrevangskirken søger kirketjener
jobs.description:
Stillingsoplysning: Overenskomstansat
Stillingen: 37 timer
Ansøgningsfrist: 8. oktober 2026
Ansøgningen sendes til: noerrevang.sogn@km.dk

Da vores dygtige kirketjener har fået anden ansættelse i det jyske, søger Nørrevangskirken i Nørrevang Sogn, Slagelse en dygtig og engageret kirketjener. Stillingen ønskes besat 1. november eller hurtigst derefter.

Vi søger en medarbejder med uddannelsen som kirketjener, eller en person som er villig til at tage de obligatoriske 5 ugers uddannelse til kirketjener indenfor 2 års ansættelse.

Der er fuld og gensidig vikarforpligtigelse mellem kirketjenerne under ferie, fridage, sygdom og kurser.

Stillingen kræver en selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst medarbejder som har udpræget ordenssans og gerne et praktisk håndelag. En medarbejder som kan lide at møde mange forskellige mennesker og som positivt kan indgå i samarbejdet med kirkens øvrige personale, præster og menighedsrådet.

Du skal kunne mestre selvledelse.

Nogle jobfunktioner foregår udenfor normal arbejdstid, sent om eftermiddagen, om aftenen eller i weekenden. Der er altid en kirketjener til stede ved bisættelser, vielser og højmesser.

En stor del af arbejdsopgaverne udgør rengøring, vedligeholdelse, pyntning, indkøb og forberedelse af arrangementer og aktiviteter hen over kirkeåret. Du skal have flair for planlægning, servering og anretning af mad.

Forberedelse og oprydning i forbindelse med kirkelige arrangementer, flytning af borde og stole, åbning og låsning af kirken, flagning, snerydning og græsklipning. Ligeledes indgå i samarbejde med vores 2 præster i forhold til ind- og udgangsbøn samt nadver.

Du og din familie skal være indstillet på tjenester i julen, påsken og andre helligdage, ligesom festgudstjenester, receptioner, bisættelse og koncerter. Ved kirkens begivenheder vil du være den første vores kirkegængere og besøgende møder.

I løbet af efteråret startes arbejdet på en udvidelse af sognegården med en tilbygning på 300 m2, som vil kræve fleksibilitet og samarbejde af alle.

Du vil være den første vores kirkegængere og besøgende møder. Derfor skal du kunne optræde engageret, imødekommende, venligt og myndigt. Bevare ro og overblik i travle situationer.

Ansættelsen er omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer, og Organisationsaftalen for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som kirketjener eller graver mellem Kirkeministeriet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening og det tilhørende protokollat for kirketjenere. Aftalen kan ses på www.folkekirkenspersonale.dk.

Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte kirketjenere har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen.

Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 324.677,00 til 408.841,00 kr. Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen.

Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 33.231,00 kr. OK tillæg på 1.401,00 kr. år

Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og Danmarks kirketjenerforening.

Stillingen har 3 måneders prøvetid.

Nærmere oplysninger om stillingen fås ved henvendelse til formand for menighedsrådet, Birgit Rømer på mobil 2874 3843 eller personaleansvarlig, Susanne Hansen på mobil 4035 7298. Du kan også kontakte kirketjener, Lærke Pil Olsen på mobil 6080 3103.

Der vil blive indhentet referencer, straffeattest og børneattest i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes til e-mail: noerrevang.sogn@km.dk. Ansøgningen skal være menighedsrådet i hænde senest torsdag den 8. oktober 2026, kl. 12.00.

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes at finde sted i uge 43.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Brukerstyrt personlig assistent søker
jobs.employer: TØNSBERG KOMMUNE - BPA - BRUKERSTYRT PERSONLIG ASSISTANSE
jobs.description:
Jeg er en positiv og humørfylt dame på 65 år som søker helgevikarer til min BPA-ordning. Jeg bor sammen med min mann og katten vår i et stort og godt tilrettelagt hus.

Jeg har assistanse mandag til fredag, men trenger nå pålitelige og omsorgsfulle assistenter som kan jobbe fast på dagen i helger, lørdag og søndag.

Kanskje dette er noe for deg?

Om meg

Jeg er glad i mennesker, og har godt humør.

På grunn av en langtkommende  MS-diagnose er jeg avhengig av hjelp til det meste i hverdagen. Jeg bruker rullestol og flere tekniske hjelpemidler, blant annet personløfter, pustemaskin og hostemaskin. Jeg får også sondemat.

Jeg søker gjerne en dame som trives med å hjelpe andre mennesker og som ikke er redd for nye utfordringer. Relevant utdanning er ikke et krav, men helsefagarbeidere oppfordres til å søke.

Det viktigste er at du er:

  • Utadvendt og har godt humør
  • Ansvarsbevisst og pålitelig
  • Selvstendig og løsningsorientert
  • Fleksibel og i stand til å ta ting på sparket
  • Tålmodig og omsorgsfull
  • Har god fysisk og psykisk helse

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet bestå av:

  • Hjelp til personlig hygiene
  • På- og avkledning
  • Skifte av stomier
  • Forflytning og bruk av hjelpemidler
  • Bistand ved måltider og sondemat
  • Praktiske og dagligdagse gjøremål i hjemmet
  • Sosial støtte og tilstedeværelse i hverdagen

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker er en fordel
  • Evne til å arbeide selvstendig
  • Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
  • Språkkrav tilsvarende nivå B2 for faglærte og ufaglærte
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt
  • Førerkort klasse B er ønskelig men ikke nødvendig
  • Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før ansettelse

Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfull og variert jobb
  • Grundig opplæring
  • Arbeid i et hyggelig hjemmemiljø
  • Mulighet til å gjøre en viktig forskjell i hverdagen til et annet menneske

Jeg ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Søknader behandles fortløpende.

 


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Velkommen til Tønsberg, byen som har holdt koken siden vikingtiden. Dette er byen som vet hvordan vi kombinerer historie, skjærgård og kulturliv, noe som er en uslåelig kombinasjon. Selv med vår sentrale plassering på Østlandet (en time fra Oslo og 20 minutter til Torp flyplass), kan du fortsatt kalle naturen for «nabo» og nyte en kaffepause med utsikt mot Oslofjorden. Tønsberg kommune er ikke bare en kommune som rommer 59 000 innbyggere. Det er også en arbeidsplass for over 4000 mennesker. Her skal arbeidsdagen innebære mer enn å telle timer. I Tønsberg kommune har du mulighet til å utvikle deg, le litt (eller kanskje mye) med kollegaer, og rom til å være deg selv. Er du klar for å jobbe i en kommune med ambisjoner for fremtiden, hvor du kan balansere jobb og fritid med skjærgård, skog, kultur eller byliv rett utenfor døren? Da venter Tønsberg kommune på deg. Er du videre nysgjerrig på Tønsberg kommune som arbeidsplass, eller et sted å flytte til? Mer informasjon finner du her: https://www.tonsberg.kommune.no https://tonsberglivet.no

jobs.title: Ei blid og aktiv jente på 11 år søker etter omsorgsfulle assistenter 🌺
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Fortløpende
📌 Stillingstype: Tilkalling
⏰ Arbeidstid: Kvelder i ukedager, samt noe ferie

Heisann! Jeg er en jente på 11 år som bor på et lite småbruk i Trøgstad sammen med min familie. Jeg elsker å være ute, dra på sykkelturer, ake på vinteren, høre på musikk og smake på god mat. Terapiridning, håndball og bading er en stor favoritt, og jeg liker å ha det gøy! Jeg er stort sett blid og full av energi. Selv om jeg ikke snakker, er det lett å lese på meg om jeg er glad eller ei. Noen dager er jeg full av energi og på jakt etter nye opplevelser, mens andre dager liker jeg å ha det rolig og bare slappe av i mitt eget selskap, derfor er det viktig at du er tålmodig og fleksibel.

Jeg har forsinket utvikling og epilepsi og sitter i rullestol. Derfor trenger jeg en superassistent som kan hjelpe meg med alt fra mat og stell, til forflytning og fritidsaktiviteter. En drømmedag for meg er at du kommer og henter meg på skolen, tar meg med på kjekke aktiviteter og at jeg får kjenne litt på friheten av å være selvstendig - uten at mamma og pappa alltid må være med! Kanskje vi kan dra å bade sammen?

Jeg ser nå etter noen initiativrike og omsorgsfulle assistenter som er glad i å være aktiv og ute i naturen. Det er krav om førerkort, da vi gjerne tar oss noen turer sammen, kun du og meg. Jeg har egen tilpasset bil, så du trenger kun førerkort klasse B (automat). Tørr du å by på seg selv og spre godt humør? Da er dette jobben for deg!

Stillings og arbeidstid:

Jeg søker nå etter 1-2 fleksible tilkallingsvikarer. Arbeidstiden vil være fra kl. 14:00 til 21:30 i ukedager, samt noen ferier.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

· Bistå med måltider

· Hente meg på skolen

· Forflytning, både med og uten hjelpemidler

· Følge til fritidsaktiviteter

· Kjøre meg til og fra fritidsaktiviteter

· Personlig stell

· Praktisk bistand i hjemmet

· Være min lekekamerat og gjøre dagene mine morsomme og meningsfulle

Kvalifikasjoner:

· Du bør være glad i å være aktiv og tilbringe tid utendørs

· Personlig egnethet og kjemi vektlegges

· Glad i å jobbe med mennesker

· Krav om B2 i norsk

· Førerkort klasse B, automat

· Fremlegge gyldig politiattest

Personlige egenskaper:

· By på deg selv - utadvendt

· Godt humør

· Tålmodig og omsorgsfull

· Kunne løfte noe tungt

· Initiativrik

· Se muligheter fremfor begrensninger

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Karen Tonette Bulæg på epost karen.bulag@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Experiment Support and Instrument Technician
jobs.description:
The company
The ILL is an international research facility at the forefront of neutron science and technology. Its High-Flux Nuclear Reactor delivers the world's most intense neutron beams to a suite of over 40 scientific instruments. Every year, some 1800 international researchers visit the ILL to carry out cutting-edge experiments across a range of scientific disciplines, driving innovation in the fields of health, energy, the environment and quantum materials. The ILL is also involved in the production of radioisotopes for medical applications. The ILL employs over 500 staff from 25 different countries, in a diversity of careers and a multicultural and inclusive environment.

The Science Division at ILL brings together close to 200 scientists, engineers, and technicians who work collaboratively to provide users with advanced experimental capabilities and expert scientific support. The DS is responsible by operating world-class neutron scattering instruments, supporting an international user community, conducting cutting-edge research, and developing new experimental techniques. In addition, the division drives the development of next-generation instrumentation and computational tools, fosters international collaborations, and contributes to advanced training.

About the position
As an experiment support and instrument technician, you will be responsible for the operation and development of experimental equipment and for providing support for experiments conducted at the ILL.
You will work closely with the scientists in charge of the instruments you will be assigned to. You will also collaborate with the other technicians in the Spectroscopy group. You will act as technical contact for the instrument WASP within this group. Depending on the needs of the different groups, you may be asked to work in parallel on other instruments within the Spectroscopy group.

Your tasks
Your main duties will involve the following:
-    Performing maintenance work and repairs on instruments and their ancillary equipment
-    Assisting in-house and visiting scientists with the preparation of their experiments
-    Designing new equipment in collaboration with ILL scientists and technical support groups
-    Improving the instruments and the way in which experiments are conducted by devising innovative technical solutions
-    Performing precision machining of simple mechanical parts (lathing, milling, drilling) at short notice
-    Installing, maintaining and operating sample environment equipment (cryostats, furnaces, etc.)
-    Organising the purchase of new equipment and spare parts

Desired profile
-    You have a Level 4/5 qualification (e.g. NVQ, BTEC HNC/HND or equivalent) in mechanical, maintenance or electronic engineering.
-    You have experience in the assembly and alignment of precision mechanical assemblies.
-    You have knowledge of CAD software.
-    Experience in scientific instrumentation, in particular in the field of cryogenics, would be an advantage.
-    You must have a sound knowledge of English and be willing to learn French (a language course will be paid for by the ILL).

Benefits
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

jobs.title: PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance
jobs.description:
PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance

Oslo Business School at Oslo Metropolitan University (OsloMet) invites applications for a temporary position as PhD scholar in long-term climate governance. The position is connected to the ERC-funded research project CAMELOT – Capacities for More Effective Long-term Climate Governance and is expected to start in April 2027.

The position is three years full-time but can be extended to four years if teaching assignments are included. The PhD Research Fellow will be based in the academic unit Public Administration and Governance at Oslo Business School and will be enrolled in OsloMet's PhD programme in Social Sciences, specialization Business Administration, Innovation and Governance (BIG).

The successful candidate is expected to complete the doctoral degree during the period of employment.


About CAMELOT

Many of today's most consequential governance challenges, including climate change and Earth system risks, unfold over decades, centuries, or longer. Yet political institutions and decision-making processes often struggle to engage effectively with such long-term futures.

CAMELOT investigates the capacities that enable individuals, groups, and institutions to think about and govern for the long term. The project develops new theory on long-term governance capacities and studies whether and how such capacities can be strengthened through experimental and participatory research. It brings together insights from political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, futures studies, psychology, and related fields.

CAMELOT is a five-year research project funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant and led by Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit at OsloMet.

CAMELOT project website


About the PhD project

The PhD scholar will develop an independent research project that contributes to CAMELOT's overarching objective of understanding and strengthening capacities for long-term climate governance.

The project should be theoretically informed and empirically grounded and involve original empirical research designed and conducted by the PhD candidate. The research may build on, extend, or enable comparisons with research undertaken elsewhere in CAMELOT, but should not depend on data collection undertaken in other parts of the project.

We welcome innovative proposals addressing questions related to long-term governance capacities. Possible research directions include, but are not limited to:

  • investigating how narratives and stories about long-term climate futures influence imagination, understanding, attitudes, decision-making, or other capacities relevant to long-term governance
  • examining how engagement with long-term climate futures differs across climate risks, Earth system tipping elements, audiences, social groups, professional communities, or political and cultural contexts
  • studying how scenarios, foresight, simulations, serious games, or other futures-oriented interventions affect capacities for anticipatory and long-term governance
  • developing and evaluating educational or professional interventions designed to strengthen capacities for engaging with long-term climate futures
  • investigating whether and under what conditions changes in long-term governance capacities translate into changes in reasoning, decision-making, or action

Applicants are encouraged to propose original research questions and approaches that extend beyond these examples while demonstrating a clear connection to CAMELOT's overarching research agenda.

A range of methodological approaches may be appropriate, including quantitative, qualitative, experimental, and mixed-methods research. The proposed research must be feasible within the period of employment.

The candidate will conduct their own research while working closely with the CAMELOT team. They will benefit from interaction with CAMELOT's theoretical, experimental, and participatory research and may develop complementary or comparative studies building on concepts, methods, interventions, or findings developed within the project.


Qualification requirements

We are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

  • master's degree of 120 ECTS or equivalent in political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, sociology, psychology, futures studies, science and technology studies, human geography, or another field relevant to the position
  • grade of B or better on both the master's thesis and the master's degree overall, or an equivalent academic record
  • demonstrate knowledge of research methods relevant to the proposed PhD project
  • strong analytical and academic writing skills
  • excellent written and spoken English

Candidates who are close to completing their master's degree may apply, provided that the degree is completed before the start of the position.

It will be an advantage

It will be considered an advantage to have knowledge of or previous research experience related to one or more of the following areas: climate or environmental governance; public policy; long-term or anticipatory governance; futures and foresight; environmental or political psychology; narratives and communication; Earth system risks and tipping points; or experimental and intervention-based social science.

Experience with empirical data collection and analysis, participation in research projects, academic publishing, or interdisciplinary research will also be considered an advantage.

General criteria for employment as a Research Fellow are stipulated in the Regulations relating to the Universities and University Colleges Act. 

Admission to the doctoral program is a prerequisite. Admission to the doctoral program is based on a comprehensive assessment of the application, including the relevance and quality of the project description. A finalized project plan for the employment period is required completed and acknowledged within 3 months from the date of employment.

See information about admission criteria to the PhD-programme.

It is important for OsloMet to reflect the diverse and multicultural populationof our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavors to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work or have been studying or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment working at the intersection of climate governance, public policy, futures research, and the social sciences.

The position offers:

  • exciting job tasks at Norway’s third largest university
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • three-year full-time position with 100% salary; possibility to extend to 4 years with teaching duties
  • beneficial pension arrangements with the Norwegian State Pension Fund 
  • good employee welfare arrangements
  • free Norwegian classes to employees
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers
  • close integration into the ERC-funded CAMELOT research team and the Public Administration and Governance research environment at Oslo Business School
  • close supervision and intellectual exchange with researchers working on long-term governance, climate governance, experimental social science, futures and anticipation, and science-policy engagement

The position provides an opportunity to develop an independent scholarly profile while being embedded in a larger international research project with strong connections to academic and policy communities.

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMets pay policy for PhD Candidate in code 1017), corresponding to 550 800 NOK per year. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK). (double check salary in the salary plan booklet and pay scales set by OsloMet).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process 

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.

Please upload the following documents together by the application deadline: 

  • an application letter (maximum two pages) explaining your motivation for applying and how your background, research interests, and experience are relevant to the position 
  • a project proposal (maximum five pages, excluding references), following the requirements above
  • CV

jobs.title: Material modelling engineer
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our dynamic Turbine Mechanical Integrity team as a Material Model Engineer! Imagine being at the forefront of innovation, where you will engage in the entire process—from test planning to the development and implementation of material models that are essential for our engineering team. You will collaborate closely with our colleagues in the materials laboratory, ensuring that your contributions directly impact our projects. Our team tackles a variety of tasks, including finite element (FE) analysis, alloy development, constitutive modeling, and methodology development, while also providing vital support to workshops, procurement, and service.



How You’ll Make an Impact



    Develop, implement, and enhance constitutive and life material models for high-temperature applications.
    Contribute to the development of methodologies and procedures for constitutive and life material modeling.
    Support development and technology projects by assessing, planning, and evaluating material testing.
    Provide assistance in response to inquiries from manufacturing and customers.



What You Bring



    A Ph.D. in Solid Mechanics or a related field.
    Extensive expertise in material modeling, backed by several years of experience and a solid theoretical foundation.
    Experience with FE analysis for lifing calculations, along with a strong understanding of relevant principles and methodologies.
    Proficiency in English, both verbal and written.
    A collaborative mindset paired with strong communication skills.

You will be part of an experienced team with diverse backgrounds and responsibilities. We strive to support one another and build a strong technical knowledge base within the team. Our commitment to developing long-term competencies makes us an ideal environment for individuals eager to grow and advance their careers alongside us.



Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.



We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.



Who is Siemens Energy?

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.title: Accounting Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an Accounting Business Analyst for a company in Stockholm. Start is ASAP, 9 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Stockholm.



Accounting Business Analyst

We are seeking a highly experienced accounting specialists for a consulting assignment within a large-scale financial transformation initiative.

The role requires strong hands-on experience in accounting and reconciliation of financial records in a complex enterprise environment. You are expected to independently analyse, design and document financial business processes from multiple front-end systems, detail resulting accounting patterns, in a complex enterprise environment.

﻿

ART Initiative

The company is running an initiative called ART, Accounting and Reporting Transformation, with the objective of moving accounting functionality from several legacy accounting solutions to a new cloud-based solution.

Integration with other systems is ongoing, including business applications delivering accounting data, source systems, and downstream consumers of accounting and reporting information.

﻿

The initiative includes several agile teams working across IT development, integration, infrastructure, security, and business processes. The solution includes development of customized bank-specific functionality running on dedicated server instances in the Oracle sovereign cloud, updates to legacy systems, and configuration and integration of an accounting SaaS solution provided by Oracle.

﻿

Required Skills & Experience

Strong ability to analyse accounting, reconciliation and reporting requirements and translate them into process descriptions, accounting patterns and system requirements

Hands-on and broad accounting experience and confident in describing accounting scenarios, for example using T-accounts

Strong ability to train and coach end-users to confidently and efficiently use the resulting accounting solutions

Experience in planning, preparing and executing tests of financial processes and accounting solutions in a large, multinational enterprise

Experience with financial services, accounting, regulatory reporting, and other highly regulated business domains

Experience working in agile development teams and collaborating across application, integration, test, and business functions

Strong written and spoken English communication skills

﻿

Education

Master’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field

Equivalent professional experience may be considered

﻿

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in integrating large scale and custom business applications using Oracle Financials Cloud or similar, comprehensive accounting system

Experience in Change Management, organizational transformation, and user training

﻿

Key Responsibilities

Analyse functional and non-functional requirements and translate those into accounting and configuration specifications

Translate business, accounting, reporting and reconciliation requirements into implementable system requirements

Support configuration, operation, and maintenance of an accounting solution based on Oracle Financials Cloud and other supporting financial solutions

Pragmatic mindset and ability to balance long-term targets with delivery needs

Effective communicator with both technical and business stakeholders

Comfortable working across accounting, system, reporting, and operational boundaries

Collaborative and team-oriented, with experience from agile environments

Proactive in identifying risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities

jobs.title: Lead Project Leader - AWS AI
jobs.employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
jobs.description:
Job ID: 6456

Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced AWS AI Lead Project Leader to drive the delivery and governance of Nordea’s AWS-based AI platform initiatives.

In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional delivery across AWS cloud foundations, AI platform capabilities, security, data and engineering. You will help establish governed, scalable and reusable services that enable AI use cases across Nordea, while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, regulatory and operational requirements.

You will translate strategic AI and cloud ambitions into executable plans, coordinate dependencies across multiple technology domains and provide clear, transparent reporting to senior stakeholders.

About our team

Core Technology Change & Delivery team is responsible for the Project & Programme management, the delivery & execution and governance of our Change Initiatives  to ensure we meet our commitments in adherence to our Core Tech Operating Model and according to Nordea Delivery Guide.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Lead end-to-end delivery of AWS AI platform initiatives, from scope definition and planning through implementation, operational readiness and handover.
    Establish and maintain delivery plans covering milestones, dependencies, resources, financials, risks and expected outcomes.
    Coordinate delivery across cloud engineering, architecture, security, identity and access management, network, data, platform engineering and business teams.
    Drive the evolution of AWS cloud foundations required for scalable AI adoption, including landing-zone capabilities, deployment pipelines, runtime environments, connectivity and platform resilience.
    Enable reusable AWS AI services and platform components that support multiple AI use cases and teams across the organisation.
    Ensure alignment between business needs, AI use cases, platform capabilities, enterprise architecture and technology roadmaps.
    Facilitate governance and approval processes in line with internal policies, regulatory requirements and Nordea’s delivery framework.
    Establish clear decision-making forums, delivery standards, operating models and reporting practices.
    Proactively manage delivery risks, issues and cross-domain dependencies, escalating when required to maintain predictable execution.
    Drive operational readiness, including support models, service ownership, resilience, security, cost management and transition to operations.
    Engage senior stakeholders and provide concise, decision-oriented updates on delivery status, risks, financials and required actions.
    Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement.



Your background and skills include:

    Proven track record of leading complex technology programmes in AWS Cloud environments.
    Strong experience in AWS platform governance, cloud operating models, landing-zone implementation and platform evolution.
    Ability to scope, drive and govern AWS AI platform initiatives that provide reusable capabilities for scalable AI adoption.
    Experience leading delivery of AWS-native AI, machine learning and data services, with a clear understanding of how platform capabilities enable business use cases.
    Strong understanding of AI enablement platforms, including Generative AI, large language models, agentic or orchestration frameworks and model lifecycle management.
    Experience coordinating delivery across architecture, cloud engineering, security, identity and access management, network, data and platform teams.
    Ability to translate AI and AWS platform roadmaps into executable programmes, milestones and delivery plans.
    Strong understanding of platform-oriented delivery, including shared services, reusable components, automated onboarding and self-service capabilities.
    Experience establishing governance frameworks, delivery standards and operating models for large-scale cloud transformations.
    Understanding of cloud security, resilience, scalability, operational excellence and cost-management principles.
    Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders, facilitate decisions and influence cross-functional teams.
    Very good financial, resource, risk and dependency-management skills.
    Very good analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to turn complex information into clear recommendations and actions.
    Advanced presentation and reporting skills, particularly using PowerPoint and Excel.
    Excellent communication skills and the ability to bring clarity in both written and verbal communication.
    Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.
    A proactive, pragmatic and solution-oriented attitude.

The role is specifically positioned around Nordea’s AWS AI platform rather than generic multi-cloud delivery. This is consistent with the planned AWS capabilities for enterprise-scale AI adoption and the current focus on a governed, scalable platform supporting AWS ecosystems.

What we offer

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

jobs.title: International Trainee - Property Development and Construction Management
jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Om rollen

Shape the future of energy.

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.



About the traineeship.  

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.

What you will experience

    Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.
    Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.
    Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”  

  

Your role as a Trainee - Property Development and Construction Management

You will join Property Development and Construction Management. We are involved in all phases of project development, from early-stage feasibility studies and planning to project execution and completion. Our focus is on managing and addressing construction-related issues throughout the development process to ensure successful project delivery.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to participate in and support feasibility studies, including meetings and activities aimed at enabling efficient project delivery. You will also gain experience in later project phases, working alongside Construction Managers on tasks such as cost control, contractor management, risk management, and other construction-related matters.

This is an excellent opportunity to gain insight into the entire construction and development process and contribute throughout all project phases. Typical responsibilities may include participating in, and eventually supporting, Real Estate Developers in negotiations and project planning during the early stages of development. You will also assist Construction Managers in documenting project deficiencies and quality issues, and over time develop the ability to independently evaluate construction-related challenges and propose solutions under the guidance of experienced colleagues.



Your responsibilities:  

    Support Construction Managers with the documentation of construction-related defects and project issues
    Participate in technical drawing reviews to ensure compliance with project requirements and construction standards.
    Support real estate developers in managing construction-related matters during feasibility study phase and early-stage project development.
    Provide administrative support across construction and development projects
    Collaborate with internal teams and external contractors to support efficient project delivery.

Kravspecifikation

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Property Development and Construction Management

    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Urban Development and Infrastructure, or a related field.
    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

You should also recognize yourself in

    You are comfortable navigating different perspectives and balancing the interests of multiple stakeholders.
    You are proactive, curious, and eager to take initiative while maintaining a humble attitude and a willingness to learn.
    You are open-minded and receptive to new ideas, while also able to make sound decisions when needed.
    You have strong communication and collaboration skills and enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams.

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”  

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:  

    Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027
    Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
    Be fluent in English
    Be available for the full-time programme from its start date
    Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
    Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.
    Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.

Location:

You will be working in the department Construction and Property Development and be located in Solna, Trollhättan or Gothenburg, (Sweden).

Ytterligare information

Our offer

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe.

jobs.title: Training Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Wärtsilä Land & Sea Academy (WLSA) is responsible for delivering high-quality learning services to customers and employees around the world. Our training portfolio supports Wärtsilä's innovative technologies and solutions across the marine and energy sectors, helping customers develop the skills needed for a more sustainable future.


We are now looking for an enthusiastic Training Coordinator to join our Training Coordination team in Vaasa, Finland. Whilst we offer hybrid working, the operational nature of our business often requires attendance on site, and occasional flexibility outside normal working hours may be required.

In this role, you will be at the heart of our global training operations, working closely with customers, instructors, sales teams, and business stakeholders to ensure an outstanding learning experience from initial enquiry to training completion. You will combine customer service, operational coordination, digital tools, and continuous improvement to deliver successful training programmes that create value for our customers and Wärtsilä.


If you enjoy working in an international environment, building strong relationships, and coordinating multiple activities simultaneously, this could be your next career opportunity.



What will you be doing?


As a Training Coordinator, you will manage and coordinate the end-to-end training delivery process while ensuring a seamless customer experience.


Your responsibilities will include:


Training Operations



* Coordinate training delivery activities at the Vaasa Training Centre and other assigned learning environments.
* Manage course scheduling, participant registrations, notifications, reporting, and training documentation.
* Maintain training records and related data in SAP, Learning Management Systems, and other digital platforms.
* Coordinate resources (instructors, classrooms, workshop) allocation.
* Support training delivery and help resolve operational challenges quickly and effectively.
* Monitor customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve services and processes.



Customer and Business Support


* Support the planning, promotion, and execution of training activities for internal and external customers.
* Create and maintain training offerings and service packages.
* Collaborate with sales, account management, contract management, and business stakeholders to promote learning solutions.
* Support internal and external communication activities related to training services.


What will help you succeed?



We are looking for someone who combines strong coordination skills with a passion for customer service and continuous improvement.


You will ideally have:



* A Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Experience with Learning management systems (LMS), training administration, learning operations, customer service, project coordination, or a similar role.
* Experience working with SAP and Salesforce would be considered an advantage.
* Strong digital skills and confidence in learning new systems and technologies.
* Excellent, organisational and multitasking abilities. You will be adept at coordinating evolving requirements and will frequently need to adapt to factors outside your control.
* A structured and detail-oriented way of working.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A proactive mindset and ability to identify and implement improvements.
* Ability to work under pressure and prioritise tasks effectively. You will be empowered to make decisions within your scope to advance your workload.
* A customer-focused approach and commitment to delivering high-quality service.
* Fluent English skills, both written and spoken.
* Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.


Why join us?


At Wärtsilä Land & Sea Academy, you will become part of a global learning organisation that plays a key role in developing the competencies needed for the future of energy and marine industries. We believe that great results come from empowered people. We encourage ownership, accountability, and collaboration, creating an environment where individuals can contribute, develop, and make a meaningful difference.


As part of our global learning organisation, you will work alongside experienced professionals in a culture built on respect, inclusion, and continuous learning. We value openness, encourage new ideas, and see challenges as opportunities to improve. Everyone is encouraged to bring their authentic self to work and contribute their unique perspective.


We particularly appreciate candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and commitment to professional growth. Experience gained across different functions, projects, or disciplines is highly valued, as it helps us build agile teams capable of supporting a diverse and evolving business environment.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:

    Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027
    Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
    Be fluent in English
    Be available for the full-time programme from its start date
    Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
    Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.
    Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.

Location:

You will be working in the department Group Strategy and located in Stockholm (Solna), Sweden.

Additional Information

Our offer

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe. We all feel part of a movement that understands the importance of human connection, resilience, and curiosity in energy transition and sustainability.” - Rogier, former International Trainee based in Amsterdam.

The Vattenfall International Trainee Programme is the kickstart of your career within Vattenfall. Over the course of a year, you will combine meaningful work with structured development opportunities, networking, workshops and site visits across Vattenfall's business areas and locations. Each position comes with a competitive salary and excellent remuneration package. Read more about the elements of the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme here.

Application process

We welcome your application in English via the application button on this page. Please include an updated resume. When applying, you will fill out screening questions, including your motivation. No cover letter or motivation letter is needed. The deadline to apply is October 18th, 2026. Selection will start after the application period with online tests, followed by interviews between the end of October to end November.

jobs.title: IT Support to Paradox Interactive!
jobs.description:
Step into a tech adventure with Padarox Interactive! A unique opportunity for a gaming enthusiast to dive into a diverse role, tackling everything from software wizardry to hardware magic. Join a team that values your passion for technology and offers a vibrant, inclusive culture.

About the role

Paradox Interactive is one of the premier game developers and publishers of strategy and management games on PC and consoles! In this position, you'll play a crucial role in providing day-to-day technical support to your colleagues in the organization. You together with a team of 10 will provide seamless support to 800 colleagues in multiple global offices.

Responsible for day-to-day technical support, your role includes troubleshooting hardware and software issues both on-site and remotely. You play a vital role in the smooth onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring the seamless integration of hardware, software, and other services. Additionally, you take charge of the functionality of conference rooms and office IT equipment, ensuring a conducive environment for smooth operations.

You are offered

    Great culture with social hours, board games, and quiz nights
    A great role to deepen your knowledge within tech
    A dedicated consultant manager from Academic Work who will support and coach you in your future career

Work tasks

    Configure and troubleshoot software for seamless operations both on site and remote  
    Install and set up new computers, addressing hardware issues  
    Provide remote support to offices globally, contributing to a smooth tech environment  
    Collaborate with the support team on projects for infrastructure scaling and updates  
    Ensure the functionality of conference rooms and office IT equipment

We are looking for

    Work experience in IT support/IT related customer service
    Has an interest in hardware and technology
    Good knowledge of English in both speech and writing as it is used in daily work

It is meritorious if you have

    

● Worked in onsite experience in IT support previously

● Prior experience in networking and/or PC hardware troubleshooting

● Gaming interest

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:

    Service-minded
    Curious nature
    Problem solver
    Adaptable

Paradox value attitude and personality. They seek individuals with a positive mindset, knowledge of technology, and a genuine interest in providing top-notch service. It's also important that you thrive in a culture where they embrace diversity in cultures, geographies, and languages.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

AD-Krossin Autokorjaamo on monipuolinen autokorjaamo, joka huoltaa ja korjaa henkilö- ja pakettiautoja merkistä ja iästä riippumatta. Etsimme joukkoon kokenutta ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevää ammattilaista, jolla on vahva käytännön osaaminen.

- Henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjaustöitä
- Määräaikaishuoltoja
- Moottori-, jarru-, alusta- ja voimansiirtotöitä
- Kytkin- ja jakohihnatöitä
- Vikadiagnostiikkaa ja vianmääritystä
- Muita korjaamon huolto- ja korjaustehtäviä
