jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
We at Rocsole are experts in electrical tomography and its application to industrial process monitoring. Our unique SeeBeyond technology helps customers detect and visualize liquids, solids, and interfaces in demanding industrial environments. Our LiquiDetect and SoliDetect products support safer, more efficient, and more sustainable operations. Our customers include major industrial and energy companies around the world.

We are looking for an **Automation Engineer** to join **#TeamROCSOLE**!

In this position, you will create and maintain electrical and automation documentation for Rocsole products, including wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, cable drawings, and other related technical documentation. You will provide technical support throughout the product lifecycle and contribute to customer projects, commissioning activities, troubleshooting, and after-sales support together with Rocsoles Technical Support team.

You will work closely with our product development, production, and technical support professionals. Your responsibilities will include supporting electrical and functional testing, maintaining accurate product documentation, and ensuring that product modifications are properly reflected in drawings and technical materials.

You will also participate in factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), commissioning, and startup activities. When required, you will support customers remotely or on-site. Occasional international travel is therefore part of the role.

The right candidate is a structured and detail-oriented professional with strong problem-solving skills. You are comfortable working independently, but you also collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers, and other stakeholders. You take pride in producing accurate technical documentation and providing professional support in practical engineering situations.

**Your main responsibilities will include:**

- Creating and maintaining wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, cable drawings, and related technical documentation for Rocsole products

- Ensuring that electrical documentation meets Rocsoles quality standards, applicable requirements, and customer needs

- Updating drawings and documentation when product modifications and engineering changes are implemented

- Supporting production personnel with electrical and automation-related technical issues

- Supporting electrical and functional testing of products before shipment

- Participating in verification and validation activities for new products and product modifications

- Supporting commissioning and startup activities together with Rocsoles Technical Support Specialist

- Participating in factory acceptance testing (FAT) and site acceptance testing (SAT)

- Providing remote and on-site technical support when required


**We expect you to have:**

- A bachelors degree or equivalent qualification in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or another relevant technical field

- Relevant work experience in electrical schematic and wiring diagram design

- Experience with SolidWorks Electrical, DraftSight, or equivalent electrical design tools

- Basic knowledge of PLCs and automation systems

- Strong attention to detail and a structured, systematic approach to your work

- Good problem-solving, communication, and customer service skills

- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

- Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English

- Willingness to travel internationally on occasion


Equivalent competence acquired through relevant work experience may also be considered.

**The following will be considered an advantage:**

- Experience in designing and documenting 230 VAC industrial electrical systems

- A valid SFS 6002 Electrical Safety Training certificate

- Knowledge of the SFS 6000 electrical installation standards

- Experience with industrial instrumentation and sensors

- Experience with industrial communication networks

- Understanding of Ex, ATEX, or IECEx requirements


Our company embraces personal and professional growth. If you are looking for practical engineering challenges and an opportunity to develop your expertise in industrial automation, instrumentation, and sensor technology, this could be the right place for you.

Our office is located in Kuopio, Finland, where your workstation and colleagues are waiting for you. The position is full-time and permanent. Occasional international travel is required.

**We shape the future of industrial process monitoring. Come join us! More info at: https://rocsole.co/AutEng**

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in fairness in artificial intelligence
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in fairness in artificial intelligence, available at the Department of Informatics, in the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group.

Starting date as soon as possible/by agreement. The fellowship period is three (3) years.

Depending on the candidate and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended either for compulsory work consisting of e.g., teaching and supervision duties and research assistance up top four years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is the Department of Informatics at Blindern, Oslo. 


Project description

The PhD fellow will be affiliated with the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group at the Department of Informatics and supervised by associate professor Anne-Marie George.

We are looking for a motivated and academically strong candidate to work on a project within fairness in artificial intelligence and machine learning. The candidate will investigate how to formally define, measure and reconcile different, at times conflicting, notions of fairness in AI systems, as well as the theoretical relationships between them.

Possible directions for the project include (the final scope will be developed together with the candidate, and it is not necessary to cover all topics):

  • Group fairness: developing and analysing algorithms and metrics for ensuring fair treatment of groups defined by protected attributes (e.g. gender, age, ethnicity, …).
  • Theoretical relations between fairness notions: studying the mathematical relationships, trade-offs, and impossibility results connecting different fairness definitions.
  • Intersectional fairness: exploring fairness guarantees for combinations of multiple protected attributes, and addressing the challenges of subgroup fairness, such as computational complexity, statistical reliability and data sparsity for fine-grained subgroups.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in informatics/computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a closely related field. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Documented competence in machine learning at Master level
  • Documented programming skills
  • Minimum three documented mathematics or statistics courses with passing grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 30.11.2026 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Programming experience, e.g. in Python, particularly for machine learning
  • Experience with machine learning theory, evaluation metrics, algorithmic fairness, statistics, or optimization is an advantage

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see:
http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Strong analytical skills and critical thinking
  • Enthusiasm, creativity, self-motivation, perseverance and initiative
  • Ability to take responsibility for your work — including troubleshooting, acquiring additional skills and asking for help when needed

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (including statement of motivation summarizing prior scientific work) + 1-2 pages on research interests and vision for PhD work
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diploma (see below)
  • A complete list of publications and academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Master's thesis. If your thesis has not yet been completed, upload a draft version.
  • Documentation of English proficiency The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of ENglish language proficiency has been submitted
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job". Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Informatics (IFI) is one of nine departments belonging to the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. IFI is Norway’s largest university department for general education and research in Computer Science and related topics. 

The Department has more than 1800 students on bachelor level, 600 master students, and over 240 PhDs and postdocs. The overall staff of the Department is close to 370 employees, about 280 of these in full time positions. The full time tenured academic staff is 75, mostly Full/Associate Professors.

jobs.title: Linear : Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**Type**: Full-time and permanent

**Location**: Helsinki

**Application deadline**: 20.09.2026

_Linear, a Finnish SaaS company founded in 2018, is well on its way to become the next Nordic tech success story: a strong product, a large market ready for change, and the ambition to redefine how an entire industry works._

_The company has grown into Finlands most used real estate software, with its platform already reaching customers across 20 countries. Were now looking for a BI professional to help turn its data into the next stage of international growth._

**Why Linear, why now?**

Linear is on a mission to modernize the real estate industry by replacing outdated tools with a single, powerful platform. Its core product, the Linear platform, brings together the most important tools real estate professionals need in their daily work, from sales and customer management to marketing. Behind the platform is a vast amount of data, covering the full customer journey from the first contact to completed deals, all running through Linears ecosystem.

Linear has established a market-leading position in Finland and is now expanding internationally. As the company and its products grow, so does the opportunity to make better use of the data already flowing through the platform. **_This is where you come in._**

We are looking for a **Business Intelligence Analyst** who combines hands-on BI skills with commercial curiosity. Someone who wants to join Linear not just for the role, but for what they are building together. A person who wants to understand customers, challenge existing solutions, and take real ownership of what reporting and analytics could become at Linear.

**What will you be doing?**

Your initial focus will be on developing the reporting capabilities within Linears SaaS product for its customers. You will work hands-on with Power BI, SQL, and Excel to build reporting solutions that help customers understand their business and make better use of their data.

You will also work directly with customers to understand their challenges, ask the right questions, and turn business needs into practical and visually appealing BI solutions. You will have considerable freedom to shape how reporting develops – from identifying what customers actually need to building and productizing solutions that can serve a growing international customer base.

As Linear grows, so can your role. You can take increasing ownership of the BI product, contribute to its commercial development, and eventually help build a broader analytics offering around it. **What makes you a great fit?**

We are looking for a person to take full ownership of Linears reporting and help shape its future. You are excited by the opportunity to join a scale-up and contribute to its international growth. Rather than being discouraged by things that are still taking shape, you see the opportunity to build, improve, and leave your own mark.

You combine this mindset with a solid foundation in BI and a genuine interest in business. Power BI, SQL, and Excel are familiar tools to you, but you also want to understand the customers and business behind the data. You ask questions, connect different perspectives, and think about how your work can create value beyond the report itself.

You thrive when you are trusted with responsibility rather than handed a detailed task list. You take initiative, find out what you dont yet know, and bring your own ideas into the discussion. And if your background is more technical – for example, you have end-to-end data pipeline experience or have worked in data engineering – we also encourage you to apply if the broader business and ownership side of the role resonates with you.

**We expect you to have:**

- Professional experience with Power BI and the ability to independently build practical BI solutions

- Good SQL skills and an understanding of databases and working with data

- Ability to connect hands-on BI work with customer and business needs

- A proactive and independent approach to solving problems and taking ownership in a fast-evolving growth company environment

- A mindset oriented towards business and growth

- Professional proficiency in English and Finnish and the ability to work directly with clients in Finnish


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience collaborating with customers or business stakeholders to understand reporting needs

- Interest in productization, analytics, product thinking, or future product ownership

- Understanding of performance optimization for large datasets

- Curiosity toward new tools, automation, or AI-assisted development


**We can offer you:**

- The freedom to take ownership of BI and influence what gets built, why it matters, and how it develops

- A chance to productize data into solutions and see their impact with customers and across new international markets

- Room to grow toward BI product ownership and help shape Linears broader analytics offering over time

- An environment where you can test ideas and turn good ones into action without layers of heavy decision-making

- An opportunity to join Linears option program and have a personal stake in the companys future


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by Linear. The ideal start time in the role is as soon as possible. The role will be located in Helsinki, and we hope you are able to visit the office from time to time as part of a flexible hybrid model, especially during the onboarding phase.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. You can familiarize yourself with Linear here: https://linear.fi/en/. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Recruitment Consultant Veera Kokko (+358 44 783 5666, veera.kokko\[at\]atalent.fi).

jobs.title: Scientist / Senior Scientist in Mass Spectrometry-based Proteome Research
jobs.description:
About Us

The Helsinki Proteomics Center (HPC) is a state-of-the-art technology platform operating across two life-science campuses at the University of Helsinki. Dedicated to advancing proteomics research, we provide cutting-edge services and collaborate with researchers to explore protein functions, interactions, and dynamics. This position is based at the Viikki Proteomics Unit, which is part of the Helsinki Proteomics Center.

Your Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist / Senior Scientist to join the Viikki Proteomics Unit. This is primarily a hands-on core-facility position: the appointee will help deliver reliable proteomics services, support facility users, maintain robust daily operations, and develop methods that can be implemented across the HPC service portfolio. The role is therefore best suited to a collaborative scientist who is motivated by enabling the research of others as well as advancing proteomics technology.

Key Responsibilities

Research and Development
* Investigate and evaluate new sample preparation protocols for bottom-up proteomics, including protein digestion, peptide clean-up, enrichment of post-translationally modified peptides, and handling sub-nanogram protein quantities.
* Optimize protocols for sensitivity, specificity, and reproducibility, and evaluate new MS data-acquisition and analysis workflows for implementation as new or improved HPC services.


Operational Support
* Perform day-to-day technical operation of the high-resolution LC-MS/MS systems.
* Prepare customer and internal samples using validated facility protocols.
* Participate in routine maintenance of existing equipment, quality-control checks, and troubleshooting.
* Maintain accurate records of instrument usage, downtime, maintenance, and experimental procedures.


Collaboration and Communication
* Work closely with HPC colleagues to maintain an efficient, safe, and well-organized core-facility laboratory, and coordinate priorities to deliver high-quality results within agreed timelines.
* Advise facility users on experimental design, sample requirements, available technologies, instrument capabilities and limitations, and realistic expected outcomes.
* Prepare clear reports, discuss results and appropriate next steps with users, and provide evidence-based recommendations to HPC leadership on new platforms, methods, and technologies.


Administrative Duties
* Oversee inventory and coordinate procurement to ensure uninterrupted operation of the Viikki Proteomics Unit.
* Work with service contract providers to restore operations of the LC-MS/MS system promptly after system downtime.


Qualifications

Educational Background
* Master's degree required; Ph.D. preferred in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, or a related life science discipline.

Experience
* 2+ years of research experience with proteomic or related technologies.
* Strong background in protein chemistry is required.
* Experience in mass spectrometry-based proteomics is highly preferred.

Technical Skills
* Proficiency in using both vendor-specific and publicly available software tools for MS data analysis.
* Detail-oriented both at the lab bench and with record-keeping.
* Good command of English, both written and spoken.


Soft Skills
* Excellent time management and organizational abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative, service-oriented team environment.
* Willingness to learn, standardize, document, and routinely apply a range of sample preparation protocols.
* Ability to provide demonstrations and training to facility users with varying levels of proteomics experience.
* Motivation to expand data-analysis expertise and contribute to user support and reporting.


What We Offer
* The salary is based on the Finnish university salary system, depending on qualifications and experience.
* The University of Helsinki provides occupational health services, staff well-being resources, access to sports facilities, and extensive opportunities for professional development.
* You will join a world-class research community, work with cutting-edge technologies, and collaborate with leading experts in the field.


Join Us
Employment is expected to start on November-December, 2026, or as agreed. The position is initially offered for two years with the possibility of extension. A 6-month trial period will be applied. The formal title of the position will be determined according to the appointee's qualifications and experience: Research Coordinator/Postdoctoral Researcher / Specialist (for an appointee with a MSc).

How to Apply
Applications should be submitted through the University of Helsinki Recruitment System at [application link] by clicking the "Apply now" button.
For the relevant application enclosers and further information, please see our website.
Application deadline: September 30, 2026

jobs.title: Can you combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations?
jobs.description:
Bergen Engines is entering an important phase of factory development and production ramp-up. To support this, we are strengthening the Special Projects team with one to two Project Managers who can lead cross-functional initiatives and help turn our operational ambitions into practical, executable projects. Reporting to the Head of Special Projects, you will work closely with Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, HSE, Facilities and Finance. The project portfolio is expected to include assembly-capacity and ramp-up initiatives, factory layout and material-flow improvements, tooling and facility investments, CAPEX projects and other operational-improvement activities required to increase manufacturing capability towards 2028.     Your key responsibilities
  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables and success criteria.
  • Develop and maintain credible project plans covering milestones, resources, costs and dependencies.
  • Coordinate cross-functional project teams and ensure clear ownership of actions.
  • Identify and manage project risks, issues, changes and key decisions.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts and escalate constraints or decisions early.
  • Support business cases, investment requests and CAPEX governance where applicable.
  • Work directly with factory teams to understand constraints and implement practical solutions.
  • Drive projects relating to capacity, throughput, assembly flow, material readiness, layout, tooling and process improvement.
  • Provide concise and transparent progress reporting to project sponsors and relevant governance forums.
  • Ensure that projects are delivered safely, on time, within approved cost and with measurable operational benefits.
  • Coordinate effective handover of completed projects into the responsible operational organisation.
Who are we looking for?  We are looking for people who combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations. You may already work as a Project Manager, or you may have led substantial projects or workstreams within Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Facilities or another relevant area.   Your qualifications: 
  • Education within technical fields and knowledge of manufacturing. If you have particularly long and relevant experience the education requirement may be disregarded. 
  • 8-10 years of experience from related role.
  • Experience from planning and delivering cross-functional projects or significant work packages.
  • A good understanding of complex engineering or manufacturing environments.
  • The ability to convert broad objectives into clear actions, milestones and accountabilities.
  • A practical and visible approach, including working directly with teams on the factory floor.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of project costs, benefits and priorities.
  • A strong commitment to safety, quality and sustainable operational improvement.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Fluent skills in both writing and orally in English and preferably also in Norwegian.
Knowledge of Bergen Engines’ products, manufacturing processes, assembly operations and internal systems will be an advantage. A formal project-management or relevant technical qualification is beneficial, but a demonstrated record of successful delivery is equally important.   Your personal characteristics
  • Ability to work independently towards goals. 
  • A good team player. 
  • Good cooperative and communicative skills. 
  • Structured and analytical. 
  • Curious and outgoing, not afraid to ask questions and suggest improvements. 
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, resolve obstacles and escalate decisions when necessary.
  • Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
 

Why choose Bergen Engines?

For more than 80 years, Bergen Engines has delivered world-class power and propulsion systems to customers around the globe. Today, we're playing a key role in the maritime industry through innovative and efficient engine technology.

From our headquarters in Bergen, Norway, we work closely with customers worldwide, combining Norwegian engineering expertise with international reach. As part of the Langley Holdings Power Solutions Division, we're investing in growth, new markets, and the people who will help drive our future success.

These positions offer an opportunity to:
  • Contribute directly to Bergen Engines’ future manufacturing capability.
  • Lead visible projects with tangible operational impact.
  • Work across multiple functions and broaden your business experience.
  • Help shape how strategic factory projects are planned, governed and delivered.

jobs.title: Kontorchef til kontoret for Lokal Udvikling i KL
jobs.description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for et nyt kontor og sætte retning for KL's arbejde med at styrke lokal udvikling i hele Danmark? Som KL's nye kontorchef for Lokal Udvikling får du en central rolle med ansvar for at omsætte kommunernes forskellige vilkår, behov og styrkepositioner til fælles politiske dagsordener, løsninger og resultater.

Med KL's nye bestyrelsesstrategi er lokal udvikling løftet frem som en central politisk prioritet, og det nye kontor skal styrke KL's gennemslagskraft på området. Opgaven for kontoret er at bringe kommunernes viden og perspektiver ind i den nationale politikudvikling, styrke KL's interessevaretagelse og skabe sammenhæng på tværs af fagområder, kommuner og politiske niveauer. Kontoret får ansvar for blandt andet landdistrikter og byudvikling, planområdet, kollektiv trafik og mobilitet, energi, forsyning og infrastruktur, omstilling af Danmarks arealer, turisme, kultur samt erhverv og produktion. Vi søger nu en kontorchef, der kan stå i spidsen for at opbygge kontoret og omsætte bestyrelsens strategiske ambitioner til tydelige prioriteringer og resultater.

'Kommunerne har forskellige vilkår, udfordringer og udviklingsmuligheder, som ikke kan mødes med ensartede løsninger. En central opgave bliver derfor at omsætte lokale forskelle til en fælles politisk retning, der både rummer kommunernes forskellige behov og bidrager til et sammenhængende Danmark. Det kræver tæt dialog med kommunerne, politisk forståelse og evnen til at samle forskellige interesser om de dagsordener, hvor fælles handling skaber størst værdi.' siger direktør i KL Stine Johansen.

Politisk tæft, solid erfaring fra det kommunale maskinrum og blik for muligheder

Du vil skulle stå i spidsen for et nyt kontor, men med nogle kendte opgaver, og forme en udviklingsorienteret arbejdsform, der leverer det, kommunerne har brug for, og understøtter KL's nye strategiske retning. Rollen er udadvendt og indebærer et tæt samarbejde med kommuner, KKR, KL's politiske niveau, direktion, kolleger på tværs af organisationen og eksterne aktører.

Dine ansvarsområder vil blandt andet være at:
  • sætte retning for det nye kontor og omsætte KL's strategiske ambitioner for lokal udvikling til tydelige prioriteringer og resultater, samt skabe følgeskab undervejs
  • udvikle og varetage KL's politiske interessevaretagelse på kontorets områder og opbygge stærke relationer og alliancer med kommuner, ministerier, styrelser, organisationer og øvrige interessenter
  • identificere udviklingsmuligheder for kommunerne med blik for deres forskellige lokale vilkår, behov og styrkepositioner
  • samle kommunerne om fælles dagsordener og løsninger med respekt for lokale forskelle og prioriteringer
  • sikre politisk betjening af høj kvalitet, herunder oplæg, anbefalinger, høringssvar og bidrag til politiske processer
  • sikre sammenhæng mellem kontorets dagsordener og KL's øvrige politikområder

Om dig

Vi søger en kontorchef, der kan kombinere politisk forståelse, strategisk udsyn og solid ledelseserfaring. Til opgaven bringer du en stærk forståelse for den kommunale virkelighed, gerne opnået gennem erfaring fra en kommune, og du kan omsætte kommunernes behov og erfaringer til politiske positioner med gennemslagskraft og troværdighed.

Du kan læse det politiske landskab, identificere udviklingsmuligheder og håndtere komplekse dagsordener med mange interessenter. Du er en sikker skriftlig og mundtlig kommunikatør og kan sikre høj kvalitet i blandt andet høringssvar, politiske oplæg og anbefalinger.

Som leder sætter du en tydelig retning, prioriterer og skaber følgeskab. Du giver plads til faglighed og initiativ, samtidig med at du tager ansvar for mennesker, samarbejde og resultater. Du trives i en synlig og udadvendt rolle, hvor relationer og samarbejde på tværs er afgørende.

Vi tilbyder

Du får en central lederstilling i en politisk organisation med stor samfundsmæssig betydning. Du får mulighed for at opbygge og præge et nyt kontor og sætte retning for en dagsorden, der har direkte betydning for kommunernes muligheder for at skabe lokal udvikling.

Du bliver en del af et ledelsesfællesskab og en organisation, hvor aktiv og troværdig interessevaretagelse, høj faglighed og tæt samspil med kommunerne er kernen i arbejdet.

Det med småt

Ansøgningsfristen er blevet forlænget, så lyder stillingen som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning senest den 1. oktober.

Vi forventer at afholde 1. samtaler i uge 43 og 2. samtaler i uge 44, med henblik på tiltrædelse pr. 1. december.

Vi anvender test og muligvis en case i forbindelse med anden samtalerunde, ligesom der forud for ansættelsen indhentes referencer.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger relevant overenskomst med mulighed for forhandling af tillæg på baggrund af dine kvalifikationer.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte direktør Stine Johansen ved at sende en sms på 25 31 20 20, så vil du efterfølgende blive kontaktet.

Læs det uddybende baggrundsnotat her: Bagrundsnotat til stillingen til kontorchef for Lokal Udvikling https://recruiter.hr-manager.net/Export/Attachments/ViewFileManagerDocument.aspx?id=80451e75-ba63-402d-9b32-050529abae22&cid=1722

KL er interesse- og medlemsorganisation for de 98 kommunalbestyrelser i Danmark. KL bidrager til at udvikle og fastholde et stærkt lokalt demokrati. KL varetager kommunernes fælles interesser og er kommunernes samlede forhandlingsorganisation, videnscenter og forum for fælles initiativer og beslutninger.

KL ser forskellighed i medarbejdersammensætningen og i ledelsen som en af vores styrker og opfordrer alle interesserede uanset personlig baggrund til at søge vores ledige stillinger.

Kig forbi vores KL Karriereunivers og lær mere om os som arbejdsplads og medarbejdere. https://www.kl.dk/karriereunivers/forside

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Virroille
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: Osa-aikainen verkkokaupan ja varaston moniosaaja – Löytö24 / CarHelp Karkkila
jobs.description:
Etsimme **erittäin oma-aloitteista, vastuuntuntoista ja järjestelmällistä henkilöä** kehittämään ja rakentamaan **Löytö24-verkkokaupan** toimintaa Karkkilassa.

**Löytö24 on tehtävän tärkein ja ensisijainen painopiste.** Syyskuussa avaamme Karkkilaan uuden varaston, johon tulee suuri määrä erilaisia uusia ja käytettyjä tuotteita. Tehtävässä pääset rakentamaan käytännössä toimivan kokonaisuuden tuotteiden käsittelystä aina verkkokauppaan ja asiakkaalle toimitukseen asti.

Työ ei ole pelkkää tuotteiden lisäämistä verkkokauppaan. Tavoitteena on saada **Löytö24 nopeasti kasvamaan ja tuotteet tehokkaasti myyntiin**.

Lisäksi tehtävään kuuluu osallistuminen CarHelpin muiden verkkokauppojen, erityisesti **rengaskauppojen**, ylläpitoon, markkinointiin ja kasvattamiseen.

Mitä työ sisältää?

- **Löytö24-verkkokaupan päivittäinen kehittäminen ja ylläpito**

- Uusien tuotteiden kuvaaminen ja kuvien käsittely

- Tuotteiden tietojen, ominaisuuksien ja hintojen selvittäminen

- Tuotteiden lisääminen Löytö24-verkkokauppaan ja muille myyntialustoille

- Myynti-ilmoitusten tekeminen ja niiden kehittäminen

- Tuotteiden lajittelu, merkitseminen ja järjestäminen

- Varaston loogisen järjestelmän rakentaminen ja ylläpito

- Tuotteiden kerääminen, pakkaaminen ja lähettäminen asiakkaille

- Noutojen ja tuotteiden luovutusten hoitaminen

- Varastosaldojen ja tuotteiden seuranta

- Uusien tuotteiden käsittely nopeasti niiden saapuessa

- Löytö24 myynnin ja näkyvyyden aktiivinen kehittäminen

- **Sosiaalisen median aktiivinen hyödyntäminen Löytö24 markkinoinnissa**

- Tuotteiden ja verkkokaupan aktiivinen esille tuominen Facebookissa, Instagramissa ja TikTokissa

- Osallistuminen myös muiden verkkokauppojen, kuten **renkaiden verkkokauppojen**, ylläpitoon ja kasvattamiseen


Millainen henkilö sopii tehtävään?

Etsimme henkilöä, joka on:

- **Erittäin oma-aloitteinen ja vastuuntuntoinen**

- Täsmällinen ja luotettava

- Hyvä suunnittelemaan omaa ajankäyttöään

- Itsenäinen – et tarvitse jatkuvaa ohjausta

- **Päätöksentekokykyinen – uskallat tehdä ratkaisuja itse**

- Järjestelmällinen ja osaat luoda järjestystä myös tilanteissa, joissa sitä ei vielä ole

- Nopea oppimaan uusia asioita ja järjestelmiä

- Tietokoneen ja verkkopalveluiden kanssa sujuvasti toimiva

- Myynnillisesti ajatteleva ja tuloshakuinen

- **Aktiivinen sosiaalisessa mediassa**

- Kiinnostunut sisällön tekemisestä ja tuotteiden markkinoinnista

- Hyvässä fyysisessä kunnossa – työ sisältää myös renkaiden ja muiden suurempien tuotteiden käsittelyä


Eduksi katsomme:

- Kokemuksen verkkokaupoista tai tuotteiden myynnistä verkossa

- **Meta Business Managerin ja Meta-mainonnan tuntemuksen**

- Facebookin ja Instagramin aktiivisen käytön

- TikTokin tuntemuksen

- Kokemuksen tuotteiden kuvaamisesta ja sisällöntuotannosta

- Kokemuksen varasto- tai logistiikkatyöstä

- Hyvän englannin kielen taidon


Tämä työ ei sovi sinulle, jos:

- Tarvitset jatkuvasti tarkkoja ohjeita siitä, mitä pitää tehdä

- Jäät odottamaan, että joku muu ratkaisee ongelmat

- Sinun on vaikea suunnitella omaa ajankäyttöäsi

- Päätösten tekeminen itsenäisesti tuntuu vaikealta

- Työskentelet hitaasti ilman selkeää syytä

- Et pidä käytännön ja fyysisestä työstä

- Some ja verkkokauppa eivät kiinnosta


Meillä tuotteita tulee jatkuvasti lisää, joten **tässä työssä pitää saada aikaan tulosta ja asioita pitää viedä eteenpäin joka päivä.**

Tarjoamme:

- Osa-aikaisen työn, jossa mahdollisuus kasvaa kokoaikaiseksi

- **Erittäin itsenäisen ja vastuullisen roolin**

- Mahdollisuuden rakentaa ja kehittää **Löytö24-verkkokauppaa alusta alkaen**

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa suoraan verkkokaupan myyntiin ja tulokseen

- Monipuolisen työn, jossa pääset tekemään sekä verkkokauppaa, varastoa että markkinointia

- Käytännön tekemistä ilman turhaa byrokratiaa

- Mahdollisuuden kasvaa yrityksen mukana, jos yhteistyö toimii hyvin


**Jos olet järjestelmällinen, oma-aloitteinen ja aikaansaava tekijä, joka näkee itse mitä pitää tehdä eikä odota jatkuvasti ohjeita, tämä tehtävä voi sopia sinulle erittäin hyvin.**

- ammattitaitoisen tiimin ja toimivan korjaamoverkoston;

- kilpailukykyisen palvelun, jota voit tarjota yrityksille;

- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa suoraan sekä omiin ansioihisi että yrityksen kasvuun.


Odotamme sinulta:

- aiempaa myyntikokemusta, mieluiten B2B-myynnistä;

- rohkeutta tehdä kylmäpuheluita ja luoda uusia kontakteja;

- valmiutta aktiiviseen kenttätyöhön, ei pelkästään toimistossa työskentelyyn;

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaitoja;

- itsenäisyyttä, pitkäjänteisyyttä ja vahvaa tuloshakuisuutta;

- kykyä viedä myyntiprosessi ensimmäisestä yhteydenotosta allekirjoitettuun sopimukseen asti.


Me tarjoamme tarvittavat työvälineet ja vapaat kädet – sinulta odotamme tuloksia.

jobs.title: Myyntihenkinen työnjohtaja autokorjaamoon CarHelp Tuusula
jobs.description:
Työnjohtaja – mekaaninen puoli | CarHelp Tuusula

Etsimme **CarHelp Tuusulan toimipisteeseen työnjohtajaa mekaaniselle puolelle**.

Tässä tehtävässä et ole vain työnjohtaja – olet tärkeä osa toimipisteen arkea, asiakaspalvelua ja kasvua. Vastaat siitä, että korjaamon päivittäinen toiminta pyörii sujuvasti, asiakkaat saavat hyvää palvelua ja mekaanisen puolen tekeminen kehittyy jatkuvasti.

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on **rohkea, aktiivinen ja myynnillinen ote**. Olet valmis tarttumaan puhelimeen, palvelemaan asiakkaita, tekemään tarjouksia ja hankkimaan uusia asiakkaita. Jos olet lisäksi aktiivinen sosiaalisessa mediassa ja innostut yrityksen näkyvyyden ja asiakaskunnan kasvattamisesta, se on iso plussa.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu:

- Mekaanisten töiden vastaanotto ja aikataulutus (huollot, korjaukset ja diagnostiikka)

- Mekaanikkojen päivittäinen työnjohto, tukeminen ja työnjako

- Aikataulujen, työn laadun ja tehokkuuden seuranta

- Aktiivinen asiakaspalvelu ja myyntityö

- **Tarjousten laskeminen ja tekeminen asiakkaille**

- **Uusien asiakkaiden hankinta ja asiakassuhteiden rakentaminen**

- Asiakkaiden kontaktointi ja yhteydenpito työn eri vaiheissa

- Sujuvan ja hyvän asiakaskokemuksen varmistaminen

- Yhteydenpito varaosatoimittajiin sekä kustannustehokkuuden seuranta

- Tarvittaessa osallistuminen tekniseen selvitykseen ja diagnostiikkaan

- Toimiminen linkkinä työntekijöiden, asiakkaiden ja yritysjohdon välillä

- Korjaamon toiminnan kehittäminen ja **uuden myynnin aktiivinen rakentaminen**

- **Sosiaalisen median hyödyntäminen asiakashankinnassa ja toimipisteen näkyvyyden kasvattamisessa** – aktiivisuus somessa katsotaan eduksi


Tässä tehtävässä onnistut, kun sinulla on:

- Kokemusta autokorjaamon työnjohdosta **tai vahva tausta mekaanisesta autokorjaamotyöstä**

- Rohkea, oma-aloitteinen ja myyntihenkinen ote asiakastyöhön

- Hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja johtamistaidot

- Kyky tehdä itsenäisiä päätöksiä ja ottaa vastuuta

- Hyvä kokonaisuuksien hallinta ja stressinsietokyky

- Halua kehittää toimintaa ja kasvattaa toimipistettä

- **Asiakashankintaan ja myyntiin motivoitunut asenne**

- Hyvä suomen kielen taito

- Reipas ja puhelias persoona – et pelkää tarttua puhelimeen tai ottaa yhteyttä asiakkaaseen

- **Sosiaalisen median tuntemus ja aktiivisuus katsotaan selkeäksi eduksi**


Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän kasvavassa yrityksessä

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa aidosti omaan työhösi ja **Tuusulan toimipisteen kehittämiseen**

- Mahdollisuuden olla mukana rakentamassa ja kasvattamassa toimipistettä

- Kilpailukykyisen palkan osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan

- Hyvät työvälineet ja selkeät prosessit

- Tiimin ja johdon täyden tuen

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa rooliasi yrityksen kasvun mukana

- Pitkäaikaisen työmahdollisuuden oikealle henkilölle


**Jos olet henkilö, joka ei halua vain odottaa asiakkaita vaan haluaa itse tehdä, myydä, kehittää ja kasvattaa toimintaa, haluamme kuulla sinusta.**

administracja platformą wirtualizacyjną VMware vSphere;
administracja systemami Windows Server (instalacja, konfiguracja, aktualizacje);
zarządzanie usługą domenową Active Directory; zarządzanie kontami, uprawnieniami oraz wdrażanie polityk bezpieczeństwa;

monitorowanie działania usług (wydajność, dostępność, pojemność, logi) i reagowanie na incydenty;
udział w procesach backupu i odtwarzania (współpraca z zespołem backupu, testy odtworzeniowe);
zapewnienie drugiego / trzeciego poziomu wsparcia dla Helpdesk w obszarze Windows, AD, dostępów, stacji roboczych;
współpraca z zespołami developerskimi, sieciowymi, bezpieczeństwa, przy wdrożeniach i zmianach;
tworzenie i aktualizacja dokumentacji technicznej oraz procedur operacyjnych.

znajomość technologii firmy Fortinet (w szczególności FortiGate, FortiAnalyzer, FortiMail);
wiedza z zakresu sieci komputerowych (TCP/IP, VLAN, routing, VPN, podstawowe mechanizmy bezpieczeństwa sieciowego);
doświadczenie w pracy z systemami monitoringu (preferowany Zabbix);
doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku uczelni wyższej lub jednostek sektora publicznego.

jobs.title: PhD CANDIDATE IN SOCIAL CRITERIA DRIVEN ABSOLUTE ENVIRONMENTAL.... (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

The Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit conducts cross disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society. SUSTAIN combines expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation to address complex challenges related to human and environmental health, climate change, and resource efficiency, developing knowledge, methods, and transferable software for the simulation and comprehensive sustainability assessment of socio-economic systems. Its purpose is to foster sustainable eco-innovation, through products and technologies, as well as support sustainability-oriented policy implementation and behavioural change to promote decarbonisation transitions.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The world faces a convergence of crises that are transforming the conditions for human development. Climate instability, ecosystem degradation, and the overuse of natural resources have reached critical levels, while social inequality, political fragmentation, and technological disruption are reshaping societies. Traditional notions of economic competitiveness, centred on growth and productivity, are being redefined to include social resilience, inclusiveness, and ecological integrity. Responding to this “polycrisis” requires new pathways that reconcile prosperity with planetary and social limits. Luxembourg offers a particularly illustrative example of these tensions. The country enjoys one of the highest income levels globally and a dynamic financial and business environment that sustains its reputation for economic success. Yet this prosperity depends strongly on cross-border commuting, which creates mobility challenges and environmental stress. Escalating housing prices have made access to affordable living increasingly difficult, displacing a significant share of the workforce beyond national borders. The reliance on imported energy leaves households and firms vulnerable to external shocks. Although Luxembourg's welfare model and social dialogue remain robust, they are under pressure from rising costs of living, widening inequalities, and growing demands on public services. Environmentally, Luxembourg's footprint per inhabitant ranks among the largest worldwide, driven by high consumption and land-use pressures that push the country beyond sustainable limits.

Meeting these intertwined challenges calls for coordinated transformations that bridge sectors, disciplines, and scales. Economic and social progress must be reframed within the concept of a Safe Operating Space—an area in which human well-being is achieved without breaching environmental boundaries. The objective is to steer innovation, governance, and everyday practices toward forms of competitiveness that are compatible with sustainability, rather than in conflict with it. The Doctoral Training Unit C-SOS (Competitiveness within a Safe Operating Space) is designed to cultivate researchers capable of analysing and fostering such transformations. It brings together an interdisciplinary consortium to train 12 PhD candidates in the assessment and design of inclusive and sustainable development trajectories. The programme equips them with conceptual and methodological tools to connect environmental sustainability, social well-being, and economic dynamics into integrated frameworks for decision-making. Its ambition is to inform socio-economic policies, encourage responsible industrial and technological innovation, and contribute to more equitable and resilient societies. Luxembourg provides an ideal environment for this initiative, combining strong expertise in sustainability science and policy analysis. The DTU is a collaboration between researchers at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), the University of Luxembourg (UL) and the Urban Development and Mobility Department at the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER). The consortium also includes the National Statistics Office (STATEC). In this DTU, 12 scientists will train 12 PhD students over six years (from January 2027), each obtaining a PhD from UL's doctoral schools.

As part of the C-SOS Doctoral Training Unit, in this PhD you will integrate concepts from Post-Growth, Sufficiency and Doughnut Economics into the downscaling of planetary boundaries, leveraging good examples of application to territories and cities. Possible research questions include: how to couple ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system? How to define social foundation? How to allocate the carrying capacity based on social foundation?.

You will be embedded in the SUSTAIN unit at LIST and enrolled as a doctoral candidate at the University of Luxembourg. You will work closely with a diverse cohort of 12 PhD researchers across the social, economic, and environmental sciences, contributing to a shared research agenda on how Luxembourg can thrive within its fair share of planetary limits

You will be mainly in charge of:
• Conducting a systematic review and critical assessment of existing carrying capacity allocation and planetary boundary downscaling approaches, spanning economic and emission based allocation methods, sufficiency based approaches, and Doughnut Economics frameworks
• Developing a methodological framework for coupling ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system, integrating Post-Growth, Sufficiency, and Doughnut Economics concepts into the downscaling of planetary boundaries
• Applying the framework to Luxembourg and comparable small territories under a range of allocation scenarios, drawing on Green Deal technology targets, context specific Decent Living Standards, and provisioning systems, producing environmental ceiling estimates grounded in social foundation thresholds
• Building and maintaining a dynamic system model enabling the testing of individual and combined allocation approaches, valuing social outcome generation per unit of environmental impact across relevant planetary boundary dimensions
• Collaborating with other C-SOS doctoral researchers, in particular those working on social foundation, Quality of Life, and economic systems, to ensure that allocation approaches rest on socially realistic and empirically coherent definitions of social foundation
• Publishing results in peer reviewed journals and presenting at international conferences
• Contributing to C-SOS training activities, workshops, and stakeholder engagement events

Education
• Master's degree (or equivalent) in a quantitative discipline relevant to environmental sustainability, such as: industrial ecology, environmental engineering, environmental or ecological economics or computational social science
• Solid academic grounding in Planetary Boundaries, Doughnut Economics, Post Growth or degrowth literature
• Familiarity with Decent Living Standards and Quality of Life frameworks

Experience and skills

• Experience with dynamic system modeling or willingness to develop this quickly

jobs.title: RESEARCHER IN FIRST-PRINCIPLES MODELLING OF MULTIFERROIC MATERIALS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The push to reduce global energy consumption has set a clear trend in modern technology towards devices that are smaller, faster and more energy-efficient. Meeting these demands calls for new materials that can perform several functions at once. Magnetoelectric multiferroics are especially attractive in this respect, because they combine magnetism and ferroelectricity in a single phase. Crucially, this opens the possibility of controlling magnetism with an electric field which could enable entirely new device architectures and transform modern computing and data storage. Despite decades of progress, this promise is hard to realise: in most known multiferroics the two orders only coexist well below room temperature, and many are difficult to integrate with standard semiconductor manufacturing. Turning multiferroics into a practical technology therefore requires identifying or designing new materials that show robust, coupled magnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature and remain compatible with established fabrication processes.

This is the challenge at the heart of the SMART project funded by the FNR CORE programme and led by Natalya Fedorova. We offer a 2-year postdoc position in which you will use first-principles calculations (DFT) together with analytical modelling to design room-temperature multiferroics via doping of semiconductors. Working mainly with DFT, you will carry out a systematic analysis of electronic, structural, magnetic and ferroelectric properties of these materials - computing, for instance, ground-state magnetic configurations, magnetic exchange interactions, electric polarization and polarization-switching pathways. You will then combine these results with analytical models to describe the magnetoelectric coupling in the most promising candidates and to explore how their magnetism could be manipulated with an applied electric field.

You will join the Modelling of Functional Materials group led by Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) and will benefit from interactions with other team members.

• You have hands-on experience with DFT codes (e.g. VASP, CRYSTAL, Quantum ESPRESSO or similar), scripting for automation and data analysis (e.g. Python, Bash), and working in a Linux/HPC environment. Knowledge of magnetism, ferroelectricity and/or multiferroics is a strong asset.

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. How will you contribute?

The AI Readiness and Assessment (AIRA) research group at LIST is seeking a highly motivated professional to contribute to the research on AI assessment. You'll advance the methods and tooling for qualifying AI systems within the Luxembourg AI Factory, characterizing an AI system and deriving which evaluations, controls, quality management processes and regulatory requirements apply to it. Your contributions will drive the catalog of assessment tools for the AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator (https://aifactory.lu/build-and-test/testing-the-solution/ai-sandbox-configurator)

Core qualification research
• Formalize how a system's characteristics (purpose, domain, data, risk profile, etc.) map to applicable assessments, controls, requirements, quality management processes, etc. captured as a reusable knowledge base (ontology / rule model), not hard-coded heuristics.[GC1]
• Handle incomplete system descriptions through interactive elicitation and confidence-aware recommendations.
Method & tooling
• Turn AI system characteristics into a justified, reproducible selection of tests and controls, moving from rules of thumb to an evidence-based, explainable, auditable method with full traceability from decisions to evidence.
• Explore agentic/LLM-assisted automation of the workflow (system description → tailored assessment plan).
• Implement AI assessment algorithms and tools, fully integrated into the AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator
Compliance & standards
• Ground the logic in the evolving regulatory and standards landscape (EU AI Act, ISO/IEC, CEN-CENELEC JTC 21, etc.) and translate abstract obligations into concrete, testable requirements.
Integration & validation
• Integrate qualification into the wider assessment platform (controls, plugins, reporting) and validate on real systems through case studies.
• Validate and improve methods and tools to industrialize and scale AI assessment especially for agentic AI.
Dissemination & ecosystem
• Contribute to publications and open-source releases, engage with the ecosystem of partners and community governance.

Education
• Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, Information Systems, AI governance, or a closely related field.

Experience
• Research experience in AI evaluation or testing (e.g. bias, drift, robustness, performance, cybersecurity, etc.).
• Hands-on experience building AI tools and pipelines in Python.

The LIST AI Initiative, supported by the LIST Board of Directors, aims to expand LIST's AI capabilities and maximise the impact of AI innovation both within LIST (AI applied to scientific research in all LIST RDI units and AI applied to improve the performance of LIST corporate support functions) and outside LIST (AI applied to improve products, services and processes of private and public organisations through collaborative projects and/or contract research).
One of the key areas of interest in the LIST AI initiative is that of Frugal AI, understood in a very broad sense: from the analysis of “frugality” of current AI models to the selection/adaptation of models to be deployed in constrained resources (in terms of energy, memory…) depending on the client requirements as part of the design process of a new software system with sustainability concerns.

In this context, LIST is seeking to recruit an AI experienced researcher with a strong specialization and interest in the field of Frugal AI (and similar terms: green AI, low-resource AI, constrained AI, …).

You will join the LIST AI Initiative team as a member of the SWRDI research group and collaborate with peers in a dynamic and evolving research environment within the SWRDI group, the HANDS unit and, in general, with other LIST units requiring expertise in the Frugal AI field.

The SWRDI team specializes in the design and development of smart (i.e. AI-enhanced) software systems. We believe energy concerns should be part of the software design from its early stages and therefore, we believe there is the need to specify resource requirements as part of the requirements engineering phase. These requirements will be then analysed against the energy/memory requirements of AI models to optimize the system behaviour while minimizing the resources consumed by the AI components in it.

We'll expect from you to lead research and innovation (RDI) activities in Frugal AI. As an experienced researcher, you will take the lead in:
• Delivering Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) activities.
• Developing and coaching the LIST RDI teams in this topic; and
• Maximising the impact of Frugal AI initiatives through externally funded projects with public or private organisations.

• Increase LIST's visibility in the AI field through publications, presentations and participation in relevant forums and conferences.

Deep scientific and technical expertise, demonstrated by publications and successful RDI projects, in at least some of these topics is required:
• Frugal AI / Green AI and, in general, the design and deployment of AI models in low-resource environments.
• Generative AI, including large language models (LLMs), multimodal foundation models, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning and optimisation techniques for LLMs.
• Use of AI to improve sustainability aspects of AI and non-AI systems based on an analysis of their current architecture and operational data.

• Multimodal input and how multimodality impacts frugality.
• Data management, data valorisation and data processing techniques, including data sandboxes, data spaces, data synthesis and data augmentation.

• Experience working with business domain experts to apply the above AI innovation capabilities in at least one vertical domain in the private and/or public sector, such as finance, space, cybersecurity, energy, mobility and logistics, defence, manufacturing, education, health, central or local government, etc.

• Software engineering and, in particular, low-code technologies. This includes some knowledge of low-code and no-code AI approaches.

In the Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) research unit, the different research groups advance science-based methods through the intensive development of software prototypes and computational tools that enable robust sustainability assessment. The unit has a strong expertise in environmental LCA, Industrial Ecology and Urban built environments the unit increasingly expands its scope to integrate social and economic dimensions and to support more realistic simulation of industrial processes. We are looking for a postdoc who will contribute to the further development and application of dynamic LCA, and in particular DyPLCA (a computational framework, tool and database), a key promising asset of LIST. jobs.title: R&T SCIENTIST – REGULATORY CONTROLS FOR FUND OPERATIONS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belval | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You'll be working on a production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system purpose-built for second-level controls on NAV computation in investment funds. The system must retrieve relevant regulatory methodology, replicate calculation steps, detect discrepancies against fund accounting outputs, and produce control reports that are traceable, auditable, and defensible under regulatory scrutiny.
You will contribute to a system where precision, explainability, and reliability are non-negotiable.

Code Development (60%):
·          Build retrieval pipelines optimised for structured regulatory methodology documents (CSSF circulars, ESMA guidelines, fund prospectuses), with adaptive weighting to surface the specific calculation rules relevant to each control query
·          Implement numerical validation pipelines that compare LLM-derived NAV calculation outputs against fund administrator figures, applying configurable tolerance bands and discrepancy flagging logic
·          Implement chunking strategies optimised for fund accounting reports and regulatory circulars, preserving the structure of calculation tables, formula references, and numbered regulatory provisions.
·          Build evaluation frameworks measuring control accuracy (error detection rate, false positive/negative rates on flagged discrepancies) and the quality of generated audit reports
·          Optimise vector database indexing for regulatory document corpora with high update frequency, ensuring fast retrieval as new CSSF/ESMA guidance is published

Research & experimentation (25%):
·          Benchmark embedding models against the current Nomic Embed Text baseline, with a focus on sensitivity to numerical and regulatory language in fund accounting contexts
·          Explore cross-lingual retrieval for EU regulatory documents published across multiple languages, with emphasis on French and German variants of CSSF and ESMA guidance
·          Research agent-based simulation of NAV calculation steps, investigating how LLMs can reason reliably over arithmetic-sensitive regulatory workflows and signal confidence levels
·          Experiment with multi-agent orchestration for second-level control workflows, where agents decompose a NAV control task into parallel verification sub-tasks across pricing, accruals, and corporate actions.

System integration (15%):
·          Integrate LLM backends optimised for structured reasoning and develop prompt engineering patterns that enforce step-by-step calculation verification and explainable output
·          Implement comprehensive logging, structured audit trail generation, and monitoring dashboards that allow compliance officers to review and challenge control decisions

jobs.description:
PHD IN SPIN PHOTON ENTANGLEMENT GENERATION WITH COLOUR CENTRES IN SILICON CARBIDE (m/f)

Temporary contract | 14+22(+12) months | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You will be part of the LIST Materials Research and Technology department, where you will carry out your work in the Quantum Materials Group, led by Dr. Florian Kaiser.
Quantum technologies have the potential to revolutionise the world in many aspects. Quantum colour centres in in wide bandgap semiconductors have recently emerged as a promising platform, since they can incorporate quantum systems, which can be scaled up by industrial processing. Along these lines, we have recently shown that individual colour centres can be integrated into silicon carbide nanophotonic waveguides with little-to-no degradation of spin-optical coherences. These finding define the strategy for developing a scalable quantum technology architecture.
Our strategy is to use multiplexed and integrated colour centres for quantum communication tasks. Key here is to generate entanglement between colour centres based on spin-photon entanglement, as well as Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. With this milestone demonstration, we strive to kickstart subsequent developments towards a quantum internet architecture.

The objective of this PhD thesis is to support our work towards optical interference between colour centres, i.e., Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. The initial part of this thesis comprises setting up our new optical cryostat platform, which is based on a combination of standard confocal microscopy, and interferometry. In the second step, you will benefit from our ongoing activities towards quantum photonic silicon carbide chips in which we generate colour centres in fibre-coupled waveguides.
You will determine the ideal pulsed excitation schemes for colour centres, considering spectral, temporal and polarization filtering. Subsequently, you will characterise the photon quality depending on experimental parameters, and implement initial two-photon inteference experiments outside of the cryostat, followed by a fully-on-chip demonstration inside the cryostat. If time permits, this project can be further extended to the generation of entanglement between two colour centre chips located in two different cryostats.

GOODYEAR-LIST partnership 2.0 embraces Luxembourg's National priorities, such as Sustainability, Digital transformation and Circular economy, through the execution of six Strategic Research Programs: Data Science for Tires, Tire as a Sensor, End-of-Life Tire Valorization, Sustainable Materials for Non-Pneumatic Tires, Sustainable Materials for Next Generation of Pneumatic Tires, Structure-Process-Properties Relationships.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

LIST is seeking to recruit a two-year postdoctoral position to work on fabrication of the piezoelectric energy harvester based on ceramics for tires. This position is part of the Strategic Research Program “Tire as a sensor” in the joint project with Goodyear SA and explores how to transform mechanical energy from tires to a useful electrical energy, which can power tire sensors. The approach used for energy harvesting is the piezoelectric effect. Materials which show piezoelectric properties transform strain variation into electrical charge. These materials can be ceramics or polymers. The material chosen in this study is commercial PZT ceramics. To efficiently use the available mechanical energy in tires and induce strain in the piezoelectric material, it is essential to develop an adapted harvester's design, the transducer. In addition, harvester's signal conditioning plays an important role. To harvest enough electrical energy, all three points: material properties, harvester design and signal conditioning, have to be addressed.

This Postdoc position is mainly focused on development of energy harvester based on ceramics. Several challenges will be addressed to achieve targeted values of power from tires:
·        Investigation of geometries for an efficient transfer of strain from the tire into the ceramic. The design optimisation will be done using finite element modelling (Comsol)
·        Development/adaptation of signal conditioning electronics
·        Integration of the harvester into a real tire
·        Tests in the tire in operation

·        Take part in the relevant training
