jobs.title: HR BUSINESS PARTNER (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
HR-26001 HR BUSINESS PARTNER

Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO), bridging scientific excellence and applied research to address real-world challenges. With over 840 employees - more than 70% of whom are researchers, engineers, and PhD-level professionals working across Natural & Built Environments, Industrial Technologies, Space, AI, Security and Defence.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website.

How will you contribute?

Our HR team of 20 professionals covers the full spectrum: HR Administration, Talent Acquisition, Learning and Development, HR Projects, and HR Business Partnering. This last function currently comprises two HRBPs. Following continued organisational growth and increasing complexity, we are creating a third HRBP position - not to replace someone, but because the demand is real.

The role

The HR Business Partner operates with a high degree of autonomy under the general supervision of the HR Director.
This is an individual contributor (IC) role - you will not manage a team, but you will lead by influence, advise with authority, and build lasting relationships within a public research institution.
You will be the primary HR point of contact for a defined population of managers and employees (e.g. Head of Units, Group Leaders, Service Heads), supporting them across the full employment lifecycle — from recruitment validation to exit interviews, from salary review to contractual management. You will work side-by-side with HR Admin, Talent Acquisition, and L&D, but the accountability for your internal "client" perimeter is yours.
This is not a role where you execute a playbook. It is a role where you read the situation, navigate the rules, and find the right path - always within a well-defined legal and regulatory framework.

What you will actually do

Here is what you will spend your time on:

1. Conflict Management & Difficult Situation Advisory

This is the most demanding dimension of the role - not in volume, but in complexity, emotional weight, and reputational stakes. Your approach is fundamentally advisory: you coach managers on how to prevent tensions from escalating, and when a situation has already become critical, you guide them through a structured, legally sound resolution process. You distinguish between what requires immediate intervention and what requires patience. You document carefully, advise precisely, and remain steady when those around you are not. Working with highly educated, articulate professionals means that the people on both sides of a conflict are often skilled at constructing their argument - your job is to remain the clearest, calmest voice in the room.

2. Manager Coaching

You act as a trusted sounding board for managers navigating team dynamics, people decisions, and leadership challenges. This is not change management in the programme-delivery sense - it is the daily, relational work of helping managers think through situations, anticipate consequences, and gradually build their own HR reflex. You build your influence over time, not through authority, but through consistency, credibility, and genuine availability.

3. Recruitment Facilitation & Internal Mobility

You are the HRBP anchor in the recruitment process for your perimeter: framing needs with Hiring Managers, contributing to the annual recruitment plan, and supporting internal mobility decisions. You do not own the end-to-end recruitment process - that is the Talent Acquisition team's remit - but you ensure the right organisational decisions are made at the right moments.

4. Trial Period & Contract Monitoring

You actively track trial periods, flag risks early, and organise structured feedback conversations between managers and employees. You manage end-of-trial-period decisions with rigor and care. You conduct or facilitate exit interviews and ensure that what can be learned is captured. You have a genuine appetite for contractual matters - including the nuances of employment situation.

5. Luxembourg Employment Law - Applied Advisory

You are a reliable reference point on Luxembourg labour law and its practical application: CNS procedures (reclassement, medical visits), parental and family leave frameworks, absence management processes, and dismissal procedures. You do not just cite the rule - you contextualise it, assess the risk level, and give the manager and HRD actionable guidance, always within the legal and regulatory framework.

6. Annual Salary Review

You coordinate and manage the annual salary review cycle for your client perimeter, ensuring internal equity, policy compliance, and a smooth process across managers, HR Admin, and Finance. You are comfortable working with data - building and maintaining Excel dashboards, producing pivot-table-based analyses, and transforming raw data into clear decision-support materials for management. Advisory skills.

7. Performance Management Support

You oversee the annual appraisal cycle and provide advisory support to managers on objective-setting and performance conversations, ensuring process consistency - while remaining in an advisory capacity rather than a direct participant in those discussions.

8. HR Department Contribution

You contribute to collective HR objectives, participate in cross-functional initiatives, and actively represent the HR team's values in every interaction with your internal clients. You communicate through influence - not authority - and you understand that in a public institution, relationships are built slowly and lost quickly.

The Environment

We want you to know what you are signing up for:

Your internal clients are highly educated. Many are PhD-level professionals who are rigorous, analytical, and used to evidence-based reasoning. Vague HR advice will not land. You must be precise, credible, and consistent.
This is a public research institution. That brings strengths - stability, mission-driven colleagues, and genuine intellectual depth - as well as challenges: governance layers and decision cycles that differ from those in smaller organizations.
Flexibility is key. LIST operates across multiple research domains with matrix-like reporting lines and evolving team structures. You will frequently need to act without the full picture being settled.
The tooling is pragmatic, not perfect. Office 365 is your daily environment.
Proactive, not reactive. The best HRBPs here anticipate - they may notice a manager struggling before it becomes a case, they flag a contractual risk before it becomes a dispute. Structured foresight is expected.
You will need to be visible. Open-space team, occasional presence across LIST sites. Being accessible and visible matters here.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Must-haves

At least 5 years of HR experience after Bachelor's degree or 3 years after Master's degree in Human Resources, with a substantial portion in a generalist HRBP or HR advisory role - you have operated independently, ideally not as support to a more senior HRBP
Proven conflict management and employee relations expertise - you have coached managers through difficult situations, both preventively and curatively, from first signal to resolution
Solid knowledge of Luxembourg employment law in practice (CNS, absences, dismissals, parental leave, etc).
Genuine appetite for contractual matters - you find contract drafting, amendment, and employment nuances interesting, not burdensome
Excel proficiency at pivot-table level minimum - you can produce clean, decision-ready reporting and work with compensation or absence data without requiring handholding
Fluency in both English and French (written and spoken) - both languages are in daily use
A diplomatic, influence [...]

Temporary contract | 24 months | Belvaux

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.
You will join the Intelligent and Clean Energy Systems (ICES) research unit at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) and will actively contribute to the WeForming and EnerTEF project, funded by the Horizon Europe, in collaboration with research institutes and Industrial partners around Europe.

WeForming and EnerTEF focus on the use of Inverter-Based Resources (IBRs) in smart grids. In the case of WeForming, this includes the integration of energy storage systems together with smart electric vehicle chargers, while EnerTEF focuses on establishing Testing and Experimentation Facilities (TEFs) for the energy sector. Specifically, this project leverages industrial communication networks, distributed controllers, AI models, and state-of-the-art IBR-based infrastructure to optimize EV charging and energy systems. By integrating distributed energy resources, demand response, and storage, this project aims to enhance grid flexibility and increase the use of renewable energy.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

• Automating the operation and control of real demonstrators based on IBRs, including BESS, EV chargers, and PV generation, using distributed controllers (e.g. Beckhoff/TwinCAT, NI/CompactRIO, SIMATIC/PAC) and industrial communication protocols (e.g. Modbus, IEC 61850, EtherCAT, OPC UA, CAN/CANopen).
• Deploying cloud-to-edge architectures for real-time operation of IBR-dominated grids, integrating edge controllers with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS or GCP) using wide-area and publish–subscribe mechanisms (e.g. MQTT, AMQP, REST APIs, OPC UA).
• Implementing distributed control strategies, including advanced services from grid-forming IBRs.
• Working with RT-HIL environments (e.g. OPAL-RT, Typhoon, dSPACE) to validate cloud-controlled systems interacting with real hardware.
• Participating in experimental activities in laboratory and field demonstrators with real-time data exchange and actuation.
• Disseminating results through technical publications and contributions to national and European RDI projects.

• Solid hands-on experience in designing and deploying automation and control architectures involving IBRs, distributed controllers, communication networks, SCADA, and cloud-based platforms.

• Experience with RT-HIL platforms (e.g. OPAL-RT, Typhoon), including closed-loop interaction with real hardware and field devices.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Environment Specialist (m/f)
jobs.description:
At Vodafone, we're working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
Join Us

At Vodafone, we're not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we're shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you're part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.
What you'll do

The Supply Chain Environmental Specialist supports the development and delivery of Vodafone's environmental strategy across supply chain categories and markets. The role focuses on category-level climate transition planning, supplier engagement, emissions reduction, and capability building within procurement, ensuring purchased goods and services align with Vodafone's 2030 reduction milestones and 2040 Net Zero ambition.
The role sits within Vodafone Procure & Connect (VP&C) in Luxembourg and reports into Vodafone Group's Sustainable Business Team, which sets global sustainability strategy and partners with business units to drive delivery. This is a growing and high-impact area, offering the opportunity to work with sustainability and supply chain experts while engaging a wide range of stakeholders across markets and functions. The role requires a self-driven individual with strong communication and programme management skills, comfortable creating new ways of working.

1. Category climate transition strategies

Support the development of category-specific climate transition plans aligned to Net Zero 2040.
Conduct baseline assessments to identify emissions hotspots, risks, opportunities, and KPIs.
Embed environmental criteria into category planning to support long-term decarbonisation.

2. Procurement collaboration & decision-making support

Support the implementation of sustainable procurement processes, including environmental requirements and contract terms.
Partner with category managers to embed carbon reduction targets, environmental KPIs, and climate-aligned supplier selection.
Provide climate data, insights, and analysis to support responsible sourcing decisions.
Support ESG assessments within RFQs, guiding suppliers and integrating results into scoring models.

3. Supplier engagement & performance management

Manage supplier performance against ESG contractual commitments and KPIs.
Drive supplier alignment with Vodafone's environmental targets, reporting, and transition pathways.
Issue and track supplier improvement plans, escalating risks where required.
Participate in supplier reviews to support credible decarbonisation and improved environmental performance.

4. Capability building for procurement teams

Deliver training, tools, and guidance to strengthen environmental capability across procurement.
Develop templates, guidance, and onboarding materials covering KPIs, carbon methodologies, and assessments.
Facilitate workshops and learning sessions to embed sustainability into BAU procurement activities.

5. Environmental data, reporting & governance

Support consolidation and validation of supplier climate data for category strategies, CSRD, and internal reporting.
Maintain category-level environmental KPIs and provide progress updates to leadership.
Provide accurate and timely supply chain environmental data to Group Finance.
Who you are

    Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business, Logistics, Sustainability, or a related field. A Master's degree is an advantage.
    4+ years of experience in supply chain, procurement, sourcing, supplier management, logistics, or a related discipline, with exposure to complex stakeholder environments and cross-functional collaboration.
    Strong project management and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, interpret complex data sets, identify risks, and drive informed decision-making.
    Experience engaging and influencing suppliers and internal stakeholders, including Procurement, Finance, Operations, and Sustainability teams, to deliver business and sustainability objectives.
    Demonstrated ability to support supplier negotiations, supplier performance management, and risk mitigation initiatives, leveraging data-driven insights to improve outcomes.
    Strong understanding of procurement processes, category management, sourcing strategies, contract compliance, and supplier engagement practices.
    Proven track record of identifying and implementing process improvements, standardisation initiatives, and operational efficiencies within supply chain or procurement functions.
    Proactive, collaborative, and highly detail-oriented approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
    Knowledge of supply chain sustainability principles, including circular economy, reverse logistics, responsible sourcing, ESG considerations, and supplier sustainability programmes.
    Passion for environmental sustainability, climate transition, Scope 3 emissions reduction, supplier ESG performance management, and circularity initiatives.

jobs.title: Directeur/trice d'Agence de Promotion Immobilière (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Notre client est un acteur reconnu de la promotion immobilière au Luxembourg, adossé à un groupe européen de référence dans les domaines de la construction et du développement immobilier. Dans le cadre de son développement, nous recrutons son/sa futur(e) Directeur/trice d'Agence de Promotion Immobilière pour piloter l'activité luxembourgeoise.
S'appuyant sur un portefeuille de projets résidentiels et tertiaires déjà sécurisé pour les prochaines années, vous prendrez la responsabilité du développement de l'activité, du pilotage des opérations et du management des équipes, avec une large autonomie et le soutien d'un groupe solide.

Vos responsabilités

En tant que Directeur/trice d'une Agence de Promotion Immobilière, vous assurez le pilotage global de l'entité, tant sur les aspects stratégiques qu'opérationnels.

Développement de l'activité

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de développement de l'activité au Luxembourg.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités et développer un réseau de partenaires (investisseurs, propriétaires, architectes, bureaux d'études, collectivités, clients...).
• Contribuer au développement commercial et à la commercialisation des opérations.
• Représenter l'entreprise auprès des principaux acteurs du marché immobilier luxembourgeois.

Pilotage des opérations

• Superviser les projets immobiliers, de la faisabilité jusqu'à la livraison.
• Garantir le respect des objectifs de qualité, de délais, de coûts et de rentabilité.
• Piloter les procédures administratives et réglementaires propres au Luxembourg (PAP, autorisations de construire, etc.).
• Coordonner les équipes internes et les partenaires externes afin d'assurer le bon déroulement des opérations.

Gestion de l'activité

• Piloter l'entité comme un véritable centre de profit.
• Assurer le suivi financier des opérations, analyser les montages et accompagner les décisions d'investissement.
• Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction Générale.

Management

• Manager et accompagner une équipe d'une petite dizaine de collaborateurs (Responsables de Projets, spécialistes techniques et fonctions administratives).
• Coordonner les intervenants externes (architectes, bureaux d'études, bureaux de contrôle et autres partenaires).
• Fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs et accompagner le développement de l'activité.

Votre profil

Vous évoluez depuis plusieurs années dans le secteur immobilier luxembourgeois et disposez d'une solide compréhension des enjeux liés à la promotion immobilière. Votre parcours vous a permis d'acquérir une vision globale d'une opération immobilière, que ce soit au sein d'un promoteur immobilier ou à travers des fonctions de pilotage de projets complexes dans le secteur de la construction ou du développement immobilier.

Vous maîtrisez notamment:

• L'ensemble du processus de promotion immobilière, de l'acquisition foncière à la livraison des opérations.
• Les montages financiers et le pilotage économique de projets immobiliers.
• La gestion d'un centre de profit ou d'une activité disposant d'objectifs financiers.
• Les procédures administratives luxembourgeoises, notamment les PAP, les autorisations de construire et les relations avec les administrations.
• La commercialisation de programmes immobiliers et la relation avec les différents partenaires du projet.

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes reconnu pour votre leadership, votre capacité à fédérer les équipes, à prendre des décisions et à faire avancer les projets. Vous appréciez évoluer dans un environnement entrepreneurial où autonomie, vision stratégique et pragmatisme sont essentiels.
Le français et l'anglais sont indispensables. La maîtrise du luxembourgeois constitue un atout.

Pour plus d'information, merci de contacter Nicolas Hurlin au +352 26 29 45.

jobs.title: PROJEKTANT SURADNIK/PROJEKTANTICA SURADNICA
jobs.description:
PROJEKTANT SURADNIK (m/ž)

Za rad u projektantskom uredu tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za radno mjesto Projektant suradnik (m/ž).

Opis posla

Projektant suradnik sudjeluje u izradi arhitektonskih projekata kroz različite faze projektiranja, u suradnji s glavnim projektantom i ostalim članovima projektnog tima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • sudjelovanje u izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata

  • izradu i razradu arhitektonske projektne dokumentacije

  • izradu tehničkih nacrta, detalja i grafičkih priloga

  • sudjelovanje u razvoju projektnih rješenja

  • usklađivanje projektne dokumentacije s ostalim strukama

  • pripremu dokumentacije za ishođenje potrebnih dozvola i suglasnosti

  • komunikaciju i koordinaciju s kolegama, suradnicima i ostalim sudionicima u projektu

  • praćenje projekta i izvršavanje zadataka prema dogovorenim rokovima

  • sudjelovanje u obilascima lokacija i gradilišta prema potrebi

Uvjeti i očekivanja

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • završeno odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz područja arhitekture, graditeljstva ili srodnog tehničkog područja

  • poznavanje rada u relevantnim programima za projektiranje i izradu tehničke dokumentacije

  • preciznost, odgovornost i organiziranost

  • sposobnost timskog rada i kvalitetne komunikacije

  • samostalnost u izvršavanju povjerenih zadataka u skladu s razinom iskustva

  • spremnost na učenje i profesionalni razvoj

Radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima je prednost, ali razmotrit ćemo i kandidate s manje iskustva koji pokazuju znanje, motivaciju i želju za učenjem.

Mjesto i način rada

Rad se obavlja na licu mjesta, u prostorijama projektantskog ureda.

Tražimo osobu koja će biti svakodnevno prisutna u uredu i aktivno sudjelovati u radu projektnog tima. Ovo radno mjesto nije predviđeno za rad na daljinu (remote) niti isključivo online suradnju.

Što nudimo

  • rad na raznovrsnim arhitektonskim i projektantskim zadacima

  • rad u profesionalnom i suradničkom okruženju

  • mogućnost učenja i razvoja stručnih znanja

  • sudjelovanje u svim fazama razvoja projekta

  • stabilnu i dugoročnu suradnju

  • mogućnost profesionalnog napredovanja u skladu sa znanjem, iskustvom i rezultatima

Ako ste zainteresirani za rad u projektantskom uredu i želite biti dio tima koji zajednički razvija i realizira projekte, pozivamo vas da nam pošaljete svoj životopis i, ako je primjenjivo, portfolio dosadašnjih rad

jobs.title: Assistant Key Account Manager, Rotkreuz, CH (Key-Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Du möchtest im technischen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen und nah an Kunden, Projekten und Vertrieb arbeiten? Dann werde Teil der TGW-Familie und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Intralogistik. In dieser vielseitigen Position unterstützt du unser Key Account Management in der technischen Auftragsabwicklung und im Customer Service. Dich erwartet ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld in einem engagierten Team, eine starke Wertekultur sowie die Sicherheit eines international erfolgreichen Unternehmens. Was man bei uns bewegt: Ausarbeiten der technischen Verkaufsunterlagen für das Key Account Management Erstellen von Kalkulationen und Angebotsunterlagen sowie Rechnungserstellung für Dienstleistungen (Wartung, Hotline und After Sales) Verwaltung und Verrechnung von Ersatzteilen Kundenbetreuung per E-Mail und Telefon sowie Begleitung des Key Account Managers zu Kundenbesuchen Erarbeiten von Lösungsvorschlägen zur Prozessoptimierung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Key Account Manager und den jeweiligen Fachabteilungen Was uns überzeugt: Technische Grundausbildung mit Weiterbildung und/oder Erfahrung im kaufmännischen Bereich (technischer Innendienst, direkte Kundenbetreuung) Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englisch und/oder Französisch vorteilhaft Hohe Zahlenaffinität sowie technisches Verständnis von Intralogistikprozessen und -abläufen Loyales und ehrliches Auftreten Kommunikative und teamfähige Persönlichkeit Was wir bieten: Wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld, motivierte Teams und eine offene Feedbackkultur Abwechslungsreiche Aufgabengebiete Übernahme von Verantwortung in einem erfolgreichen internationalen Unternehmen mit starkem Fokus auf Kultur und Werte Sicherer und stabiler Arbeitgeber, der entsprechend der Philosophie ,,Mensch im Mittelpunkt - lernen und wachsen" agiert Grosses Angebot zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung in Form von Präsenztrainings sowie eLearnings

jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

jobs.title: REMONTSTRĀDNIEKS
jobs.description:
SIA “RSWISS”, Reģ. Nr. 40103973119 aicina darbā REMONTSTRĀDNIEKUS

Darba pienākumi un darba līguma nosacījumi:Darbinieka galvenie pienākumi:

  • veikt ēku, telpu un atsevišķu būvkonstrukciju remonta un atjaunošanas darbus;

  • sagatavot sienas, griestus, grīdas, fasādes un citas virsmas remonta un apdares darbu veikšanai;

  • demontēt nolietotus vai bojātus apdares materiālus un konstrukciju elementus;

  • veikt špaktelēšanas, slīpēšanas, krāsošanas, apmešanas un citus iekšējās un ārējās apdares darbus;

  • piedalīties fasāžu, pamatu, cokolu, balkonu un citu ēkas daļu remontā;

  • uzstādīt un remontēt vienkāršus stiprinājumus, margas un citus būvelementus;

  • veikt palīgdarbus vēsturisko ēku un fasāžu elementu atjaunošanā;

  • sagatavot, pārvietot un izmantot darbam nepieciešamos būvmateriālus, instrumentus un aprīkojumu;

  • uzturēt darba vietā kārtību un ievērot būvobjekta iekšējās kārtības noteikumus;

  • ievērot darba aizsardzības, ugunsdrošības un darba instrumentu lietošanas prasības;

  • izpildīt tiešā darba vadītāja uzdevumus atbilstoši būvobjektā veicamajiem remonta darbiem;

  • nodrošināt kvalitatīvu un savlaicīgu uzticēto darbu izpildi.

    • Prasības kandidātiem:

    • vismaz pamatizglītība;

    • augsta atbildības sajūta par veicamā darba kvalitāti;

    • precizitāte un godprātīga attieksme pret darbu;

    • labas saskarsmes un komunikācijas prasmes;

    • vēlme mācīties un paaugstināt savu profesionālo kvalifikāciju;

    • spēja strādāt gan patstāvīgi, gan komandā;

    • bez kaitī

jobs.title: ELEKTROMONTIERIS
jobs.description:
SIA “KogotElektro”

 Reģ.Nr. 40203494184​

 aicina darbā ELEKTROMONTIERUS

Darba pienākumi:

Elektroinstalāciju montāža, apkope un remonts dažādos objektos.

Bojājumu diagnostika un tehnisko problēmu novēršana.

Materiālu un tehnikas sagādes plānošana sadarbībā ar noliktavu.

Ikdienas darbu plānošana, izpildes kontrole un atskaišu sagatavošana.

Efektīva komunikācija ar darbā iesaistītajām personām.

Darba vieta Ikšķilē, Līvciema iela 9 ar izbraukumiem uz objektiem visā Latvijas teritorijā.

Prasības:

Elektromontiera kursi.

Pieredze ar elektroinstalāciju montāžu 2 (divi) gadi.

Elektrodrošības grupa BZ, B, CZ, C.

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
jobs.description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Senior Controller
jobs.description:
Senior Controller

Work tasks: As part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in the areas of packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, as well as one of the world’s largest privately owned forest owners. We believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future.
Our company employs approximately 19,000 people. Our global Finance Operations unit handles accounting activities and provides financial services across a range of areas. In the world of finance, we value accuracy, collaboration and innovation. Career for a better climate. Every day. Your Responsibilities as a Senior Controller Act as a Finance Business Partner for a business area/business unit, legal entity or group function. Lead or support controlling and financial reporting processes for the entity/function within your area of responsibility. Be responsible for the effective and accurate period-end closing, analysis and reporting activities of the entity/function. Contribute to and support the implementation and management of an efficient and accurate forecasting and budgeting process within the entity/function. Represent the entity/function in queries related to other Finance Operations processes, including Record to Report (RtR), Purchase to Pay (PtP) and Order to Cash (OtC). Ensure the implementation and compliance with Stora Enso’s financial processes and policies within the entity/function. Proactively identify opportunities for improvement, make recommendations and lead changes to continuously improve and harmonise end-to-end controlling processes. Lead and support process automation and other development projects. Ensure close collaboration and effective information flow between the entity/function, the Finance department and key stakeholders across other functions. Support and train stakeholders on controlling-related topics. What We Expect from You A Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in controlling, management reporting or accounting. A good understanding of controlling processes, including period-end closing, operational financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting. Good knowledge of controlling tools and analytics platforms, such as Excel, SAP, OneStream and Power BI. Experience in leading process improvement and harmonisation initiatives. A change-oriented mindset – you are willing to improve processes, develop new ways of working and promote standardisation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and quality. The ability to work in a matrix organisation and in an international environment. Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence others and explain complex financial information to people who are not finance specialists. Very good command of English, both spoken and written.

We offer: By joining us, you will become part of an organisation with a diverse and inclusive work culture that supports you in discovering new perspectives and developing professionally.
You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as we believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future. To help you perform your work safely and feel well, we support both your physical and mental wellbeing. This is a permanent position with an open-ended employment contract. How to Apply You can submit your application to us only in English, using our recruitment system. We hope to receive your application as soon as possible, but no later than 24 September. If you have any questions, please contact our People and Culture representative, Alena Stesnerova, at alena.stesnerova[at]storaenso.com.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Software Engineer, User Database Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

You’ll build the systems that let any knowledge worker leverage fast, scalable databases without having to become a DBA.

You’ll be a hands-on technical leader, helping set the architectural direction and roadmap as we take a new product from early alpha to general availability. You’ll work directly with early customers to shape foundational technical and product decisions. Then, together, we’ll work on scaling as adoption and workloads grow.

This is a backend-leaning role with work spanning the stack. You might build the systems that provision and manage a fleet of customer Postgres instances, design how user-defined schemas evolve safely, or make complex queries execute efficiently. You’ll also follow those systems into the product: improving how a table loads, how users understand a slow operation, or how an agent safely works with their data.

You’ll help shape the architecture and the product together. Some problems call for a better abstraction, others for a better default, and others for rethinking what we ask the user to do in the first place. You’ll work with teammates and customers to find those answers, ship practical solutions, and evolve them as usage grows.



Our stack includes Postgres, Go, TypeScript, Node.js, and React.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

The people who understand a business best aren’t always the people who can build its software. A support lead knows how tickets should be triaged. An operations manager knows how inventory should move. But turning that knowledge into a reliable system often means finding an engineer, provisioning a database, and building an application.

We’re building database infrastructure for everyone else. We want everyday knowledge workers to bring their data into Notion, connect it, and build workflows around it. And do so with the power of a real database (Postgres!) and the approachability of a tool they already know.

AI agents make that opportunity even bigger: helping people build and operate systems they couldn’t have created on their own.

For our team, this is much more than putting a friendly interface on Postgres. It means making hard database problems disappear from the user’s workflow without sacrificing correctness, performance, or flexibility. How do you let someone reshape a live database as easily as editing a document? Make the right indexes exist without asking someone to become a DBA? Let a weekend experiment grow into a company’s system of record without anyone having to rearchitect it?




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Take a new product from alpha to general availability. Work with early customers to understand what matters, iterate on feedback, and help shape what we ship.

 - Make real customer workloads fast. Improve query execution, indexing, and client data loading so performance holds up as datasets grow and workflows become more demanding.

 - Build systems businesses can trust with their data. Make schema changes, concurrent writes, permissions, and recovery reliable enough for customers to build essential workflows on top.

 - Make powerful capabilities approachable. Turn database provisioning, migrations, and indexes into a reliable, easy-to-use product experience that gives people the power of a database without the burden of managing one.

 - Build for the customers who come next. Automate database provisioning and fleet operations, strengthen observability, and evolve the architecture so we can serve many, many customers.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Production relational database experience (e.g., Postgres or MySQL). You’ve made decisions about schemas and indexes, analyzed database performance, and debugged issues involving transactions, locking, or concurrency. Your experience goes beyond accessing a database through an ORM.

 - Engineering experience and technical leadership. You bring 10+ years of experience building and operating production software, with a track record of setting technical direction and leading complex, cross-team initiatives from concept through delivery. You identify the most important problems to solve, turn ambiguous goals into a technical strategy, and align engineers and partner teams around a practical plan. You stay hands-on while helping others make better decisions through design reviews, mentorship, and clear technical guidance.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals. You’ve built services that need to remain correct under concurrency and failure. You can reason about retries, partial failures, consistency, and the trade-offs involved in reliable reads and writes.

 - A systematic approach to performance. You use query plans, traces, profiles, and experiments to find bottlenecks and verify improvements. You’re willing to follow a problem across storage, services, and client code rather than stopping at a team boundary.

 - Product judgment. You’re interested in who will use what you build, not just how it works. You can turn a customer’s problem into a technical approach and recognize when a better default or simpler workflow would solve it more effectively.

 - Willingness to work across the stack. You bring backend depth, but you’re comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and working in client code when that’s what delivering a good experience requires.

 - Fluency with AI-assisted engineering. You use AI to accelerate exploration, implementation, and testing while taking responsibility for understanding and validating the result.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience managing fleets of databases or building database platforms, including provisioning, upgrades, backups, and recovery.

 - Deep Postgres expertise, such as advanced query optimization, performance tuning, or workload isolation for large datasets and high-concurrency workloads.

 - Experience building query layers, sync engines, change-data-capture pipelines, permission systems, or other reusable data abstractions.
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $299,000 – $334,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: DIRECTEUR / DIRECTRICE D'HÔTEL - SAISON D'HIVER (H/F)
jobs.description:
**Entreprise**

Madame Vacances est un acteur majeur de l'hôtellerie et des résidences de tourisme en France, proposant des séjours dans des destinations variées, de la montagne à la mer. Rejoindre nos équipes, c'est partager notre passion pour l'accueil et contribuer chaque jour à offrir à nos clients des vacances inoubliables.

**Poste**

**Des clients heureux, des équipes heureuses, avant tout**

Nos Directeurs d'hôtel vivent et respirent la satisfaction client. Ils savent qu'un service exceptionnel repose sur toute une équipe partageant la même philosophie : nos clients consacrent un budget important à leurs vacances et méritent un excellent séjour.

**Contrat, rémunération et conditions**

Pour la saison d'hiver, nos Directeurs commencent généralement autour du 1er décembre et terminent environ une semaine après la fermeture de l'hôtel. Ils bénéficient d'un contrat cadre, avec l'autonomie et la flexibilité liées à leurs responsabilités. Le logement est fourni pendant toute la durée du contrat. Une prime de fin de saison peut être attribuée selon les performances.

Rémunération mensuelle indicative selon l'expérience et l'établissement :

- Plus de 65 chambres : 4 000 à 4 500 € brut, ou 6 000 à 6 500 € pour un couple assurant ensemble la direction.

- 40 à 65 chambres : 3 300 à 3 800 € brut, ou 5 000 à 6 000 € pour un couple.

- Hôtels plus petits : 2 500 à 3 300 € brut, ou 4 500 à 5 200 € pour un couple.

**Profil et responsabilités**

Nos Directeurs arrivent dans un hôtel préparé pour la saison : personnel recruté, fournisseurs référencés, produits et services définis et organisation mise en place. Leur mission est de faire fonctionner cette organisation efficacement, tout en assurant les dernières ventes localement lorsque des chambres restent disponibles.

Ils consacrent l'essentiel de leur temps aux clients et aux équipes : organisation des plannings, management des responsables de service, communication avec le siège, suivi du reporting et présence active dans l'établissement.

Dans un hôtel, les imprévus font partie du quotidien : absences, problèmes techniques, neige, arrivées tardives, clients difficiles ou services particulièrement chargés. Nos Directeurs sont donc avant tout des personnes de terrain, capables de retrousser leurs manches lorsque nécessaire.

Cela peut signifier aider au bar, faire la plonge, préparer des chambres avec l'équipe housekeeping, déneiger une terrasse, porter des bagages ou prendre personnellement en charge un client rencontrant un problème.

Ils dirigent par l'exemple, assument leurs responsabilités et trouvent des solutions sans attendre systématiquement l'intervention du siège.

Ils veillent à ce que les équipes soient ponctuelles, professionnelles, correctement présentées et pleinement tournées vers le client. Ils gèrent les problématiques RH quotidiennes, assurent la bonne organisation des plannings et veillent à une excellente communication entre les différents services.

Qu'ils excellent dans la délégation ou préfèrent être très présents sur le terrain, nos Directeurs savent intervenir personnellement lorsque la situation l'exige.

**Ce qui compte, c'est le résultat**

jobs.title: Business Operations & Strategy
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an opportunity to serve as a key partner and advisor on Notion’s Business Operations team, working primarily with our Engineering, Product, & Design teams. Business Operations is a cross-functional team that partners with senior leaders across the company, focusing on high-impact strategic projects and analysis. In this role, you’ll work hand-in-hand with leadership to identify, structure, and act on the most challenging strategic and operational questions impacting our business.



This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Build trusted relationships with cross-functional leaders to define and implement strategy across all Notion products, driving increased value to our users and our business

 - Structure complex, ambiguous strategic problems for the Notion leadership team, defining clear hypotheses and building detailed business cases and quantitative models that will inform and influence our approach

 - Work closely with cross-functional leaders to define and manage key drivers of business performance, identifying areas of opportunity and incorporating them into your work

jobs.title: Bogholder til Skoda Nørresundby
jobs.description:
Bogholder til Škoda Nørresundby – få en central rolle i vores spændende hus

Er du skarp til tal, har du styr på detaljerne – og trives du med at have ansvar og overblik?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter som vores nye bogholder hos Škoda Nørresundby.

Vi søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst kollega, som får en central rolle i vores økonomifunktion. Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift og samtidig en tæt samarbejdspartner for ledelsen og kollegerne på tværs af forretningen.

EN ROLLE MED ANSVAR OG OVERBLIK

Som bogholder får du ansvar for en bred vifte af opgaver inden for økonomi og regnskab. Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

▪️ Daglig bogføring og finans ▪️ Kreditor- og debitorstyring ▪️ Bankafstemninger og betalinger ▪️ Momsafstemning og momsindberetning ▪️ Måneds- og årsafslutning ▪️ Løn og personaleadministration ▪️ Økonomiske rapporter og nøgletal ▪️ Afstemning af bilanlæg, lager og øvrige balanceposter ▪️ Kontakt til revisor ▪️ Løbende optimering og effektivisering af økonomiprocesserne

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor du både arbejder selvstændigt med dine egne ansvarsområder og har tæt kontakt til resten af organisationen.

ET LILLE HUS MED STORE AMBITIONER

Škoda Nørresundby er en mindre, men ambitiøs bilforretning, hvor vi kender hinanden og hjælper hinanden på tværs af afdelingerne.

Hos os er der kort fra idé til handling, og vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes sammen.

Det gælder også økonomien. Vi har brug for en kollega, som ikke bare ser tal og posteringer, men som har lyst til at forstå forretningen og være med til at skabe struktur, overblik og gode processer.

Vi har en uformel omgangstone, et stærkt kollegaskab og en hverdag, hvor der også er plads til humor.

HVEM ER DU?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

▪️ Har erfaring fra en lignende stilling som bogholder ▪️ Har en relevant økonomisk uddannelse ▪️ Arbejder struktureret og detaljeorienteret ▪️ Er fortrolig med Excel og økonomisystemer ▪️ Har forståelse for regnskab fra A-Z ▪️ Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar ▪️ Er god til at samarbejde på tværs af organisationen ▪️ Har naturligt fokus på at skabe overblik og sikre, at tingene stemmer

HVAD FÅR DU HOS OS?

Du får en spændende og alsidig stilling i en forretning, hvor din indsats kan mærkes.

Vi tilbyder:

▪️ En central rolle med stort ansvar og indflydelse ▪️ Mulighed for at udvikle og præge økonomifunktionen ▪️ Dygtige og engagerede kolleger ▪️ En uformel hverdag med plads til humor og godt kollegaskab ▪️ Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling ▪️ Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter kvalifikationer og erfaring

Stillingen er på mellem 30-37 timer og kan således tilpasses dine ønsker og behov.

LYDER DET SOM NOGET FOR DIG?

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen og har lyst til at blive en del af Škoda Nørresundby, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV til Torben Vinter: tovin@skoda-norresundby.dk

Alle henvendelser behandles naturligvis fortroligt.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller hverdagen hos os, er du meget velkommen til at ringe til Torben på 40 30 61 89 og tage en uforpligtende snak.

Strong communication, interpersonal, reflective practice and report-writing skills. Ability to work independently and within a team, support colleagues, build positive relationships with young people and remain calm in crisis situations. Please note that we are currently accepting applications **only from candidates who already have the right to work in Finland.** Unfortunately, due to the processing times for work permits and the schedule of our recruitment, we are unable to consider applications from candidates who would require a new work permit to work in Finland. **This includes applicants from the UK, Australia, and other non-EU countries who do not already hold a valid right to work in Finland.**

Due to long distances, you may also occasionally transport staff between different locations, or between the workplace and staff accommodation.

The vehicles you drive will vary from passenger cars to vans, 9seat minibuses, and even vans equipped with a tail lift that can be driven with a category B driving license. Our working language is English, so good English skills is considered an advantage.

In addition to a valid driving license, we expect flexibility regarding tasks and working hours, as your workdays may sometimes be long. You are the person we are looking for if you are hardworking, proactive, well organized, and reliable.

The work is physically demanding and partly carried out in challenging weather conditions, including Laplands winds and snowstorms. You will work as part of a larger equipment maintenance team, and your contribution is highly important to the operation of Lapland Safaris.

- A great team to work with

- The beautiful landscapes of Lapland

- An easy way to start working in the field of tourism in Lapland

- Numerous leisure opportunities

- Comprehensive staff benefits from Lapland Hotels & Safaris, including discounts on equipment rental, restaurants, and lift tickets at Lapland Ski Resorts.

. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A, hourly wage starting from 11,30 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. jobs.title: Factory Training & Development Specialist
jobs.description:
**The opportunity**

Join Hitachi Energy in shaping the future of learning and growth! We're looking for a dynamic Factory Training & Development Specialist to lead impactful programs at our Transformers Factory in Vaasa.

The Transformers Business Unit is a core part of Hitachi Energy, enabling reliable power transmission and distribution worldwide. Over the years, the Vaasa factory has become one of Finland's largest and most important transformer manufacturing plant, contributing significantly to national energy security. Today, the factory develops and manufactures transformers that ensure electricity flows to millions of homes worldwide. The site operates in a complex manufacturing environment with high safety standards and a strong focus on sustainability, quality, and continuous improvement, serving customers globally both within and outside Hitachi Energy.

In this role, you will design and deliver innovative training experiences that empower teams, foster leadership, and drive operational excellence. If you're passionate about helping people unlock their potential and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this is your chance to make a real difference.

**How you'll make an impact**

· Drive factory training activities according to the agreed training roadmap, production needs and HUB guidance.

· Lead the practical implementation of Structured-On-The-Job training for direct workforce, including schedules, participants, trainers and documentation.

· Maintain course assignments, training records, certifications and completion data in the appointed Learning Management System (LMS).

· Prepare regular training status reports, dashboards or data extracts to support follow-up and decision-making.

· Coordinate with trainers and SMEs to prepare, update and validate training materials and work instruction related content.

· Follow up overdue, mandatory or certification-related trainings and escalate gaps when needed.

· Collect feedback from participants, trainers and stakeholders and drive agreed improvement actions.

· Communicate training schedules, requirements and practical instructions to relevant employees and managers.

· Provide accurate training records and evidence for audits, compliance checks and training documentation requests.

· Contribute to and drive continuous improvement of training processes, tools and ways of working within the factory.

**Your background**

· A B.Sc., M.Sc. or equivalent degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, HR, Education, Business Administration or another relevant field

· Relevant experience in training coordination, production training, technical instruction, LMS administration or manufacturing support roles.

· Good understanding of manufacturing environment, shopfloor operations and competence development needs for direct workforce.

· Experience with Learning Management Systems, training data maintenance and reporting tools such as Excel and PowerBI is an advantage.

· Ability to coordinate multiple training activities, follow up details and maintain accurate documentation.

· Strong collaboration, communication and stakeholder service mindset.

· Structured, proactive and quality-oriented way of working with a continuous improvement mindset.

· Familiarity with transformer manufacturing is an advantage.

· Fluency in both Finnish and English, written and spoken.

We are looking for a strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.


A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. 

After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since.

As part of A·Team, you can expect:

  • High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc.
  • Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can.
  • Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. 
  • Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about.
  • Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.

 

 

How to apply:

Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit.

What you’ll do:

  • Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would

  • Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. 

  • You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. 

Who A·Team is for:

  • Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

  • Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

  • The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

Who A·Team is not for:

  • People looking for small gigs

  • Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

  • Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

Our long-term vision:

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. 

To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

jobs.title: Doctoral Researcher: MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC 06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries
jobs.description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Position details

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI-Mediated Communication and Collaboration Norms at Work.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

As AI becomes embedded in everyday work, employees increasingly interact with AI agents, but also encounter AI-mediated contributions from colleagues. Messages may be written, filtered or delivered with AI, while autonomous agents increasingly participate in work processes and collaboration.

This doctoral project examines how these developments shape relational aspects of work, (which may include authenticity, trust, social connection, and experiences of loneliness), as people negotiate emerging norms around AI use, disclosure, and appropriate forms of interaction. Through ethnographic research in AI-intensive settings, you will follow relational practices as they evolve over time and identify the mechanisms behind change.

The project will develop evidence-based guidance that supports transparency, social connection and responsible AI use in organisational life. Practitioner outputs include AI- aware communication norms, guidance on disclosure and authenticity in AI-assisted exchanges, and leadership practices that protect social connection and prevent relational deterioration. In addition, the doctoral project is expected to advance scientific knowledge in relation to the doctoral topic.

Your work

- Examine how interactions among people, AI agents and AI-mediated communication shape workplace relationships and collaboration.
- Conduct ethnographic research on how employees make sense of and negotiate AI use in workplace interactions, including norms of disclosure and transparency, and how these processes shape relational aspects of work.
- Identify the mechanisms through which AI-mediated contributions and autonomous agents reshape relational dynamics, and develop evidence-based guidance for responsible and socially sustainable AI use.
- Develop AI-aware communication norms and leadership guidance that protect social connection at work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.
