jobs.title: Indkøbsansvarlig
jobs.description:
Er du den, der kan sikre, at de rette materialer kommer i hus, og har du mod på en rolle med indkøb og teamansvar som omdrejningspunkt?


Stillingen ved Evapco Europe byder på et bredt ansvar i en veletableret, international vækstvirksomhed, hvor du kan forme din rolle og gøre en forskel.

¤Ansvarsområder

Som supply chain team lead hos Evapco Europe bliver du en vigtig del af indkøbsafdelingen i Aabybro. Du får ansvar for operationelt indkøb, primært ordrebaseret, samt teamledelsen af en shippingmedarbejder/indkøber og to lagermedarbejdere. Strategisk indkøb fylder ca. 30 % i jobbet. Du vil opleve et bredt samarbejde med både salg, produktion, lager og leverandører, og derfor er evnen til at kommunikere bredt en vigtig succesfaktor i jobbet. Virksomheden har ved årsskiftet konverteret til Business Central fra Axapta.

¤Dine arbejdsopgaver:

• Dagligt ordrebaseret indkøb af og kontraktforhandlinger på materialer og råvarer, særligt rustfrit stål, kobber m.m.
• Forecasting
• Logistik og ordretransport
• Dialog og koordinering med leverandører i bl.a. Danmark, Italien og Kina
• Kvartalsvise budget- og prisindekseringsmøder med ledelsen
• Daglig teamledelse samt årlige løn- og medarbejdersamtaler

Du vil i jobbet referere til den europæiske indkøbsdirektør, der er lokaliseret i Italien, og du vil samarbejde med dine kolleger i Belgien og Italien. Der vil være ca. 20 årlige rejsedage, primært i forbindelse med leverandørbesøg.

¤Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du kommer med nogle års erfaring som indkøber, supply chain-ansvarlig eller lignende i en produktions- eller industrivirksomhed. Du trives med operationelt indkøb og synes, det vil være en spændende udfordring at motivere og lede et mindre team.
Som person ser vi gerne, at du er struktureret og selvstændig, og at du kan lide at skabe relationer til både dine leverandører og kolleger.
Koncernsproget er engelsk, så gode kundskaber i både skrift og tale er vigtigt.

¤Evapco tilbyder

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed med en flad struktur, hvor humøret er højt og samarbejdet godt blandt de 65 kolleger på tværs af afdelingerne. Udover dette vil du få løn efter kvalifikationer. Der vil være fokus på din trivsel og udvikling, og der er derfor mulighed for uddannelser og kurser.
Evapco har dansk kontor i Aabybro, nord for Aalborg. Du kan læse mere på: www.evapco.dk

¤Ansøgning


Vi søger en medarbejder, der kan starte hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette i forhold til opsigelsesperiode. Send gerne din ansøgning og dit CV. Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte seniorkonsulent Jesper Høgh på tlf. 92 92 16 38.
Denne rekruttering håndteres af Randstad, og alle henvendelser bedes rettet hertil.

¤Om Evapco Europe A/S
Evapco Europe er specialiseret inden for produktion og udvikling af specialdesignede varmevekslere til en lang række brancher inden for bl.a. energi-, fødevare- og industrisektoren. Evapco Europe har fabrikker i Italien, Belgien og Danmark og er en del af en større global organisation med hovedsæde i Taneytown, Maryland, USA. Evapco Europe blev grundlagt i 1992 som Flex Coil, blev i 2009 opkøbt af amerikanske Evapco og består i dag af samlet 3.000 dygtige kolleger. Man har vækstet støt de senere år, og det forventes at fortsætte i de kommende år.

¤Om Randstad
Hos Randstad hjælper vi mennesker og virksomheder med at udnytte deres fulde potentiale. Vi kombinerer viden med moderne teknologi for at skabe forandringer, der hjælper mennesker fremad. Vi kalder det Human Forward.
Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group, som er verdens største udbyder af HR-løsninger. Med over 4.700 kontorer fordelt på 39 lande formidler vi hver dag arbejde til mere end 650.000 mennesker verden over.
I Danmark er vi blandt de førende vikar- og rekrutteringsbureauer med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding. En position, vi har opnået, fordi vi som eksperter på arbejdsmarkedet formår at matche kvalificerede kandidater med de rette jobmuligheder.

jobs.title: Technicien / Technicienne de hot line en informatique
jobs.description:
Enreach for Service Providers développe la plateforme UCaaS sur laquelle les opérateurs télécoms à travers l'Europe font fonctionner leurs communications professionnelles. Nous sommes environ 60 personnes basées à Sophia-Antipolis, membres du groupe Enreach. Notre logiciel est utilisé par des centaines de milliers d'utilisateurs de téléphonie professionnelle. Ici, le support n'est pas une simple fonction de déviation d'appels. C'est le point de contact où la plateforme rencontre la réalité du terrain.

Vos missions :
Être en première ligne : répondre à la hotline de support, qualifier les tickets Jira entrants et effectuer le premier diagnostic réel de chaque problème avant qu'il ne soit transmis ailleurs. C'est vous qui décidez de l'urgence.
Accompagner nos partenaires EUPCloud : nos partenaires SaaS ne disposent pas de leurs propres équipes opérationnelles. Ils comptent sur nous. Vous travaillerez directement avec eux - via Jira, les canaux Teams, le téléphone - pour les guider dans la configuration et les aider à comprendre leur propre plateforme. Cette partie du rôle est nouvelle, et c'est la raison pour laquelle nous recrutons.
Savoir gérer efficacement :  lorsqu'un problème dépasse le niveau L1, vous le documentez correctement et assurez le suivi jusqu'à sa résolution. Ici, on ne se contente pas de traiter des tickets à moitié diagnostiqués.
Documenter les procédures : tout problème que vous résolvez deux fois aurait dû être documenté une fois. Notre base de connaissances est le levier qui permet à l'équipe de gagner en rapidité.
Monter en expertise avec le temps : vous commencerez par le triage. En l'espace d'un an, vous connaîtrez notre plateforme mieux que la plupart de ceux qui l'ont construite, car vous aurez vu toutes les façons dont elle peut tomber en panne.

Votre profil :

Maîtrise du français et aisance en anglais : vous travaillerez en français au quotidien. Cependant, nos partenaires étant répartis dans toute l'Europe, vous devrez également répondre à des appels de la hotline et rédiger des mises à jour de tickets en anglais. Votre anglais n'a pas besoin d'être parfait ou sans accent. Il doit être suffisamment bon pour qu'un ingénieur stressé à Rotterdam se sente pris en charge.
Quelqu'un qui aime le téléphone : pas quelqu'un qui le "tolère", mais qui l'aime. Guider calmement un ingénieur stressé à travers un problème, un vendredi à 16h, est une véritable compétence et est au cœur de ce métier.
Curiosité pour le fonctionnement des systèmes : vous avez cassé quelque chose, vous avez compris pourquoi, et vous l'avez réparé. Linux et Unix, le réseau, et idéalement une première approche de SIP ou VoIP - même s'il s'agit simplement d'un serveur Asterisk maison et de beaucoup de Wireshark.
Autonome : on vous donnera un problème, pas un script. Il s'agit d'une petite équipe de personnes expérimentées qui agissent vite et n'attendent pas qu'on leur dise quoi faire.
Quelqu'un qui tire les autres vers le haut : nous déboguons ensemble, nous nous enseignons mutuellement, et personne ici ne garde ses connaissances pour soi. Si cela vous semble évident, nous nous entendrons bien.

Les petits plus (atouts) :
Maîtrise de Linux (famille Rocky / RHEL) au-delà des bases.
Connaissance de SIP, RTP, et les joies spécifiques du débogage d'un problème d'audio unidirectionnel.
Capacité à scripter dans n'importe quel langage.
Allemand, néerlandais ou espagnol : ces langues sont un plus, mais aucune n'est obligatoire.

Jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail par semaine, une fois que vous aurez été pleinement intégré et que vous travaillerez en autonomie.

Laadukkaan perehdytyksen: pääset alkuun kokeneen työkaverin rinnalla.
Itsenäisen, vaihtelevan ja ratkaisukeskeisen työn sekä vahvan tiimin tuen.
Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi.

Olet sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilörekisteriin merkitty nimikesuojattu lähihoitaja tai perushoitaja.
Sinulla on hyvät työyhteisö- ja tiimityötaidot sekä valmius itsenäiseen työskentelyyn.

Toivomme, että voit aloittaa tehtävässä mahdollisimman pian, sovimme aloituksesta kanssasi erikseen. Toinen tehtävistä päättyy 1.11.2026 ja toinen 10.1.2027. jobs.title: Junior IT Service Manager for energy sector, Espoo
jobs.description:
About the role

In this role, you will work closely with a Senior Manager while collaborating with a team of specialists to ensure system reliability. You will gain hands-on experience and take ownership of daily operational processes for a critical SaaS-based Customer Information System (CIS). This position offers an ideal stepping stone for anyone looking to build a successful career in IT service management.

You are offered
- Gain valuable, practical experience managing operations for a large-scale enterprise Customer Information System.
- Take real ownership of critical processes like release management, access control, and stakeholder communication.
- Enjoy modern working methods, competitive benefits, and a balance of team collaboration and independent work.

Work tasks

While the exact day-to-day duties will be shaped around your personal strengths and prior background, your main responsibilities will cover:
- Incident & Performance Monitoring: Support major and critical incident communications, monitor overall service performance, and ensure open issues and operational tickets progress smoothly.
- Release & Stakeholder Communication: Keep business stakeholders, internal IT teams, and vendors aligned through clear updates, service announcements, and release notes.
- Cross-Team & Vendor Coordination: Drive daily operational activities, facilitate testing, and coordinate tasks between internal specialists and external service providers.
- Service Management & Documentation: Maintain accurate IT service documentation in Confluence, support audit and compliance checks, and assist the Senior Manager with ad-hoc coordination tasks.

We are looking for

- Relevant higher education degree (e.g., Business Information Technology, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or similar).
- Previous practical experience in IT or software environments—such as hands-on project experience, acting as a Key User, or serving as a Scrum Master.
- Basic understanding of IT service management (ITSM) concepts and SaaS operational models.
- Strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills in English.

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Finnish

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Trustful
- Social
- Orderly
- Responsible

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.description:
Autoriseret kloakmester – 4-dages uge, stor frihed og mulighed for medejer

Vil du have mere frihed, færre arbejdsdage og en reel mulighed for at få indflydelse og ejerskab?
Så er det her ikke bare et job – det er en mulighed.

Vi søger en autoriseret kloakmester til en spændende og alsidig stilling i en mindre, veldrevet virksomhed med base i Thy.
Du kan bo hvor som helst i Danmark – det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ansvar og arbejde en del på Sjælland i en 4-dages arbejdsuge.

Det får du

-4-dages arbejdsuge (mandag–torsdag)
 -Stor frihed til selv at planlægge din hverdag
 -Firmabil og alt nødvendigt udstyr
 -Varierede opgaver – ingen ensformige dage
 -Kort vej fra idé til handling
 -Mulighed for medejer/partnerskab på sigt

Hverdagen

Du får en alsidig hverdag med både store og små opgaver – fra nyanlæg, renovering og dræn til fejlfinding, dokumentation og kvalitetssikring.

Du bliver en nøgleperson i virksomheden med tæt kundekontakt, samarbejde med entreprenører og direkte indflydelse på, hvordan opgaver løses, og hvordan forretningen udvikler sig.

Vi leder efter dig, der

• Er autoriseret kloakmester
• Bor et sted i Danmark og er fleksibel ift. opgaver på Sjælland
• Trives med ansvar og selvstændigt arbejde
• Har styr på kvalitet, dokumentation og struktur
• Har ambitioner og lyst til at være med på den lange bane
• Er typen, der ser muligheder – ikke begrænsninger

Om virksomheden

Virksomheden er en mindre, seriøs og ambitiøs aktør med fokus på kvalitet, ordentlighed og langvarige kunderelationer. Der er styr på tingene – og samtidig plads til nye idéer og udvikling.

For den rette kandidat er der en realistisk mulighed for medejer/partnerskab, hvis kemien og ambitionerne matcher.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning og CV til dg@kvr.dk
Har du spørgsmål, så ring til Dan Gyldenberg på 25 38 84 06

Vi holder samtaler løbende – og venter gerne på den rette.

jobs.description:
**Lähihoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen – Lahti**

Tarjolla on vakituinen työsuhde monipuolisissa kotihoidon tehtävissä. Tehtävä sopii niin kokeneelle lähihoitajalle kuin opintojensa loppuvaiheessa olevalle lähihoitajaopiskelijalle. Tärkeintä on hyvä asenne, vastuullinen työote ja halu tehdä merkityksellistä työtä asiakkaiden arjessa.

Tehtävässä tarvitset lähihoitajan tutkinnon tai loppuvaiheen lähihoitajaopinnot. Lisäksi odotamme:

- voimassa olevia LOVE-lääkelupia tai valmiutta niiden suorittamiseen

- B-ajokorttia

- riittäviä ATK-taitoja

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- itsenäistä ja vastuullista työotetta


Ensiaputaidot katsotaan eduksi.

- vakituisen työsuhteen

- TES mukaisen palkkauksen

- tarvittaessa koulutusta ATK-, LOVE- ja ensiapuosaamisen päivittämiseen

- monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen työn

- mukavan työyhteisön ja tuen työhösi


Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Lähetä hakemuksesi meille jo tänään! Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja etenemme sopivien hakijoiden kanssa nopeasti.

**_Staffgate Oy_** _on suomalainen henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluja tarjoava yritys. Asiakkaamme toimivat monilla eri toimialoilla. Autamme työntekijöitä löytämään työtä ja onnistumaan työelämässä mahdollisimman hyvin._

jobs.title: Project Engineer, ABB Marine & Ports
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated Project Engineer to join ABB Marine & Ports and support the delivery of advanced marine electrical, propulsion, and control system projects.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or an early-career engineer who wants to develop technical expertise within a global engineering organization and gain hands-on experience in international delivery projects.

Your responsibilities

As a Project Engineer, you will:

- Support Lead Engineers in delivery project engineering and design activities
- Assist in technical problem-solving throughout the project lifecycle
- Participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and related engineering activities
- Prepare and maintain technical documentation
- Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams on system integration and troubleshooting
- Contribute to the development and improvement of engineering processes and ways of working
- Support project teams in ensuring successful project execution and delivery

You will have the opportunity to work with systems such as:

- Generators
- Main switchboards and power distribution systems
- Transformers
- Converters and drives
- Propulsion Control Systems (PCS)
- Remote Control Systems (RCS)
- Dynamic Positioning (DP) systems
- Marine automation and control systems

What we are looking for

To succeed in this role, we hope you have:

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Good written and spoken English communication skills
- Ability to work effectively in an international project environment
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn
- Interest in electrical systems, automation, and engineering projects

Considered an advantage

- Familiarity with EPLAN or other electrical design tools
- Knowledge of IEC or IEEE standards
- Previous project, internship, or thesis experience related to electrical engineering or automation
- Interest in marine technology and power systems

What we offer

- Opportunity to work with world-leading marine technologies
- Exposure to challenging international delivery projects
- Great opportunities for professional growth and development

Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications and interview suitable candidates during the application period. The position will be filled once a suitable candidate has been found.

Please note that, for GDPR and data security reasons, we are unable to process applications submitted by email or through other channels. To be considered for the position, please submit your application through our recruitment system on our website.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in AI-Assisted Software and Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. 

The Software Engineering group conducts research in a wide range of topics related to design, development, verification, and operation of complex software systems, including emerging technologies and their relation to Software Engineering. You will join a diverse research environment and an exciting Doctoral Programme.

Your immediate leader will be the Leader of the Software Engineering unit.


About the project

Software is today prominent in many critical systems and infrastructures, such as power distribution systems, railway infrastructure, or flight control systems. These systems are subject to complex development and verification processes, including certification and audits, and in general different activities that span the Software Engineering and the Systems Engineering disciplines.

Generative AI and AI agents are rapidly changing how software-based systems are being designed, developed, and evaluated. While AI agents have become common in certain Software Engineering tasks, such as programming, documentation, and vulnerability detection, their adoption for other tasks such as software architecture design, or safety and hazard analysis, is still limited. 

The objective of this position is to investigate and evaluate solutions for software engineering and systems engineering tasks in critical systems and infrastructures. Within this context, the project can be tailored to the interests and background of the successful candidate.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Author academic publications and popular science dissemination material
  • Participate in the Software Engineering research group
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Support to education activities in courses within the Software Engineering area
  • Other career-promoting work, such as learning grant preparation fundamentals

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the Doctoral Programme in Computer Science, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than 30.10.2026.
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Good programming skills.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English.
     

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria

The following characteristics will be considered an advantage during the selection process:

  • Good understanding of Software Engineering or Systems Engineering fundamentals
  • Experience with modeling of software and/or system architecture
  • Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Microsoft Agent Framework)
  • Good knowledge of AI concepts, particularly Generative AI
  • Knowledge of aspects related to critical systems and infrastructures

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Be good at anticipating problems and identifying logical solutions as well as contradictions and inconsistencies  
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
     

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
  • CV.
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing your own research proposal within the topics of this position, including a description of research questions, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages).
  • Short motivation letter (cover letter) (maximum 400 words/1 page).
  • Scientific publications if you have, or other relevant work that fits the position topics.
  • Names and contact information of three references.
     

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Leonardo Montecchi, +47 734 12 964, leonardo.montecchi@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact our HR hiring team at HR@IDI.ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 08.10.2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Computer Science 

We are the leading academic IT environment in Norway, and offer a wide range of theoretical and applied IT programmes of study at all levels. Our subject areas include hardware, algorithms, visual computing, AI, databases, software engineering, information systems, learning technology, HCI, CSCW, IT operations and applied data processing. The Department has groups in both Trondheim and Gjøvik. The Department of Computer Science is one of seven departments in the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering .

jobs.title: Process Engineer (Surface Treatment)
jobs.description:
Type: permanent, full-time

Location: Perniö, Turku, Tampere, Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Oulu, remote

Application deadline: 28.9.2026

Want to develop surface treatment processes in an international environment and impact production quality and efficiency? Wipro is looking for a Process Engineer!

**What will you be doing?**

We are looking for a Process Engineer to join Wipro Infrastructure Engineering as a technical expert in surface treatment. You will develop and evaluate new and existing surface treatment methods at Wipros manufacturing sites and support production, R&D, and other teams in technical matters. Your work will focus especially on industrial painting and pretreatment processes, corrosion testing, and improving process quality and efficiency.

Your projects may include reducing paint and energy use, improving cycle times, and finding more environmentally friendly solutions. You will also support equipment investments by defining technical requirements and taking part in testing and commissioning. In addition, you will help investigate production issues, support the technical handling of customer complaints, and work with customers, suppliers, and Wipro teams at the manufacturing sites in Perniö, Sweden, and Romania.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You have a strong practical and technical understanding of industrial surface treatment processes and experience in developing them. You understand not only individual process steps but also the whole process and how different changes can affect quality, costs, efficiency, and production. You are interested in improving processes and finding better technical solutions.

This is an independent and international role, so we value an accurate, organized, and proactive way of working as well as good communication and negotiation skills. Working with different teams, suppliers, and customers comes naturally to you, and you can adapt to changing situations. A practical and cost-conscious approach will help you succeed in this role.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant technical degree, for example in chemical, materials, process, production, or mechanical engineering

- Several years of relevant experience in industrial surface treatment and process development

- Strong knowledge of industrial painting and pretreatment processes, as well as electrolytic surface treatment methods

- Experience with AutoCAD and/or other technical design tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, or similar software

- Good English skills and willingness to travel to Wipros sites within Europe


**Additionally valued:**

- Experience with different surface treatment methods, such as nitrocarburizing or chromium processes

- Experience with equipment investments, commissioning, or technical development projects

- Knowledge of surface treatment testing, process requirements, or quality development


**Wipro offers you:**

- The freedom to develop surface treatment processes and make a real impact on quality, efficiency, and sustainability

- An international environment where you work across manufacturing sites and develop your technical skills

- The opportunity to develop new solutions and help shape the future of surface treatment at Wipro

- A varied expert role combining technical development, projects, and practical problem-solving

- The flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in Finland


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy. We hope you are available to start as soon as possible, depending on your notice period.

You can work either at Wipros Perniö site or remotely from anywhere in Finland. The position includes approximately 50–60 travel days per year, mainly to Wipros sites in Finland, Sweden, and Romania. Salary in this position is 4500-5500 €/month (gross), depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**How to apply?**

Please submit your CV and application in PDF format in English by Monday 28th of September via aTalents application system: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/382498/create/ .

Remember to use the application system as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure an equal recruitment process for all applicants and will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can learn more about Wipro Infrastructure Engineering here: https://hydraulics.wiproinfra.com/.

For more information about the position and recruitment process, please contact aTalents Recruitment Consultant Säde Juntunen (+358 44 901 2283, sade.juntunen@atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

**Company description**

_Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy develops, manufactures, and markets high-quality hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic components under the Nummi trademark. The company is also a well-known OEM manufacturer of double-acting hydraulic cylinders. Wipro operates internationally, and about 70% of its turnover comes from exports. In addition to Finland, its main markets are Scandinavia, Poland, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, and Switzerland._

_Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy is a subsidiary of the Indian company Wipro Enterprises. Its parent company, Wipro Ltd, is an international multi-business corporation listed on the New York and Mumbai stock exchanges. The company is headquartered in Bangalore, India. Wipro Infrastructure Engineering has manufacturing facilities in Finland (Perniö), Sweden, Romania, Brazil, India, Canada, and the United States._

jobs.title: Sairaanhoitaja kotihoitoon
jobs.description:
**Sairaanhoitaja – tule tekemään merkityksellistä työtä kanssamme kotihoitoon**

**Haluatko sairaanhoitajan työn, jossa sinulla on aikaa kohdata asiakas ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan työhösi?**

Etsimme sairaanhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Toivomme sinulta oma-aloitteista ja kehitysmyönteistä työotetta, hyviä organisointitaitoja sekä ennen kaikkea halua tehdä laadukasta hoitotyötä yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.

Tässä tehtävässä et ainoastaan suorita työlistaa, vaan pääset ottamaan vastuuta, tukemaan muuta tiimiä ja osallistumaan toiminnan kehittämiseen. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä esihenkilön kanssa ja olet tärkeä osa tiimin päivittäistä toimintaa.

**Mitä työpäivääsi kuuluu?**

- hoitotyön suunnittelua ja koordinointia

- lähihoitajien tukemista arjen työssä

- asiakaskäyntejä, kuten lääkehoitoa, haavanhoitoa ja asiakkaan voinnin arviointia

- hoidon laadun ja sujuvuuden varmistamista

- yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, omaisten ja moniammatillisen työryhmän kanssa

- toiminnan ja toimintatapojen kehittämistä yhdessä tiimin kanssa

- tiivistä yhteistyötä esihenkilön työparina


**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

Tarjoamme **vakituista työtä**, jossa työvuorot sijoittuvat pääosin arkipäiviin. Käytössä on joustava ja autonominen työvuorosuunnittelu, joten pääset vaikuttamaan omiin työvuoroihisi.

Lisäksi tarjoamme:

- TES mukaisen palkan – kuulemme mielellämme myös palkkatoiveesi

- yrityksen auton asiakaskäynteihin

- työterveyshuollon

- mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa työnkuvaasi

- mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä yrityksen mukana

- työyhteisön, jossa yhteistyö ja hyvä arki ovat tärkeässä roolissa


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Tehtävä sopii sairaanhoitajalle, jolla on hyvä asenne, organisointikykyä ja valmiutta ottaa vastuuta. Aikaisempi kokemus vastaavanlaisista tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi.

Edellytämme:

- sairaanhoitajan tutkintoa

- voimassa olevia lääkehoitolupia (LOVE)

- ajokorttia

- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa


Tehtävään valitulta edellytetään rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä ikäihmisten kanssa työskentelyä varten.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos etsit sairaanhoitajan työtä, jossa saat yhdistää käytännön hoitotyön, vastuun ja toiminnan kehittämisen, **haluamme kuulla sinusta!**

**Staffgate Oy** on suomalainen henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluja tarjoava yritys. Asiakkaamme toimivat monilla eri toimialoilla. Autamme työntekijöitä löytämään työtä ja onnistumaan työelämässä mahdollisimman hyvin.

Strong fault-finding and breakdown repair skills, experience working in a manufacturing/production environment preferred. Good communication skills to liaise with fitters, contractors and suppliers. Strong commitment to health and safety, ability to follow preventative maintenance schedules and to work with production teams to minimise downtime. The International School of Vantaa is a multicultural comprehensive school with around 680 students. The school provides English-language instruction for grades 1 - 9. The students' home language is English or they have acquired a good English proficiency by other means. The students are admitted to the school based on a language test. The teachers employed at our school come from various nationalities. Our curricula are based on the National Core Curriculum for Basic Education. Our goal is to raise well-behaving students with versatile general knowledge who can function in English in a global environment.

Our school is situated in the Aviapolis area, on the premises of the Point - Pakkala Learning and Information Centre, in Kartanonkoski. It is in Helsinki Region Transport zone B, and is quickly accessible. Buses from e.g. Sörnäinen metro station take about 25 minutes.

The International School of Vantaa is looking for a class teacher (Päätoiminen tuntiopettaja, luokanopetus). The qualification requirements are higher university degree and class-teacher qualification (degree 986/1998). If the degree has been taken outside Finland, the applicant shall present an equivalent qualification approved by the Finnish National Board of Education.

We are looking for a teacher with good cooperation and communication skills and interest in further developing our school. We offer you a global work community as well as interesting teaching and education tasks in a modern learning environment.

Vantaa is the fourth largest city in our country, with the courage to do things in new ways and the skill to collaborate within various networks. The city is a safe employer that offers its staff extensive opportunities for skill development. In our modern educational institutions, we value not only high-quality education and teaching but also internationalism, multiculturalism, and a sense of community.

Additionally, employees often have access to discounted tickets for cultural events.

If youre still wondering what Vantaa has to offer you, visit our website to find out [more reasons to choose Vantaa](https://www.vantaa.fi/fi/kaupunki-ja-paatoksenteko/avoimet-tyopaikat-vantaan-kaupungilla/johtaminen-tyohyvinvointi-ja-henkilostoedut).

Käytössä olevina apuvälineinä kuulolaitteet ja tukipohjalliset.

Avustustunteja käytettävissä 30t/kk. Työtä tehdään pääsääntöisesti iltapäivisin, iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin tarpeen mukaan. Asiakas käy työtoiminnassa viitenä päivänä viikossa (ma-pe), jonka vuoksi avustustunteja voi olla vähemmän kuukaudessa, esim. 15-20t/kk voisi aluksi olla riittävä.

Lupaamme sinulle:

- mahdollisuuden tehdä työsi hyvin ja asiakasta kunnioittaen

- työyhteisön, jossa saat rohkeasti olla oma itsesi

- lähiesihenkilön tuen

- monipuolisen työnkuvan

- työehdot yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaan

- palkkaluokka on G16A eli palvelusvuosien mukaan 13,20 € - 14,51 € / tunti (+TES:n mukaiset lisät)


Tule mukaan rakentamaan pykälää parempaa maailmaa: Spesio on toiminut sosiaali- ja hyvinvointipalvelualalla pitkään, jo yli 20 vuotta. Työntekijöitä meillä on tällä hetkellä yhteensä reilut 700 ja toimipisteemme sijaitsevat Kuopiossa, Joensuussa ja Tampereella. Palvelutarjontaamme kuuluu henkilökohtainen apu, omaishoidon vapaa, vammaisten kotihoito, vammaisten päivätoiminta, lapsiperheiden kotipalvelu sekä kotiin vietävät palvelut yksityisasiakkaille. Me haluamme, että kaikilla on mahdollisuus omanlaiseensa elämään, ja uskomme että omalla työllä voimme tehdä maailmasta paremman paikan. Jos uskot samaan ja haluat tulla mukaan, laita meille hakemus.

**Työssä vaadittavat rikosrekisteriotteet**

- Vammaisten kanssa työskentelyyn vaaditaan rikosrekisteriote, joka perustuu lakiin sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta (741/2023).

- Iäkkäiden kanssa työskentelyyn vaaditaan rikosrekisteriote, joka perustuu lakiin sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta (741/2023).

jobs.title: Hands-on Data Center Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**

Nordecon Oy is converting a former industrial bakery building in Riihimäki into a data centre designed for AI and high performance computing workloads. Repurposing an existing industrial site brings interesting engineering problems a new build never has.

We are looking for a hands-on Data Center Deployment Engineer to help us build it and then run it. You will be part of the core team in this role, which means you will not inherit someone else's procedures, you will build them.

Founded in 2006, Nordecon is an OEM and solution provider with nearly two decades of experience in mobile, server and custom-built desktop systems. The data centre is the next phase of that business.

**What you will do**

- Plan and oversee the installation of data centre infrastructure: servers, storage, networking and power systems

- Coordinate with vendors and contractors on procurement, installation, commissioning and acceptance testing

- Configure, integrate and troubleshoot systems to keep them performing

- Work with environmental and monitoring systems — cooling, power distribution, alarms

- Carry out site assessments and make sure we meet safety and industry standards

- Write and maintain the documentation: design records, installation procedures, and the operating procedures the site will run on

- Take part in our ISO/IEC 27001 certification work. Building the operational procedures and controls that certification is based on, not just following them

- As the team grows, support and guide our data centre technicians


**What helps you succeed in this role**

- Hands-on experience deploying and operating data centre infrastructure

- Solid understanding of network and data cabling, and of network and power capacity planning

- Strong Linux skills

- Working knowledge of HVAC and cooling dynamics in a data centre context

- Fluent Finnish and good English

- A degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field or equivalent experience earned on the job

- Willingness to be on site in Riihimäki, and to take part in an on-call rotation once the site is live


**Nice to have**

- Experience converting or retrofitting an existing building for data centre or other critical facility use

- Experience commissioning a new site or a major capacity expansion

- Liquid-cooled or high-density deployments

- Exposure to ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or similar management systems

- Electrical or HVAC qualifications


We offer you a permanent full-time position with interesting and versatile tasks with the opportunity to have a real influence on the development of the data center. The applicant must speak Finnish. If you got interested and would like to know more please send your questions, introductions and CV with salary request to applications@nordecon.fi

We read every application, but we are a small team and receive a high volume of them. We will only contact candidates we invite to interview. If you have not heard from us within two weeks of applying, the role has moved forward with other candidates. We know applying takes real effort, and we appreciate the time you put into it.

*

*

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

*

*

   À l'aise avec Docker/Kubernetes et les bases de données PostgreSQL/MongoDB

*

   Une expérience RabbitMQ est un plus

PROCESS DE RECRUTEMENT

jobs.title: Tukiperhe
jobs.description:
Tukiperhetoiminta on tarkoitettu tueksi lapsiperheelle, jossa tarvitaan apua arjen helpottamiseksi kuormittavassa elämäntilanteessa tai johtuen lapsen erityisen tuen tarpeista.

Tukiperhe voi olla lapseton pariskunta, pariskunta, jolla on kotona asuvia lapsia tai yksinasuvan aikuisen perhe, jolla on resursseja ja halua tarjota huolenpitoa sekä turvaa lapsille ja nuorille. Koska lasten ja perheiden tilanteet ja tukitarpeet ovat erilaisia, toimintaan tarvitaan eri-ikäisiä, kulttuuritaustaltaan vaihtelevia ja monenlaisia taitoja omaavia tukiperheitä, jotka voivat vastata lapsen ja perheen tarpeisiin.

Etsimme tukiperheitä erityisesti Uudenmaan alueelta sekä Mikkelin seudulta. Myös muualla asuvat olkaa yhteydessä niin pohditaan tilannettanne.

Lapsi viettää tukiperheessä yleensä yhden viikonlopun kuukaudessa ja loma-aikoina sovitulla tavalla. Tukiperheessä tehdään tavallisia, turvallisen arkisia asioita. Tukiperheen aikuisilla tulisi olla mahdollisuus kuljettaa lasta tukiviikonlopuille ja takaisin kotiin. Tukiperheen oma elämäntilanne on vakaa, perheessä ei ole akuutteja kriisejä tai muita suuria huolia.

AVA valmentaa tukiperheet ja antaa vahvaa tukea koko lapsen tukisuhteen ajan.

Role Summary The Care Operations Planner is responsible for coordinating the day-to-day operational delivery of home support services to elderly people and individuals with disabilities living in the community. The role involves analysing workforce capacity, evaluating operational priorities and making independent resource allocation decisions. Operational decisions made within this role directly impact the continuity of care provided to elderly people and individuals with disabilities, requiring a high level of judgement, analytical thinking, strong organisational skills, and accountability. Requirements Essential • Minimum 1 year's experience in a planning, scheduling, operations or resource allocation role requiring independent decision-making and organisational skills. • Excellent planning, analytical and problem-solving abilities. • Ability to prioritise competing operational demands within a fast-paced environment. • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with Healthcare Assistants, healthcare professionals, clients and family members. • Excellent organisational skills and high attention to detail. • Ability to remain calm and make effective decisions under pressure. • Strong IT skills with confidence using computer systems, electronic scheduling software, Microsoft Office and other digital platforms. • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary team.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I august 2019 åpnet det sentrale serveringsstedet på torget i ny drakt. Pangea kitchen & Bar

Vi er alt annet en mainstream, vi lager det vi synes er godt. Her er det ingen regler på hvilke kulturer og kjøkken som krysser hverandre. Så lenge det smaker digg, er det lov

Pangea er et ujålete og raust restaurantkonsept, som oser av kvalitet med fokus på hva som blir levert på tallerken og i glasset til gjestene.

In August 2019, the central serving location on the square opened in a new guise. Pangea kitchen & Bar

We are anything but mainstream, we make what we think is good. Here there are no rules on which cultures and cuisines intersect. As long as it tastes good, it's legal

Pangea is an unpretentious and generous restaurant concept, which oozes quality with a focus on what is delivered on the plate and in the glass to the guests.

jobs.title: Tiimipäällikkö
jobs.description:
**Toimintamme kasvaessa etsimme nyt neljättä tiimipäällikköä Huolenpitotiimiin. Meillä pääset oppimaan jatkuvasti uutta asuntosijoittamisesta ja vuokrasuhteiden hallinnoinnista.**

Asuntopehtoori on täyden palvelun asuntovarallisuuden hoitaja, joka tarjoaa asiakkailleen vuokravälitystä, asuntovälitystä, vuokra-asuntojen Huolenpitopalvelua sekä isännöintiä. Olemme ketterä ja nykyaikainen toimija, joka tunnetaan loistavasta asiakaspalvelustaan sekä kilpailukykyisestä hinnoittelustaan. Toimimme 14 eri kaupungissa palvellen asiakkaita ympäri Suomen!

Meillä Asuntopehtoorin Huolenpitopalvelussa teet tiivistä yhteistyötä Huolenpitopalvelun muiden tiimipäällikön, sihteeriemme ja välittäjiemme sekä liiketoimintajohtajan kanssa. Tiimissämme on yhdessä tekemisen meininki ja hyvä yhteishenki!

Tiimipäällikön tehtävänä on varmistaa, että tiimin päivittäinen työ sujuu tehokkaasti, ja asiakkaamme saavat laadukasta ja asiantuntevaa palvelua. Tiimipäällikkönä vaikutat suoraan siihen, miten tiimi toimii, millaista palvelua asiakkaamme saavat ja miten pystymme vastaamaan kasvun tuomiin tarpeisiin. Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on kyky itsenäiseen työskentelyyn, kyky kantaa vastuuta omasta ja tiimin työskentelystä sekä halua kehittää toimintaa ja auttaa tiimiä onnistumaan yhdessä.

**Työnkuva:**

- Tiimin päivittäisen työn johtaminen ja resursointi huomioiden mm. lomat ja poissaolot

- Työntekijöiden tukeminen ja esihenkilötyö

- Uusien työntekijöiden rekrytointi ja perehdytys

- Raportointi ja palkkojen koostaminen

- Sihteereiden tukeminen erilaisissa vuokrasuhteisiin liittyvissä haastavissa tilanteissa

- Haastavien asiakastilanteiden ratkaiseminen

- Palvelun laadun seuranta ja kehittäminen

- Asiakastyytyväisyyden parantamiseen tähtäävien toimintatapojen kehittäminen

- Yhteistyö muiden tiimien ja sidosryhmien kanssa


**Odotamme rooliin valitulta henkilöltä:**

- Osaamista tiimin johtamisesta ja esihenkilötyöstä

- Kykyä kantaa vastuuta sekä omasta että tiimin tekemisestä ja toimia esimerkkinä muille

- Kykyä seurata, arvioida ja kehittää työn laatua sekä puuttua tarvittaessa havaittuihin puutteisiin

- Aiempaa kokemusta sijoitusasunnoista ja vuokrasuhteiden hallinnoinnista

- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja

- Itsenäistä, järjestelmällistä ja vastuullista työotetta

- Rohkeutta tehdä päätöksiä, viedä asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin ja ottaa myös haastavia asioita rakentavasti puheeksi

- Rakentavaa ja ratkaisukeskeistä asennetta, kykyä toimia joustavasti muuttuvissa tilanteissa sekä valmiutta sitoutua yhteisiin tavoitteisiin ja viedä niitä eteenpäin myös haastavissa tilanteissa


Lisäksi arvostamme asunto-osakeyhtiölain ja huoneenvuokralain perusteiden osaamista sekä kokemusta kiinteistönvälitysalalta tai asuntosijoittamisesta. Aiempi kokemus vuokravälityksestä, vuokravalvonnasta, vuokrasuhteiden hoitamisesta, LKV/LVV-tutkinto tai muu työtehtävää tukeva koulutus katsotaan eduksi.

Palkkaus on kiinteä kuukausipalkka 3 000 - 3 300 €/kk aiemman kokemuksen mukaan.

Luottamus ja vastuullisuus ovat toimintamme perusta, minkä vuoksi tehtävään valittavalta henkilöltä tarkistetaan luottotiedot.

**Työaika ja työskentelypaikka**

Työaika arkisin klo 8.00-16.00. Työ pitää sisällään satunnaisia viikonloppuvuoroja muutaman kerran vuodessa. Työskentelypaikka on Asuntopehtoorin toimisto. Saat kuitenkin itse valita, että millä toimistostamme tulisit työskentelemään, joten kerrothan hakemuksessa mikä toimistomme olisi sinulle mieluisin.

Vastaanottoperhehoito tarkoittaa sitä, että lapsi tai nuori sijoitetaan perhehoitoon lyhyeksi aikaa, tavallisimmillaan muutamasta päivästä kuukausiin. Pitkäaikainen perhehoito tarkoittaa sitä, että lapsi tai nuori on sijoitettu lastensuojelulain mukaisesti pidempiaikaisesti perhehoitoon. Perhe perheeseen sijoitus on avohuollon tukitoimi, jolla voidaan sijoittaa koko perhe perhehoitajan kotiin ja jonka aikana tuen tarvetta arvioidaan ja perhettä tuetaan kasvatustehtävässään.

**Etsimme lastensuojelun perhehoitajia**

Perhehoitajaksi ei vaadita sosiaalialan koulutusta, tärkeintä on sitkeys, lämpö ja kyky kohdata myös lapsen vaikeat tunteet turvallisesti. Perhehoitajana olet lapselle pysyvä ja luotettava aikuinen, joka tarjoaa arjen turvaa ja jatkuvuutta.

**Sinulta edellytämme:**

Kykyä toteuttaa terapeuttista vanhemmuutta, kykyä kohdata lapsi tunnetasolla, tuet hänen kuntoutumistaan ja luot turvallisen, oppimista edistävän kasvuympäristön. Yhteistyötaitosi ovat vahvat, sillä teet suunnitelmallista yhteistyötä lapsen vanhempien, läheisverkoston ja viranomaisten kanssa asiakassuunnitelman mukaisesti. Odotamme myös koko perheen sitoutumista: muiden perheenjäsenten tulee hyväksyä sijoitettu lapsi ja kyetä tarjoamaan hänelle tasavertainen asema perheessä koko sijoituksen ajan.

Perhehoitajana toimiminen on haastava tehtävä, joka vaatii vahvan tuen. Tarjoamme:

- Perhehoidon vastuutyöntekijän säännölliset kotikäynnit ja puhelinkeskustelut.

- Nopeat ja joustavat tukipalvelut.

- Tilapäistä lastenhoitoapua.

- Työnohjaus ja vertaisryhmätoiminta.

- Mentorointi.

- Erityisasiantuntijan konsultointikäynnit.

- Koulutukset.

- Virkistyspäiviä koko perheelle.

- 24/7 puhelinpäivystyksen.

- Kilpailukykyisen palkkion ja korvauksen.


Lastensuojelun perhehoitajana voi toimia yksin tai yhdessä puolison kanssa. Perhehoitajana toimiminen edellyttää ennakkovalmennuksen suorittamista. AVA perhepalvelut tarjoaa perhehoitajaksi ryhtyville maksuttoman PRIDE-ennakkovalmennuksen. Valmennuksen tavoitteena on antaa riittävästi tietoa sijaisvanhemmuudesta niin, että valmennukseen osallistuva voi tehdä tietoisen päätöksen ryhtymisestään tehtävään sekä taata jokaiselle sijaisperhettä tarvitsevalle lapselle mahdollisuus päästä hyvin valmentautuneeseen perheeseen ja saada yksilöllisiä tarpeita vastaava hoito ja huolenpito perheessä.

Seuraavat PRIDE -valmennus alkaa 7.11.2026.

jobs.title: Machinist, Bluefors Oy
jobs.description:
Bluefors Oy is a Finnish high-tech company based in Helsinki, working at the absolute frontier of quantum technology. They design and manufacture some of the world's most precise cryogenic measurement systems - the kind of equipment that pushes the boundaries of what science can do. When you work here, your machining skills directly support cutting-edge research used by leading institutions and companies around the world.

As a Machinist at Bluefors, you'll be working with a 5-axis DMG Mori milling machine, producing precision parts from materials like copper, aluminium, brass, stainless steel, and POM. The work is varied - small series, tight tolerances where it counts, and surface finishes that matter. You'll have real influence over your work, not just push a button and repeat.

YOUR TASKS

You'll be working as a Machinist in Bluefors' production team, operating a 5-axis DMG Mori milling machine to manufacture precision components for quantum technology systems.

- Setting up and operating 5-axis DMG Mori milling machines using Heidenhain controls
- Machining parts from copper, AISI 316 stainless steel, brass, aluminium, and POM
- Working with part sizes ranging from 5 to 360 mm in diameter
- Producing small series (typically under 10 pieces) with accuracy and consistency
- Maintaining tight tolerances and high surface quality standards where required
- Reading and interpreting technical drawings and machining programs
- Carrying out quality checks and ensuring finished parts meet specifications
- Contributing to a clean, organized, and safe workshop environment

REQUIREMENTS

- Solid experience setting up and operating CNC milling machines
- Hands-on experience with 5-axis machining
- Familiarity with Heidenhain controls
- Ability to read technical drawings and apply tolerances accurately
- Attention to surface quality and detail
- Good communication skills in Finnish or English

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with Mastercam or other CAM software
- Background machining copper, brass, or other non-ferrous materials
- Experience in small-series precision manufacturing
- Prior work in a high-tech or engineering environment

Chosen applicants will be employed with Barona Teollisuus Oy with fixed-term contract until 31.12.2026, with possibility for extension.

This is full-time position from Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week with 2-shift rotation on a 3-week cycle: 2 weeks on a day shift (Monday to Friday) and 1 week on evening shift (Monday to Thursday from 14.00 to 00.00, Fridays off).

If this sounds like you and you're the machinist were looking for, submit your application today using the link provided. For more information, contact Ari Kumlander at Barona by email at
. Please note that, due to data privacy regulations, we cannot accept applications submitted via email.

jobs.title: Join our Account Executive teams!
jobs.description:
At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.

With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.

Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.

Join Us

We are growing our Buy-Side Sales teams and looking for ambitious Account Executives to join us in several markets. This is not a single open role, but a talent pool - an ongoing hiring pipeline which we will continuously review and match strong profiles with upcoming opportunities across our teams.

Your Mission

Our Account Executives are at the heart of Mercell’s mission. You’ll be a trusted advisor to public sector customers, guiding them through a value based buying journey and showing how Mercell’s solutions can help them achieve efficiency, compliance, and real impact for society.

You’ll manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting and qualifying leads (both inbound and outbound) to running demos, managing tender responses, negotiating terms, and closing deals.

With each success, you’ll help strengthen Mercell’s presence in your market and expand our growing community of public sector partners.

Core Responsibilities  

  • Proactively identify, engage, and build relationships with key decision-makers across your market.

  • Translate the business pains of the organization into a value based selling approach to drive large strategic engagements.

  • Own the entire sales journey from first contact and discovery to negotiation, closing, onboarding, and upselling.

  • Confidently demonstrate the value and impact of Mercell’s SaaS platform to organisations of all sizes.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM data in HubSpot, using insights to optimise pipeline and sales performance.

  • Stay ahead of developments in the local and European public procurement landscape to uncover new growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications  

  • Strong experience (ideally 3-5 years) managing a full B2B SaaS sales cycle, preferably to the public sector or highly regulated industries with a tender driven sales motion.

  • Strong experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation with demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, and collaborative environment where priorities evolve.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

  • Fluency in at least one of the following languages: Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, German or Dutch.

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Familiarity with public procurement, tendering, or compliance-driven buying processes.

  • Experience working in an international or multi-market sales environment.

  • Strong consultative selling mindset with a focus on long-term customer value. 

Workplace type: Hybrid, working onsite at the office and from home balancing flexibility with collaboration

Locations: Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Netherlands

 

What we offer 

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. Please see https://career.mercell.com/posts/our-perks-benefits to get more insights on what to expect of perks, benefits and culture when joining Mercell.

Has this sparked your interest?

Apply now and join our team!

This is a talent pool, there is no fixed application deadline — we will review applications continuously.

By applying, your profile will be considered for upcoming opportunities that match your skills, experience, and interests. We will keep you updated accordingly throughout the process.

-Mercell is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

-Mercell handles all personal data in line with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

-Mercell does not provide relocation support. We are seeking candidates who are already based in, or have existing work authorization for, the country where the role is located.

-Mercell may carry out background checks on applicants to verify information that appears on CVs and other documentation. This background check is carried out by an external party and is not carried out without the consent of the applicant. Current applicants will receive further information about this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Mercell, we’re transforming how businesses manage procurement and public tendering processes. As a leading provider of digital solutions for procurement, we help organizations across Europe streamline, automate, and optimize their sourcing operations. Our cloud-based platform connects buyers and suppliers, driving transparency, efficiency, and compliance in public and private sector procurement. The Problem We Solve: Procurement is often plagued by inefficiencies, manual workflows, and a lack of transparency, making it time-consuming and prone to errors. This not only impacts operational performance but can also prevent businesses from making strategic, cost-effective decisions. At Mercell, we are solving these challenges by providing an integrated solution that simplifies the tendering process, ensures compliance with regulatory standards, and empowers businesses with data-driven insights. Why We Do It: We believe that efficient procurement is at the heart of sustainable business growth. By digitizing and optimizing the procurement process, we help organizations save time, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions, all while fostering a more competitive and transparent marketplace. Our goal is to empower organizations to focus on their core business, leaving procurement complexity to us. At Mercell, we’re driven by innovation and a passion to continuously improve the procurement landscape.

jobs.description:

Asiakkaamme on rakennus- ja työmaakaluston myyntiin erikoistunut yritys, joka palvelee rakennusalan ammattilaisia laadukkailla koneilla, laitteilla ja asiantuntevalla palvelulla. Etsimme henkilöä, joka innostuu asiakaskohtaamisista, ymmärtää teknisiä tuotteita tai haluaa oppia niistä lisää ja nauttii tavoitteellisesta myyntityöstä. Tässä tehtävässä yhdistyvät asiantuntijamyynti, asiakassuhteiden rakentaminen ja käytännönläheinen tekeminen.

Työtehtäväsi -->

Rakennuskoneiden myyjänä vastaat asiakkaiden palvelemisesta ja myynnin edistämisestä. Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:

- asiakkaiden tarpeiden kartoittaminen ja oikeiden ratkaisujen tarjoaminen

- rakennuskoneiden ja työmaakaluston myynti sekä tarjousten laatiminen

- uusien asiakkuuksien hankinta ja olemassa olevien asiakassuhteiden kehittäminen

Myytävä kalusto on erittäin monipuolinen ja sisältää esimerkiksi pienkoneita, rakennustyökaluja, henkilönostimia, maanrakennuskoneita, työmaakalustoa sekä erilaisia erikoislaitteita.

Toivomme, että sinulla on:

- kokemusta myyntityöstä tai vahva halu kehittyä teknisen alan myyjäksi

- teknistä ymmärrystä tai kiinnostusta koneisiin ja laitteisiin

- asiakaslähtöinen ja tavoitteellinen työote

- halua oppia uutta ja kehittää omaa osaamistasi

- laadukkaat tuotteet ja tunnetut tuotemerkit myynnin tueksi

- kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään

- mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi teknisen kaupan ammattilaisena

- kannustavan työyhteisön ja pitkäaikaisen työmahdollisuuden


Työ sijaitsee Itä-Helsingissä.

Jos nautit asiakastyöstä, haluat rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita ja kiinnostut teknisistä tuotteista, tämä voi olla juuri sinun seuraava urasi.

jobs.description:
CMS Construction Management Solutions Oy is looking for **Project Schedulers** for our client's industrial project in the Oulu region, Finland.

As a Project Scheduler, you will work as part of the project organization and be responsible for preparing, maintaining and monitoring project schedules. You will work closely with project management, site teams and other project parties to ensure that schedule information is up to date and that project progress can be effectively monitored and reported.

**Your responsibilities include**

- preparing, maintaining and updating project schedules

- monitoring project progress against the agreed schedule

- tracking key milestones, dependencies and critical paths

- identifying schedule deviations, delays and potential risks

- preparing schedule forecasts and progress reports

- collecting and coordinating schedule information from different project parties

- supporting the follow-up of work progress and upcoming activities

- reporting schedule status and relevant changes to the project organization

- working closely with project management, site teams and other project stakeholders


**We are looking for**

- previous experience in similar scheduling roles in industrial or construction projects

- experience with Primavera P6

- good understanding of project scheduling, dependencies and progress monitoring

- ability to analyze schedules and identify deviations and potential delays

- good IT and reporting skills

- good command of English

- a valid right to work in Finland


Accommodation and project-related travel can be arranged by CMS as agreed.

**Applicants must have valid rights to work in Finland.**

**The opportunity**

Hitachi Energy is on an exciting growth journey. We are investing over EUR 170 million to build a new production and technology center in Vikby, Mustasaari. The upcoming Hitachi Energy Park will feature a top-notch transformer factory and modern office and testing facilities, which will double the companys production and testing capacity of transformers in Finland. The Hitachi Energy Park Production and Technology Center is expected to be operational by early 2027.

We are now looking for a Testing Specialist at Hitachi Energy, Transformers business in Vaasa. You will be performing routine, type and special tests on power transformers and reactors in accordance with electrical safety regulations, standards, technical specifications and test procedures. In this position, you are typically in close contact with customers from all over the world during factory acceptance tests.

We offer you a challenging and rewarding position in an international working environment, in which there's a great opportunity for personal development. We will provide training and support to help you grow into this role. You will be part of an experienced, professional team using state-of-the-art measurement tools.

· Managing, planning and performing routine, type and special tests on power transformers up to 400MVA, 420kV and reactors up to 200MVAr, 420kV.

· Leading factory acceptance tests together with project managers in close contact with customers

· Strong commitment to safe work practices and dedication to following all relevant workplace safety guidelines.

**Your background**

· B.Sc. or M.Sc. in electrical engineering

· The ability to work in teams and good proactive communication skills

"    vzdělání - preferujeme VŠ obor zahradnictví, arboristika, krajinářská architektura, správa zeleně, zahradní a krajinářské realizace, lesnictví, zemědělství případně SŠ obdobného zaměření s praxí v oboru
"    řidičský průkaz skupiny B,

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!

The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 

While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.

This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
  • Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
  • Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
  • Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
  • Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
  • Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
  • Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
  • Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
  • US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
  • Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
  • Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
  • Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
  • Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
  • Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)
  • Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing

jobs.title: Ingénieur d'application MES (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Applications pour assurer l'interface technique principale entre les clients, les partenaires système et les équipes d'ingénierie Vsora. Ce rôle combine accompagnement client, support technique, intégration de plateformes et résolution de problèmes au niveau système, afin d'assurer le succès du déploiement des solutions IA basées sur l'accélérateur Vsora.

Vos responsabilités Servir de pont entre les clients et les équipes d'ingénierie Vsora, assurant une communication efficace et la priorisation des problèmes techniques. Traduire les exigences clients, les demandes de fonctionnalités et les défis de déploiement en retours actionnables pour les équipes Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de validation logicielle, runtime, compilateur, logiciel IA et matériel pour résoudre les problèmes et améliorer le produit Suivre et gérer les escalades clients jusqu'à leur résolution, en maintenant une communication claire avec l'ensemble des parties prenantes Accompagner les fabricants de serveurs, OEM, ODM et partenaires plateforme dans l'intégration des accélérateurs Vsora dans des systèmes de production. Résoudre les problèmes au niveau système impliquant le matériel, le firmware, les drivers, le réseau, le stockage, l'alimentation et la thermique Collaborer avec les équipes hardware pour diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes d'intégration plateforme et d'interopérabilité.

Description du profil Solide expérience en support technique, ingénierie terrain (FAE), solutions engineering, ingénierie client ou intégration système Expérience en infrastructure IA, serving d'inférence, déploiement ML ou plateformes datacenter Familiarité avec les frameworks IA et solutions de serving : PyTorch, ONNX, Hugging Face, vLLM, SGLang, Triton Inference Server ou technologies équivalentes Expérience avec les systèmes Linux, les technologies de containerisation, les systèmes distribués. Compréhension de l'architecture serveur, des accélérateurs PCIe et de l'infrastructure datacenter Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et débogage : hardware, firmware, drivers, systèmes d'exploitation et logiciels applicatifs Excellentes capacités de communication et de relation client, avec la capacité d'interagir efficacement avec des interlocuteurs techniques et non-techniques Expérience avec des OEM, ODM, hyperscalers, cloud providers ou clients enterprise est un fort atout.

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d'activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l'environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d'euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l'innovation tels que l'IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Votre quotidien

Rejoignez-nous sur le campus Vélizy qui héberge une grande diversité d'activités Thales, aéro, défense, civile A l'ouest de Paris, ce site offre un environnement de travail équipé des dernières innovations technologiques et propose des services permettant de concilier vie professionnelle et personnelle.

L'outil TCIS (Thales Component Information System) référence l'ensemble des composants (matériels, produits chimiques, outils logiciels) utilisés par le groupe Thales pour définir et développer ses produits.

Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un Software Solution Engineer expérimenté pour maintenir en condition opérationnelle cet outil et participer au développement de son écosystème.

Vos principales missions seront :

Effectuer le Support (redémarrage application / serveur de cette application dans le respect des directives, processus et pratiques standardisés de la discipline

Développer et livrer des packs correctifs de cette application

Contribuer de manière active à l'intégration de cette application dans son écosystème en développant des passerelles entre TCIS et les différents outils de son écosystème.

Collaborer avec les équipes de développement pour implémenter et exécuter des tests d'intégration

Participer et contribuer aux évènements de disciplines qui promeuvent l'amélioration continue.

Participer activement aux différentes cérémonies agiles

Votre profil :

Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée d'au moins 5 ans dans le développement d'application d'applications logiciel en tant que développeur Full stack et en particulier sur du maintien en condition opérationnelle.

Vous maitrisez le développement JAVA en particulier la version 1.6

Vous avez des connaissances solides en scripting Shell

Vous avez des connaissances solides en Oracle - SQL/PLSQL

Par ailleurs :

Vous avez des connaissances de l'OS linux (Red Hat )

Vous avez des connaissances sur un Cloud provider en particulier Azure

Vous vous intéressez aux technologies d'IA, en particulier l'IA générative

Vous avez une forte appétence pour le Software craftmanship et ses principes

Vous êtes doté(e) de fort esprit d'analyse, vous avez l'esprit d'équipe et êtes autonome.

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

Obiettivo del ruolo e responsabilità principali: Assicurare che ogni commessa venga gestita con rispetto di tempi, contratti e consegne, mantenendo un presidio operativo sul cantiere e guidando squadre e fornitori con metodo, disciplina e orientamento al risultato. In particolare: Pianificazione delle commesse: organizzare il susseguirsi dei cantieri sul lungo periodo, in base alle scadenze contrattuali, durata dei cantieri, ecc.
